tk.Frame(p, bg=BG); up.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="ew") self.sw_path_lbl = tk.Label(up, text="No file selected", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG3, padx=12, pady=8, anchor="w") self.sw_path_lbl.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True) self._btn(up, "📂 Choose file", BG4, BTN_FG, self._pick_sw).pack(side="left", padx=(8,0)) br = tk.Frame(p, bg=BG); br.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(8,0)) self._btn(br, "↔️ Analyze Width", BLUE, "#090909", self._analyse_sw).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=2) self._btn(br, "📋 Copy", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda: self._copy_txt(self.sw_txt)).pack(side="left") self.sw_status = tk.Label(p, text="", font=F_LABEL, fg=BLUE, bg=BG) self.sw_status.grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(4,4)) self.sw_canvas = tk.Canvas(p, bg="#080808", height=200, highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=BORDER) self.sw_canvas.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0,6)) self.sw_txt = self._txt_out(p, 6, BLUE) p.rowconfigure(6, weight=1) self.sw_file = None def _pick_sw(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("Alle","*.*")]) if path: self.sw_file = path self.sw_path_lbl.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(path)}", fg=FG) def _analyse_sw(self): if not self.sw_file: messagebox.showwarning("No file selected","Please choose an audio file first.") return self.sw_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing..."); self.update() try: import librosa, numpy as np from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt # Laad stereo y_stereo, sr = librosa.load(self.sw_file, sr=None, mono=False) if y_stereo.ndim == 1 or y_stereo.shape[0] == 1: self.sw_status.config(text="⚠️ Mono bestand — geen stereo width") self._write(self.sw_txt, "Dit is een mono bestand.\nStereo width is 0.") return L, R = y_stereo[0], y_stereo[1] M = (L + R) / 2 # Mid S = (L - R) / 2 # Side # Width per frequentieband BANDS = [("Sub 20-80Hz",20,80),("Bass 80-250Hz",80,250), ("Low-Mid 250-500Hz",250,500),("Mid 500-2kHz",500,2000), ("Hi-Mid 2-5kHz",2000,5000),("Presence 5-8kHz",5000,8000), ("Air 8-20kHz",8000,min(18000,sr//2-100))] def bp_rms(sig, f_lo, f_hi): nyq = sr/2; lo = f_lo/nyq; hi = min(f_hi/nyq, 0.999) if lo >= hi: return 1e-9 sos = butter(4,[lo,hi],btype='band',output='sos') filt = sosfilt(sos, sig[:sr*30]) return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(filt**2))) widths = [] for name, f_lo, f_hi in BANDS: m_rms = bp_rms(M, f_lo, f_hi) s_rms = bp_rms(S, f_lo, f_hi) width = min(1.0, s_rms / (m_rms + 1e-9)) widths.append((name, width, f_lo, f_hi)) # Overall width m_total = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(M**2))) s_total = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(S**2))) overall = min(1.0, s_total / (m_total + 1e-9)) # L/R phase correlation — a DIFFERENT metric than the M/S # width ratio above (this is what Logic's correlation meter # shows). +1 = perfectly phase-coherent (safe for mono), # -1 = out of phase. A track can show correlation near +1 # while STILL having real width above, if L/R differ in # level/EQ but not phase — tested: L=1.0x, R=0.6x same # waveform gave correlation=1.00 but M/S width=0.25, # confirming these genuinely measure different things and # aren't in conflict when they appear to disagree. try: lr_correlation = float(np.corrcoef(L, R)[0,1]) except Exception: lr_correlation = 1.0 # Teken canvas self.sw_canvas.update() W = self.sw_canvas.winfo_width() or 800 H = 200; PAD_L=50; PAD_R=20; PAD_T=15; PAD_B=30 self.sw_canvas.delete("all") n = len(widths) bar_w = (W-PAD_L-PAD_R)//n - 4 for i,(name,width,_,_) in enumerate(widths): x = PAD_L + i*((W-PAD_L-PAD_R)//n) bar_h = int(width * (H-PAD_T-PAD_B)) if width > 0.6: col = "#27c45a" elif width > 0.3: col = BLUE elif width > 0.1: col = GOLD_LT else: col = ACCENT self.sw_canvas.create_rectangle( x, H-PAD_B-bar_h, x+bar_w, H-PAD_B, fill=col, outline="") self.sw_canvas.create_text( x+bar_w//2, H-PAD_B-bar_h-8, text=f"{width:.2f}", fill=col, font=("Courier New",7,"bold")) short = name.split(" ")[0] self.sw_canvas.create_text( x+bar_w//2, H-PAD_B+10, text=short, fill="#555555", font=("Courier New",7)) # Referentie lijnen for pct, label in [(0.6,"Breed"),(0.3,"Normaal"),(0.1,"Smal")]: y = H-PAD_B - int(pct*(H-PAD_T-PAD_B)) self.sw_canvas.create_line(PAD_L, y, W-PAD_R, y, fill="#2a2a2a", dash=(3,4)) self.sw_canvas.create_text(PAD_L-3, y, text=label, fill="#3a3a3a", font=("Courier New",7), anchor="e") # Tekst rapport out = "── STEREO WIDTH ANALYSE ──────────────────────────────\n" out += f" Overall breedte: {overall:.2f} " if overall > 0.6: out += "→ Breed — goed voor sync\n" elif overall > 0.3: out += "→ Normaal — gezonde mix\n" elif overall > 0.1: out += "→ Smal — kan breder\n" else: out += "→ Bijna mono\n" out += f" L/R fase-correlatie: {lr_correlation:+.2f} " out += "(1.0 = veilig voor mono-som, geen fase-uitdoving)\n" out += " ⚠️ Dit is een ANDER getal dan 'breedte' hierboven — je kan\n" out += " +1.0 correlatie zien (zoals Logic's meter toont) terwijl er\n" out += " toch echte breedte is (bijv. door niveau/EQ-verschil zonder\n" out += " fase-verschil). Beide getallen kunnen tegelijk kloppen.\n" out += "\n Per band:\n" for name, width, _, _ in widths: bar = "█"*int(width*20) + "░"*(20-int(width*20)) advice = "" if width < 0.1: advice = "⚠️ Bijna mono in deze band" elif width > 0.8: advice = "⚠️ Erg breed — check mono" out += f" {name:<20} {bar} {width:.2f} {advice}\n" out += "\n── MONO CHECK ────────────────────────────────────────\n" mono_issues = [n for n,w,_,_ in widths if w > 0.7] if mono_issues: out += f" ⚠️ Erg breed in: {', '.join(mono_issues)}\n" out += " → Check of dit nog goed klinkt in mono (TV, telefoon)\n" else: out += " ✅ Mono compatibel — geen brede banden die problemen geven\n" out += "\n── SYNC ADVIES ───────────────────────────────────────\n" if overall < 0.2: out += " 💡 Track is smal — gebruik Ozone Imager of S1 voor meer breedte\n" out += " 💡 FabFilter Pro-Q3 M/S mode: boost side kanaal bij 5-10kHz\n" elif overall > 0.7: out += " 💡 Track is erg breed — zorg dat het in mono nog goed klinkt\n" out += " 💡 Ozone Imager: beperk breedte in lage banden (sub/bass)\n" else: out += " ✅ Stereo breedte is goed voor sync placements\n" self._write(self.sw_txt, out) self.sw_status.config(text=f"✅ Overall width: {overall:.2f} · {os.path.basename(self.sw_file)}") except Exception as e: self.sw_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:60]}") # ── ARRANGEMENT ANALYZER ────────────────────────────── def _build_arrangement(self, parent): p = tk.Frame(parent, bg=BG, padx=22) p.pack(fill="both", expand=True, pady=8) p.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) tk.Label(p, text="🎼 ARRANGEMENT ANALYZER", font=F_MED, fg=PURPLE, bg=BG).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(8,2)) tk.Label(p, text="Analyze the structure of a track — intro, verse, chorus, bridge, outro", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG).grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(0,8)) up = tk.Frame(p, bg=BG); up.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="ew") self.arr_path_lbl = tk.Label(up, text="No file selected", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG3, padx=12, pady=8, anchor="w") self.arr_path_lbl.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True) self._btn(up, "📂 Choose file", BG4, BTN_FG, self._pick_arr).pack(side="left", padx=(8,0)) br = tk.Frame(p, bg=BG); br.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(8,0)) self._btn(br, "🎼 Analyze Structure", PURPLE, "white", self._analyse_arr).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=2) self._btn(br, "📋 Copy", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda: self._copy_txt(self.arr_txt)).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8)) self._btn(br, "⭐ Favorite", BG4, GOLD_LT, lambda: self._fav_txt(self.arr_txt)).pack(side="left") self.arr_status = tk.Label(p, text="", font=F_LABEL, fg=PURPLE, bg=BG) self.arr_status.grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(4,4)) self.arr_canvas = tk.Canvas(p, bg="#080808", height=120, highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=BORDER) self.arr_canvas.grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0,6)) self.arr_txt = self._txt_out(p, 6, PURPLE) p.rowconfigure(6, weight=1) self.arr_file = None def _pick_arr(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("Alle","*.*")]) if path: self.arr_file = path self.arr_path_lbl.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(path)}", fg=FG) def _analyse_arr(self): if not self.arr_file: messagebox.showwarning("No file selected","Please choose an audio file first.") return self.arr_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing..."); self.update() try: import librosa, numpy as np y, sr = librosa.load(self.arr_file, sr=None, mono=True) dur = librosa.get_duration(y=y, sr=sr) # Splits in segmenten van 5 seconden seg_s = 5 n_seg = int(dur // seg_s) segs = [] for i in range(n_seg): chunk = y[i*seg_s*sr:(i+1)*seg_s*sr] rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(chunk**2))) sc = float(librosa.feature.spectral_centroid(y=chunk,sr=sr).mean()) segs.append({"rms":rms,"sc":sc,"t":i*seg_s}) if not segs: self.arr_status.config(text="❌ Track te kort") return rms_vals = [s["rms"] for s in segs] rms_max = max(rms_vals) rms_min = min(rms_vals) rms_avg = sum(rms_vals)/len(rms_vals) # Label secties op basis van energie sections = [] prev_label = None for i, seg in enumerate(segs): e = seg["rms"] pct = i / len(segs) if e < rms_avg * 0.5: label = "Intro/Outro" if (pct < 0.15 or pct > 0.85) else "Break/Bridge" elif e > rms_avg * 1.3: label = "Chorus/Drop" elif e > rms_avg * 0.9: label = "Verse/Build" else: label = "Transitie" if label != prev_label: t = seg["t"] sections.append({ "label": label, "start": t, "start_str": f"{int(t//60)}:{int(t%60):02d}" }) prev_label = label # Teken arrangement visueel self.arr_canvas.update() W = self.arr_canvas.winfo_width() or 800 H = 120; PAD_L=10; PAD_R=10; PAD_T=15; PAD_B=30 self.arr_canvas.delete("all") pw = W - PAD_L - PAD_R SECT_COLORS = { "Intro/Outro":"#3a8fd9","Verse/Build":"#27c45a", "Chorus/Drop":"#e8323e","Break/Bridge":"#f0d060", "Transitie":"#6a6a6a" } for i, seg in enumerate(segs): x = PAD_L + int(i/len(segs)*pw) w = max(2, int(pw/len(segs))) e_norm = (seg["rms"]-rms_min)/(rms_max-rms_min+1e-9) h = max(4, int(e_norm*(H-PAD_T-PAD_B))) # Kleur op basis van secties col = "#3a3a3a" for s in sections: if seg["t"] >= s["start"]: col = SECT_COLORS.get(s["label"],"#3a3a3a") self.arr_canvas.create_rectangle( x, H-PAD_B-h, x+w, H-PAD_B, fill=col, outline="") # Sectie labels for s in sections: x = PAD_L + int(s["start"]/dur*pw) self.arr_canvas.create_line(x, PAD_T, x, H-PAD_B, fill="#2a2a2a", dash=(2,3)) self.arr_canvas.create_text(x+2, PAD_T, text=f"{s['start_str']} {s['label'][:8]}", fill="#555555", font=("Courier New",7), anchor="nw") # Tekst output out = "── ARRANGEMENT STRUCTUUR ─────────────────────────────\n" out += f" Duur: {int(dur//60)}:{int(dur%60):02d} · {len(sections)} secties gevonden\n\n" for i, s in enumerate(sections): end_t = sections[i+1]["start"] if i+1 < len(sections) else dur length = end_t - s["start"] out += f" [{s['start_str']}] {s['label']:<15} ({length:.0f} sec)\n" out += "\n── ADVIES ────────────────────────────────────────────\n" has_chorus = any(s["label"]=="Chorus/Drop" for s in sections) has_break = any(s["label"]=="Break/Bridge" for s in sections) if not has_chorus: out += " 💡 Geen duidelijke climax gevonden — voeg een energiek hoogtepunt toe\n" if not has_break: out += " 💡 Geen break/bridge — overweeg een rustig moment voor contrast\n" if dur < 90: out += " ⚠️ Track is korter dan 1:30 — voor sync vaak 2:00+ gewenst\n" elif dur > 300: out += " 💡 Track is lang — maak ook een 2-3 min edit voor sync\n" first_chorus = next((s for s in sections if s["label"]=="Chorus/Drop"), None) if first_chorus: if first_chorus["start"] > 60: out += f" ⚠️ Eerste climax pas na {first_chorus['start_str']} — supervisors luisteren max 30 sec\n" else: out += f" ✅ Eerste energie boost op {first_chorus['start_str']} — goede timing\n" out += "\n── LEGENDA ───────────────────────────────────────────\n" out += " 🔵 Intro/Outro 🟢 Verse/Build 🔴 Chorus/Drop 🟡 Break/Bridge\n" self._write(self.arr_txt, out) self.arr_status.config( text=f"✅ {len(sections)} secties · {int(dur//60)}:{int(dur%60):02d}") except Exception as e: self.arr_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:60]}") # ── DRUM SUGGESTIES ─────────────────────────────────── def _build_drum_suggest(self, parent): p = tk.Frame(parent, bg=BG, padx=22) p.pack(fill="both", expand=True, pady=8) CHAPTERS = { "basics": """══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 🎧 DJ COACH — CHAPTER 1: THE BASICS ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ A DJ plays music for an audience and creates a seamless musical experience. The difference between a good and great DJ: track selection, timing, technique. ── WHAT YOU NEED TO START ──────────────────────────── FREE (start here): → Mixxx (mixxx.org) — best free DJ software for Mac → Your own music library (MP3/WAV files) → Headphones — any closed-back pair works to start → Your Mac keyboard acts as a basic controller NEXT LEVEL (when you're ready): → Controller: Pioneer DDJ-FLX4 (~€300) — best beginner → Headphones: Sony MDR-7506 or Sennheiser HD25 → Software: Rekordbox (free with Pioneer hardware) PROFESSIONAL: → Pioneer CDJ-3000 + DJM mixer (club standard) → Serato DJ Pro or Traktor Pro ── THE THREE PILLARS OF DJING ─────────────────────── 1. TRACK SELECTION — right track at right moment The most important skill — technique means nothing without knowing what to play when. 2. TECHNICAL MIXING — smooth transitions Beatmatching, EQ mixing, phrasing — the craft. 3. CROWD READING — feeling what people want The most advanced skill — takes years to develop. Watch the dancefloor, not your screen. ── BPM RANGES PER GENRE ────────────────────────────── Lo-fi / Chill: 70-90 BPM Hip-Hop / R&B: 85-100 BPM Afrobeats: 95-115 BPM Dancehall: 80-100 BPM House: 120-130 BPM Tech House: 128-135 BPM Techno: 130-150 BPM Drum & Bass: 160-180 BPM ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ * Start with Mixxx — it's free and teaches you everything you need before buying hardware. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════""", "beatmatch": """══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 🎧 DJ COACH — CHAPTER 2: BEATMATCHING ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ Beatmatching = bringing two tracks to the exact same tempo so the beats overlap perfectly. ── THE GOLDEN RULE ─────────────────────────────────── ALWAYS learn to beatmatch manually first. Only use the sync button AFTER you can do it by ear. If you rely on sync from day one you will never develop the ear needed to be a real DJ. ── MANUAL BEATMATCHING STEP BY STEP ───────────────── 1. Play Track A — listen to the kick on beat 1 2. Load Track B in your headphones (cue/pre-listen) 3. Press play on Track B, tap along with Track A 4. Adjust the TEMPO SLIDER until they feel the same 5. Listen for the "flam" — when beats don't align → If Track B is rushing: slow it down (tempo down) → If Track B is dragging: speed it up (tempo up) 6. When they match — start Track B on beat 1 of Track A ── PHRASING — THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE ─────────────── Music is built in phrases of 4, 8, 16 or 32 bars. ALWAYS start your mix at the beginning of a phrase. Count while listening: 1-2-3-4, 2-2-3-4, 3-2-3-4... When you reach 8 or 16 — that's your mix point. Bad DJ: mixes randomly mid-phrase → sounds wrong Good DJ: always mixes on phrase boundaries → seamless ── HEADPHONE TECHNIQUE ─────────────────────────────── Split cue: one ear on Track A (speakers), one ear on Track B (headphones) This lets you hear both at the same time. In Mixxx: headphone icon → enable split cue Hold one ear of headphones to your ear Other ear listens to the main speakers ── COMMON MISTAKES ─────────────────────────────────── → Mixing too quickly — give it 8-16 bars minimum → Not counting phrases — always causes train wrecks → Relying on sync before learning manually → Watching the screen instead of the dancefloor → Mixing too many genres in one set ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ * Practice: load the same track on both decks Try to perfectly align them manually. When they sound like one track — you've got it. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════""", "camelot": """══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 🎧 DJ COACH — CHAPTER 3: CAMELOT WHEEL ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ The Camelot Wheel shows which keys mix harmoniously. Mixing in compatible keys = tracks sound musical together. Mixing in clashing keys = sounds wrong and amateur. ── THE CAMELOT WHEEL ───────────────────────────────── Each key has a number (1-12) and letter: A = minor key B = major key 1A = Ab minor 1B = B major 2A = Eb minor 2B = D major 3A = Bb minor 3B = F# major 4A = F minor 4B = Ab major 5A = C minor 5B = B major ← common! 6A = G minor 6B = Eb major 7A = D minor 7B = F major 8A = A minor 8B = C major ← very common! 9A = E minor 9B = G major 10A = B minor 10B = D major 11A = F# minor 11B = A major 12A = Db minor 12B = E major ── MIXING RULES ────────────────────────────────────── SAFE moves (always sounds good): → Same number: 8A → 8A (same key, different track) → +1 step: 8A → 9A (one step up) → -1 step: 8A → 7A (one step down) → A to B: 8A → 8B (minor to major = energy boost) → B to A: 8B → 8A (major to minor = emotional drop) RISKY moves (use carefully): → ±2 steps: can work but listen carefully first AVOID: → More than ±2 steps = will sound out of tune → Random key changes = amateur mistake ── HOW TO USE IN PRACTICE ─────────────────────────── 1. Find your current track's key (shown in Mixxx/Rekordbox) 2. Convert to Camelot number using the wheel above 3. Choose next track within ±1 step 4. Mix and the keys will blend naturally Example: Playing A minor (8A) → Next track options: 7A, 9A, or 8B → All three will sound musical and harmonic ── QUICK REFERENCE ─────────────────────────────────── Most popular keys in music: C minor (5A) — emotional, dark, cinematic A minor (8A) — the most common minor key C major (8B) — uplifting, happy G major (9B) — bright and positive F minor (4A) — dark and dramatic ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ * Rekordbox and Serato show Camelot numbers automatically. Enable "Key" display in settings. Mixxx shows the key — convert using the wheel above. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════""", "eq": """══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 🎧 DJ COACH — CHAPTER 4: EQ MIXING ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ EQ mixing is the professional technique for smooth, clean transitions. The bass swap is the most important skill after beatmatching. ── THE BASS SWAP — STEP BY STEP ───────────────────── WHY: Two bass lines playing simultaneously = muddy mess HOW: Only ONE track plays bass at a time 1. Track A playing — bass fully on (EQ low at 12 o'clock) 2. Load Track B, match BPM, cue in headphones 3. Start Track B but KILL THE BASS (EQ low fully left) 4. Slowly bring Track B volume up over 8-16 bars → You hear Track B melody but Track A bass 5. At your chosen mix point (phrase boundary!): → Turn Track B bass UP → Turn Track A bass DOWN → Do both simultaneously — this IS the bass swap 6. Bring Track A volume down — mix complete ── THREE-BAND EQ EXPLAINED ────────────────────────── LOW (Bass): 60-250Hz — kick, bass, sub MID (Mids): 250-3kHz — melody, pads, vocals HIGH (Treble): 3-20kHz — hi-hats, air, presence Typical DJ mixer EQ range: -∞ (kill) to +6dB ── EQ TECHNIQUES ───────────────────────────────────── FILTER SWEEP: → High-pass filter slowly sweeps up on outgoing track → Creates tension and anticipation before the drop → Use on the last 8 bars before a major transition MID CUT: → Cut the mids on the incoming track slightly → Reduces clashing with the outgoing track's vocals → Bring mids back up after the bass swap HIGH BLEND: → Slowly bring in the highs (hi-hats) of Track B → Before starting the full transition → Creates a smooth preview of what's coming ── COMMON EQ MISTAKES ──────────────────────────────── → Bass swap at the wrong moment (not on phrase) → Forgetting to kill the bass on incoming track → EQ-ing too aggressively — subtle is better → Not checking the mix in mono (bass disappears in mono!) ── VOLUME LEVELS ───────────────────────────────────── Outgoing track: start at 100% → end at 0% Incoming track: start at 0% → end at 100% Crossfade time: 8-32 bars depending on style Rule: the louder track always wins the crowd's attention ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ * Practice the bass swap with two similar tracks first. Same BPM, same energy — focus only on the EQ technique. When it feels natural — move to different tracks. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════""", "setbuild": """══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 🎧 DJ COACH — CHAPTER 5: SET BUILDING ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ A great set has an emotional arc — like a film. The crowd should feel a journey, not just hear tracks. ── ENERGY CURVE ────────────────────────────────────── Energy 10 | ▓▓▓▓▓ 9 | ▓▓▓ ▓▓▓ 8 | ▓▓▓ ▓▓▓ 7 | ▓▓▓ 6 | ▓▓▓ 5 | ▓▓▓ 4 | ▓▓▓ 3 | ▓▓▓ ───────────────────────────────────────── Start Build Peak Release End ── 1 HOUR SET STRUCTURE ────────────────────────────── 0:00-0:15 OPENING → Warm, melodic, lower energy → Let people arrive and settle in → BPM: start low, increase gradually → Play: deeper, more atmospheric tracks 0:15-0:35 BUILD → Slowly increase energy and BPM → Drop in more recognizable tracks → The crowd should start moving more 0:35-0:50 PEAK → Your biggest, best tracks go here → Maximum energy, maximum BPM → Anthems, crowd favorites, your best edits → The moment everyone remembers 0:50-1:00 OUTRO → Slowly bring energy back down → Give the crowd a chance to breathe → End on something memorable but softer ── TRACK SELECTION RULES ───────────────────────────── → Never play two same-energy tracks back to back Always vary: big → small → medium → big → Read the dancefloor — not your laptop screen → If people stop dancing: change direction immediately → Save your best track for the peak — not the beginning → A track you love but the crowd doesn't = skip it ── CROWD READING ───────────────────────────────────── Signs the crowd loves it: → Hands in the air → People singing along → More people joining the dancefloor Signs you need to change: → People walking away from the floor → Phones going up (checking time) → People talking loudly over the music Response options: → Drop to a crowd favorite they know → Change the energy — go harder or softer → Drop the bass for a moment — rebuild tension ── TRANSITIONS BETWEEN GENRES ─────────────────────── Use "bridge tracks" when switching genres: → Hip-Hop to House: use a hip-hop house edit → R&B to Afrobeats: find tracks that blend both → Never jump straight from 90 BPM to 128 BPM ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ * Record all your practice sets and listen back. Every professional DJ does this — always. ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════""", "tracks": """══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ 🎧 DJ COACH — CHAPTER 6: MAKING TRACKS FOR DJs ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ If you make your own tracks, structure them so DJs can mix them in and out easily. This also makes your tracks more likely to get played in clubs. ── ESSENTIAL TRACK STRUCTURE FOR DJs ──────────────── INTRO (16-32 bars, drums only): → No vocals, no main melody — just drums and bass → This gives the DJ time to mix in from the previous track → Fade in from silence over 4-8 bars optionally VERSE / BUILD: → Introduce elements gradually → Create anticipation for the drop DROP / CHORUS: → Full arrangement — maximum energy → This is what the crowd came for BREAKDOWN: → Strip back to pads/melody only → Perfect mix-out point for the next DJ → Creates tension before the second drop OUTRO (16-32 bars, drums only): → Mirror the intro — strip back to drums → Next DJ can mix in their track here → Fade out optionally ── EXPORT SETTINGS FOR REKORDBOX ──────────────────── Format: WAV 44.1kHz / 24-bit (minimum) BPM: Round to nearest whole number (128.0 not 127.8) Key: Tag in metadata — Rekordbox reads this Headroom: Leave -6dBFS — mixer adds its own gain Loudness: -14 to -9 LUFS — leave room for the DJ mixer ── CUE POINTS (set these in Rekordbox) ────────────── Cue 1 (yellow): Start of intro — where to load Cue 2 (green): First drop — your main moment Cue 3 (blue): Breakdown — good mix-out point Cue 4 (red): Second drop or outro start ── LOOP POINTS ─────────────────────────────────────── 8-bar loop on the drop: → DJ can extend the drop for extra energy → Gives them time to read the crowd 4-bar loop on breakdown: → Extends the tension before the drop → Creates dramatic build-up moments ── KEY AND BPM TIPS ────────────────────────────────── → Always tag your tracks with the correct key → Use Camelot notation if possible → Keep BPM consistent — no gradual BPM changes (unless intentional as an artistic choice) → If your track has two sections at different BPM: mark the BPM change with a hot cue ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ * Tracks with proper intros and outros get played more. Press H key to toggle headphone monitoring ── SETTING CUE POINTS IN MIXXX ────────────────────── Hot Cue 1: Press 1 (saves current position) Hot Cue 2: Press 2 Jump to cue: Press the same number again Set your cues at: → Start of track (cue 1) → Start of drop (cue 2) → Breakdown (cue 3) → Outro (cue 4) ── LOOP FUNCTION ───────────────────────────────────── Press R = activate 4-beat loop Press T = double loop length Press Y = halve loop length Press U = exit loop ── EFFECTS IN MIXXX ────────────────────────────────── Flanger: good for transitions and build-ups Echo: good for outros and dramatic moments Filter: high-pass sweep before drops To enable: Effects → Add Effect to chain ── RECORDING YOUR SET ──────────────────────────────── Options → Live Recording → Start Recording Format: choose WAV for best quality File saves to your Music folder automatically ALWAYS record your practice sets — listen back! ── MIXXX TIPS ──────────────────────────────────────── → Enable "Master sync" for automatic BPM matching (but learn manual first!) → Right-click waveform for zoom level → Enable "Quantize" for cue points to snap to beat → Use the library search to find tracks quickly → Sort library by BPM to find mixing pairs easily ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ * Mixxx has everything you need to learn properly. Find where phrases start and end Day 5: Load same track on both decks Try to start them at exactly the same time Listen for the "flam" when they're not aligned Day 6: Practice with two similar BPM tracks Manual tempo adjustment — NO sync button Day 7: Record a 15-minute session · Listen back Write down what went wrong — fix next week ── WEEK 2 — BEATMATCHING (Days 8-14) ──────────────── Day 8: Beatmatch practice — same track both decks Align perfectly using only tempo slider Day 9: Two different tracks, similar BPM (±2) Practice aligning on phrase boundaries Day 10: Learn the EQ controls · Cut bass on one deck Practice the bass swap with no transition yet Day 11: First complete transition attempt Track A → bass swap → Track B Record and listen back Day 12: Repeat 10 transitions — focus on phrase timing Always start transitions at bar 1 of a phrase Day 13: Learn the Camelot Wheel Tag 10 of your tracks with Camelot numbers Day 14: Mix only Camelot-compatible tracks Feel the difference vs random key mixing ── WEEK 3 — TECHNIQUE (Days 15-21) ────────────────── Day 15: Practice filter sweeps into transitions High-pass filter slowly rising before drop Day 16: Build a 30-minute set — same genre only Record it — listen for mistakes Day 17: Practice loop function Set 8-bar loop on drop, extend the energy Day 18: Add effects — echo on outro, flanger on build Keep it subtle — effects should enhance not dominate Day 19: Practice reading "imaginary crowd" If the energy was wrong — what would you play next? genre, patterns, canvas, info_lbl): """Draw the step sequencer grid on canvas.""" self.dg_genre.set(genre) data = patterns[genre] canvas.delete("all") w = canvas.winfo_width() or 900 h = canvas.winfo_height() or 400 rows = data["rows"] n_rows = len(rows) n_steps = 16 label_w = 90 cell_w = (w - label_w - 20) / n_steps cell_h = min(40, (h - 20) / n_rows) padding = 3 info_lbl.config(text=f" {genre} · BPM: {data['bpm']} · 16 steps · Copy to your DAW Step Sequencer") # Draw beat markers (1, 2, 3, 4) for beat in range(4): x = label_w + beat * 4 * cell_w canvas.create_text(x + cell_w*2, 8, text=str(beat+1), font=("Courier New",8), fill="#444", anchor="center") for row_i, (name, steps, color) in enumerate(rows): y = 20 + row_i * (cell_h + padding) # Row label canvas.create_text(label_w - 6, y + cell_h/2, text=name, font=("Courier New",9,"bold"), fill=color, anchor="e") for step_i, val in enumerate(steps): x = label_w + step_i * cell_w # Beat group dividers if step_i % 4 == 0 and step_i > 0: canvas.create_line(x, 18, x, 20 + n_rows * (cell_h + padding), fill="#333", width=1) if val == 0: # Inactive canvas.create_rectangle(x+1, y+1, x+cell_w-1, y+cell_h-1, fill="#1a1a1a", outline="#2a2a2a") elif val == 0.5: # Ghost note canvas.create_rectangle(x+1, y+1, x+cell_w-1, y+cell_h-1, fill="#3a2a1a", outline="#5a4a2a") canvas.create_text(x+cell_w/2, y+cell_h/2, text="·", font=("Courier New",12,"bold"), fill="#886040") else: # Active canvas.create_rectangle(x+1, y+1, x+cell_w-1, y+cell_h-1, fill=color, outline=color) # Step number on active canvas.create_text(x+cell_w/2, y+cell_h/2, text=str(step_i+1), font=("Courier New",7), fill="#1a1a1a") def _copy_drum_grid(self, patterns): genre = self.dg_genre.get() data = patterns[genre] out = f"STEP GRID — {genre} ({data['bpm']} BPM)\n\n" out += f"{'Instrument':<12} " + " ".join([f"{i+1:2}" for i in range(16)]) + "\n" out += "─" * 60 + "\n" for name, steps, _ in data["rows"]: row_str = " ".join(["██" if v==1 else "··" if v==0.5 else " " for v in steps]) out += f"{name:<12} {row_str}\n" out += f"\n* ██ = active ·· = ghost note (soft) spaces = inactive" self.ds_path_lbl.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(path)}", fg=FG) def _analyse_ds(self): if not self.ds_file: messagebox.showwarning("No file selected","Please choose an audio file first.") return self.ds_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing..."); self.update() try: import librosa, numpy as np from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt y, sr = librosa.load(self.ds_file, sr=None, mono=True, duration=60) # BPM tempo, _ = librosa.beat.beat_track(y=y, sr=sr) bpm = float(np.atleast_1d(tempo)[0]) if bpm > 180: bpm /= 2 if bpm < 55: bpm *= 2 # Toonsoort chroma = librosa.feature.chroma_cqt(y=y, sr=sr) key_idx= int(np.argmax(chroma.mean(axis=1))) NOTES = ["C","C#","D","Eb","E","F","F#","G","Ab","A","Bb","B"] key = NOTES[key_idx] # Energie per band def bp_rms(sig, f_lo, f_hi): nyq = sr/2; lo=f_lo/nyq; hi=min(f_hi/nyq,0.999) if lo>=hi: return 1e-9 sos = butter(4,[lo,hi],btype='band',output='sos') return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(sosfilt(sos,sig)**2))) sub_e = bp_rms(y, 20, 80) bass_e = bp_rms(y, 80, 250) mid_e = bp_rms(y, 500, 2000) hi_e = bp_rms(y, 5000, 18000) rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))) lufs = 20*np.log10(rms+1e-9) - 0.691 # Spectrale centroid voor helderheid sc = float(librosa.feature.spectral_centroid(y=y,sr=sr).mean()) # Bepaal genre/stijl if bpm >= 160: genre = "Drum & Bass / Jungle" elif bpm >= 140: genre = "Techno / Hard Dance" elif bpm >= 128: genre = filedialog.askopenfilename( filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("Alle","*.*")]) if path: if idx == 0: self.fo_file1 = path self.fo_lbl1.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(path)}", fg=FG) else: self.fo_file2 = path self.fo_lbl2.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(path)}", fg=FG) def _analyse_fo(self): if not self.fo_file1 or not self.fo_file2: messagebox.showwarning("Ontbreekt","Please choose both stems.") return self.fo_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing..."); self.update() try: import librosa, numpy as np from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt y1, sr1 = librosa.load(self.fo_file1, sr=None, mono=True, duration=30) y2, sr2 = librosa.load(self.fo_file2, sr=None, mono=True, duration=30) sr = min(sr1, sr2) def bp_rms(y, sr_, f_lo, f_hi): nyq = sr_/2; lo=max(f_lo/nyq,0.001); hi=min(f_hi/nyq,0.999) if lo >= hi: return 1e-9 sos = butter(4,[lo,hi],btype='band',output='sos') return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(sosfilt(sos,y)**2))) BANDS = [ ("Sub 20-80Hz", 20, 80), ("Bass 80-200Hz", 80, 200), ("Low-Mid 200-500Hz",200,500), ("Mid 500-2kHz", 500, 2000), ("Hi-Mid 2-5kHz",2000, 5000), ("Presence 5-8kHz",5000,8000), ("Air 8-20kHz", 8000,18000), ] overlaps = [] rms1_vals = [] rms2_vals = [] for name, f_lo, f_hi in BANDS: r1 = bp_rms(y1, sr1, f_lo, f_hi) r2 = bp_rms(y2, sr2, f_lo, f_hi) rms1_vals.append(r1) rms2_vals.append(r2) # Overlap score — hoger = meer masking overlap = min(r1,r2) / (max(r1,r2) + 1e-9) overlaps.append((name, r1, r2, overlap)) # Teken canvas self.fo_canvas.update() W = self.fo_canvas.winfo_width() or 800 H = 180; PAD_L=50; PAD_R=20; PAD_T=15; PAD_B=35 self.fo_canvas.delete("all") n = len(overlaps) bw = (W-PAD_L-PAD_R)//n - 4 max_rms = max(max(rms1_vals), max(rms2_vals)) for i,(name,r1,r2,ov) in enumerate(overlaps): x = PAD_L + i*((W-PAD_L-PAD_R)//n) h1 = int(r1/max_rms*(H-PAD_T-PAD_B)) h2 = int(r2/max_rms*(H-PAD_T-PAD_B)) bot = H-PAD_B # Stem 1 balk self.fo_canvas.create_rectangle(x+2, bot-h1, x+bw//2, bot, fill=TEAL, outline="") # Stem 2 balk self.fo_canvas.create_rectangle(x+bw//2, bot-h2, x+bw-2, bot, fill=BLUE, outline="") # Overlap indicator if ov > 0.6: col = ACCENT elif ov > 0.3: col = GOLD_LT else: col = GREEN self.fo_canvas.create_text(x+bw//2, bot+12, text=name.split(" ")[0], fill="#555555", font=("Courier New",7)) self.fo_canvas.create_text(x+bw//2, bot+24, text=f"{int(ov*100)}%", fill=col, font=("Courier New",7,"bold")) # Legenda self.fo_canvas.create_rectangle(PAD_L, PAD_T, PAD_L+10, PAD_T+8, fill=TEAL, outline="") self.fo_canvas.create_text(PAD_L+13, PAD_T+4, text=os.path.basename(self.fo_file1)[:15], fill="#555555", font=("Courier New",7), anchor="w") self.fo_canvas.create_rectangle(PAD_L+120, PAD_T, PAD_L+130, PAD_T+8, fill=BLUE, outline="") self.fo_canvas.create_text(PAD_L+133, PAD_T+4, text=os.path.basename(self.fo_file2)[:15], fill="#555555", font=("Courier New",7), anchor="w") # Tekst rapport out = "── FREQUENCY OVERLAP ANALYSE ─────────────────────────\n" out += f" Stem 1: {os.path.basename(self.fo_file1)}\n" out += f" Stem 2: {os.path.basename(self.fo_file2)}\n\n" for name, r1, r2, ov in overlaps: db1 = 20*np.log10(r1+1e-9) db2 = 20*np.log10(r2+1e-9) if ov > 0.6: status = "⚠️ MASKING — één van beide moet wijken" elif ov > 0.3: status = "💡 Overlap — let op bij luid afspelen" else: status = "✅ Weinig overlap" out += f" {name:<22} {int(ov*100):>3}% {status}\n" out += "\n── HOE TE FIXEN ──────────────────────────────────────\n" problem_bands = [(n,ov) for n,_,_,ov in overlaps if ov > 0.5] if problem_bands: for band, ov in problem_bands: out += f"\n {band} ({int(ov*100)}% overlap):\n" if "Sub" in band or "Bass" in band: out += " → High-pass on stem 2 at the bottom of this band\n" out += " → Or sidechain stem 2 to stem 1 in this band\n" out += " → Tool: FabFilter Pro-Q3 dynamic EQ\n" elif "Mid" in band: out += " → Narrow cut -3dB on the less important stem\n" out += " → Use M/S EQ — one stem to Mid, other to Side\n" out += " → Tool: FabFilter Pro-Q3 / Waves F6\n" else: out += " → High-shelf cut on the less important stem\n" out += " → Tool: SSL Channel strip / API 550\n" else: out += " ✅ No serious masking found — mix looks good!\n" self._write(self.fo_txt, out) worst = max(overlaps, key=lambda x: x[3]) self.fo_status.config( text=f"✅ Ergste overlap: {worst[0]} self.am_file_lbl.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(path)}", fg=FG) self.am_status.config(text=f"⏳ Batch {i}/{total}: analyzing {os.path.basename(path)}...") self.update() self.am_file = path self.am_last_settings = None try: self._gen_auto_master() if self.am_last_settings: self.am_status.config(text=f"⏳ Batch {i}/{total}: mastering {os.path.basename(path)}...") self.update() self._apply_auto_master() results.append((os.path.basename(path), "✅ Done")) else: results.append((os.path.basename(path), "❌ Analysis failed")) except Exception as e: results.append((os.path.basename(path), f"❌ {str(e)[:40]}")) self.am_file = original_file self.am_last_settings = original_settings if original_file: self.am_file_lbl.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(original_file)}", fg=FG) else: self.am_file_lbl.config(text="No track selected", fg=FG2) ok_count = sum(1 for _, s in results if s.startswith("✅")) self.am_status.config(text=f"✅ Batch complete: {ok_count}/{total} tracks mastered — saved next to each original") summary = "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" summary += f" 📦 BATCH MASTER — {ok_count}/{total} SUCCESSFUL\n" summary += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n" for name, status in results: summary += f" {status:<20} {name}\n" summary += "\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" summary += " * Each mastered file is saved next to its original,\n" summary += " named '_auto_mastered.wav'\n" summary += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" self._write(self.mc_txt, summary) # ── SYSTEM EMULATION (Club / Car / Phone / Earbuds / Laptop) ── SYSTEM_PROFILES = { "🏟 Club System": { "color": "#e8323e", "bands": {"sub": 2.2, "bass": 1.7, "lowmid": 0.9, "mid": 1.0, "highmid": 1.15, "high": 1.2}, "desc": "Huge sub + bass, slightly scooped mids, crisp top — how it hits on a real club rig", }, "🚗 Car Speakers": { "color": "#40a0e8", "bands": {"sub": 0.35, "bass": 1.6, "lowmid": 1.25, "mid": 1.1, "highmid": 1.0, "high": 0.85}, "desc": "True sub-bass barely reproduced, boosted low-mid 'boom', warm mids, softer highs", }, "📱 Phone Speaker": { "color": "#40c880", "bands": {"sub": 0.02, "bass": 0.15, "lowmid": 0.6, "mid": 1.7, "highmid": 1.5, "high": 0.7}, "desc": "Almost no bass at all, heavy honky mid boost (tiny driver), rolled-off highs", }, "🎧 Earbuds": { "color": "#c070e8", "bands": {"sub": 0.9, "bass": 1.3, "lowmid": 1.0, "mid": 1.0, "highmid": 1.05, "high": 1.1}, "desc": "Decent full range with a warm bass boost — close to the ear, forgiving highs", }, "💻 Laptop Speakers": { "color": "#e8a030", "bands": {"sub": 0.05, "bass": 0.3, "lowmid": 0.8, "mid": 1.5, "highmid": 1.3, "high": 0.75}, "desc": "Thin and mid-forward, almost no low end, slightly better than a phone", }, } def _show_system_emulation(self, preset_file=None): """Preview how a track translates on different real-world playback systems.""" win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("🔊 System Emulation — MCS") win.geometry("760x620") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = bg="#e8323e", height=1).pack(fill="x") ctrl = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=12) ctrl.pack(fill="x", padx=16, pady=(10,0)) ctrl.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.se_file = preset_file init_text = f" {os.path.basename(preset_file)}" if preset_file else "No track selected" init_fg = FG if preset_file else FG2 self.se_file_lbl = tk.Label(ctrl, text=init_text, font=F_LABEL, fg=init_fg, bg=BG3, padx=12, pady=7, anchor="w") self.se_file_lbl.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=(0,8)) self._btn(ctrl, "📂 Choose track", BG4, BTN_FG, self._pick_system_emulation_file).grid(row=0, column=1) prof_f = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, padx=16, pady=12); prof_f.pack(fill="x") tk.Label(prof_f, text="PLAYBACK SYSTEM:", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG).pack(anchor="w", pady=(0,6)) self.se_profile = tk.StringVar(value=list(self.SYSTEM_PROFILES.keys())[0]) btn_row = tk.Frame(prof_f, bg=BG); btn_row.pack(fill="x") for name, data in self.SYSTEM_PROFILES.items(): _MacBtn(btn_row, text=name, font=("Courier New",9,"bold"), bg=BG3, fg=data["color"], relief="flat", cursor="hand2", padx=8, pady=6, command=lambda n=name: self._sel_system_profile(n) ).pack(side="left", padx=(0,4), pady=2) self.se_desc = tk.Label(win, text=self.SYSTEM_PROFILES[self.se_profile.get()]["desc"], font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG2, bg=BG, wraplength=700, justify="left") self.se_desc.pack(fill="x", padx=16, pady=(0,10)) # Original vs Emulated toggle toggle_f = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, padx=16); toggle_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(4,4)) self.se_mode = tk.StringVar(value="emulated") for label, val, color in [("▶ Play Original", "original", FG2), ("▶ Play Emulated", "emulated", "#e8323e")]: tk.Radiobutton(toggle_f, text=label, variable=self.se_mode, value=val, font=("Courier New",9,"bold"), fg=color, bg=BG, selectcolor=BG3, activebackground=BG, cursor="hand2" ).pack(side="left", padx=(0,16)) br = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, padx=16, pady=10); br.pack(fill="x") self._btn(br, "▶ Preview", TEAL, "#090909", Emulated WAV", "#e8323e", "white", self._export_system_emulation).pack(side="left", ipady=2) self.se_status = tk.Label(win, text="", font=F_LABEL, fg="#e8323e", bg=BG) self.se_status.pack(anchor="w", padx=16, pady=(4,0)) note = tk.Label(win, text="* EQ-based emulation of typical frequency response per system — not a\n" " literal recording through real speakers, but a close practical approximation.", font=("Courier New",8), fg=FG3, bg=BG, justify="left") note.pack(anchor="w", padx=16, pady=(14,0)) def _sel_system_profile(self, name): self.se_profile.set(name) self.se_desc.config(text=self.SYSTEM_PROFILES[name]["desc"]) def _pick_system_emulation_file(self): win = self.se_file_lbl.winfo_toplevel() path = filedialog.askopenfilename( parent=win, title="Choose track", filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("All","*.*")]) if path: win.destroy() self._show_system_emulation(preset_file=path) def _process_system_emulation(self, out_path): """Runs the actual multiband EQ processing for the selected profile.""" import numpy as np import soundfile as sf from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt profile = self.SYSTEM_PROFILES[self.se_profile.get()]["bands"] y, sr = sf.read(self.se_file, always_2d=True) y = y.T # (channels, samples) nyq = sr / 2 # Frequency band edges (Hz) edges = {"sub": (20, 60), "bass": (60, 150), "lowmid": (150, 500), "mid": (500, 2000), "highmid": (2000, 6000), "high": (6000, min(20000, nyq*0.99))} def band_isolate(signal, low, high): out = signal.copy() if low > 20: sos = butter(2, min(low/nyq, 0.99), btype="high", output="sos") out = sosfilt(sos, out) if high < nyq: sos = butter(2, min(high/nyq, 0.99), btype="low", output="sos") out = sosfilt(sos, out) return out processed = np.zeros_like(y) for ch in range(y.shape[0]): sig = y[ch] mixed = np.zeros_like(sig) for band_name, (low, high) in edges.items(): gain = profile[band_name] mixed += band_isolate(sig, low, high) * gain processed[ch] = mixed # Prevent clipping — normalize down if needed, small safety headroom peak = np.max(np.abs(processed)) if peak > 0.98: processed = processed * (0.98 / peak) sf.write(out_path, processed.T, sr) def _preview_system_emulation(self): if not self.se_file: messagebox.showwarning("No track", "Please choose a track first.") return self.se_status.config(text="⏳ Processing preview..."); self.update() import sys, subprocess, tempfile try: import numpy as np, soundfile as sf from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt except ImportError: try: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "numpy", "soundfile", "scipy", "--quiet"]) except Exception as e: self.se_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:60]}") return try: subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) if self.se_mode.get() == "original": play_path = self.se_file else: tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) self._process_system_emulation(tmp.name) play_path = tmp.name subprocess.Popen(["afplay", play_path], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL) label = "Original" if self.se_mode.get() == "original" else self.se_profile.get() self.se_status.config(text=f"▶ Playing: {label}") except Exception as e: self.se_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") def _stop_system_emulation(self): import subprocess subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) self.se_status.config(text="⏹ Stopped") def _export_system_emulation(self): if not self.se_file: messagebox.showwarning("No track", "Please choose a track first.") return self.se_status.config(text="⏳ Exporting..."); self.update() try: base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.se_file))[0] profile_tag = self.se_profile.get().split(" ",1)[1].replace(" ","_").lower() out_dir = os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop") out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{base}_{profile_tag}.wav") self._process_system_emulation(out_path) self.se_status.config(text=f"✅ Saved: {out_path}") except Exception as e: self.se_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") # ── PITCH SHIFTER tk.Label(semi_f, text="SEMITONES:", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG).pack(anchor="w", pady=(0,8)) row = tk.Frame(semi_f, bg=BG); row.pack(fill="x") self.ps_semitones = tk.IntVar(value=0) self._btn(row, "−1", BG3, "#40c880", lambda: self._nudge_pitch_shift(-1)).pack(side="left", padx=(0,4)) self._btn(row, "−12 (oct)", BG3, "#40c880", lambda: self._nudge_pitch_shift(-12)).pack(side="left", self._nudge_pitch_shift(v, reset=True) ).pack(side="left", padx=(0,4)) br = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, padx=16, pady=10); br.pack(fill="x") self._btn(br, "▶ Preview", TEAL, "#090909", self._preview_pitch_shift).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=2) self._btn(br, "⏹ Stop", BG4, BTN_FG, self._stop_pitch_shift).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=2) self._btn(br, "💾 Export", "#40c880", "#090909", self._export_pitch_shift).pack(side="left", padx=(0,12), ipady=2) # Format choice tk.Label(br, text="FORMAT:", font=("Courier New",8), fg=FG2, bg=BG).pack(side="left", padx=(0,6)) self.ps_format = tk.StringVar(value="WAV") self.ps_fmt_btns = {} for fmt_val in ["WAV", "MP3"]: b = tk.Label(br, text=fmt_val, font=F_BTN, bg=TEAL if fmt_val=="WAV" else BG3, fg="#090909" if fmt_val=="WAV" else "#e870c8", cursor="hand2", padx=14, pady=8, bd=0, highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=BORDER) b.bind("", lambda e, v=fmt_val: self._set_ps_format(v)) b.pack(side="left", padx=(0,4)) self.ps_fmt_btns[fmt_val] = b self.ps_status = tk.Label(win, text="", font=F_LABEL, fg="#40c880", bg=BG) self.ps_status.pack(anchor="w", padx=16, pady=(4,0)) note = tk.Label(win, text="* Natural speed: pitch + tempo shift together (like a turntable) —\n" " usually sounds most natural, especially for bigger shifts.\n" "* Preserve tempo: only the pitch changes, duration stays fixed —\n" " can sound slightly artificial on large shifts (8+ semitones).", font=("Courier New",8), fg=FG3, bg=BG, justify="left") note.pack(anchor="w", padx=16, pady=(14,0)) self._update_pitch_shift_bpm() def _nudge_pitch_shift(self, amount, reset=False): if reset: self.ps_semitones.set(amount) else: self.ps_semitones.set(self.ps_semitones.get() + amount) val = self.ps_semitones.get() sign = "+" if val > 0 else "" self.ps_semi_lbl.config(text=f"{sign}{val} st") self._update_pitch_shift_bpm() def _update_pitch_shift_bpm(self): """Live-calculate the resulting BPM after a Natural Speed shift, so you're never left guessing what tempo you ended up with.""" if not hasattr(self, "ps_new_bpm_lbl"): return try: orig_bpm = float(self.ps_original_bpm.get()) except (ValueError, AttributeError): self.ps_new_bpm_lbl.config(text="—") return if self.ps_mode.get() == "preserve": # Tempo-locked mode — BPM never changes, regardless of pitch self.ps_new_bpm_lbl.config(text=f"{orig_bpm:.1f} (unchanged)", fg=FG2) else: semitones = self.ps_semitones.get() rate = 2 ** (semitones / 12) new_bpm = orig_bpm * rate self.ps_new_bpm_lbl.config(text=f"{new_bpm:.1f}", fg="#40c880") def _pick_pitch_shifter_file(self): win = self.ps_file_lbl.winfo_toplevel() current_bpm = self.ps_original_bpm.get() if hasattr(self, "ps_original_bpm") else "120" path = filedialog.askopenfilename( parent=win, title="Choose track", filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("All","*.*")]) if path: # Close this window and open a completely fresh one with the # file pre-filled — works around a macOS/Tk bug where the # window is left blank after a native file dialog closes win.destroy() self._show_pitch_shifter(preset_file=path, preset_bpm=current_bpm) def _process_pitch_shift(self, out_path): import librosa import numpy as np import soundfile as sf semitones = self.ps_semitones.get() y, sr = librosa.load(self.ps_file, sr=None, mono=False) if self.ps_mode.get() == "linked": # Natural speed change — pitch AND tempo shift together, # like speeding up/slowing down a record. Resample the # audio, then write it back out at the ORIGINAL sample # rate so playback compresses/stretches in time too. rate = 2 ** (semitones / 12) target_sr = sr / rate if y.ndim == 1: shifted = librosa.resample(y, orig_sr=sr, target_sr=target_sr) else: shifted = np.array([librosa.resample(ch, orig_sr=sr, target_sr=target_sr) for ch in y]) sf.write(out_path, shifted.T if shifted.ndim > 1 else shifted, sr) else: # Preserve tempo — time-stretched pitch shift, duration stays the same if y.ndim == 1: shifted = librosa.effects.pitch_shift(y, sr=sr, n_steps=semitones) else: shifted = np.array([librosa.effects.pitch_shift(ch, sr=sr, n_steps=semitones) for ch in y]) sf.write(out_path, shifted.T if shifted.ndim > 1 else shifted, sr) def _preview_pitch_shift(self): if not self.ps_file: messagebox.showwarning("No track", "Please choose a track first.") return self.ps_status.config(text="⏳ Processing preview (can take a moment)..."); self.update() import sys, subprocess, tempfile try: import librosa, numpy as np, soundfile as sf except ImportError: try: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "librosa", "numpy", "soundfile", "--quiet"]) except Exception as e: self.ps_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:60]}") return try: subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) if self.ps_semitones.get() == 0: play_path = self.ps_file else: tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) self._process_pitch_shift(tmp.name) play_path = tmp.name subprocess.Popen(["afplay", play_path], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL) self.ps_status.config(text=f"▶ Playing at {self.ps_semi_lbl.cget('text')}") except Exception as e: self.ps_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") def _stop_pitch_shift(self): import subprocess subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) self.ps_status.config(text="⏹ Stopped") def _set_ps_format(self, val): self.ps_format.set(val) for k, b in self.ps_fmt_btns.items(): is_active = (k == val) b.config(bg=TEAL if is_active else BG3, fg="#090909" if is_active else "#e870c8") def _export_pitch_shift(self): if not self.ps_file: messagebox.showwarning("No track", "Please choose a track first.") return self.ps_status.config(text="⏳ Exporting (can take a moment)..."); self.update() try: base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.ps_file))[0] val = self.ps_semitones.get() tag = f"{'+' if val>0 else ''}{val}st" out_dir = os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop") # Format choice fmt = getattr(self, 'ps_format', None) fmt = fmt.get() if fmt else "WAV" if fmt == "MP3": tmp_wav = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{base}_{tag}_tmp.wav") out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{base}_{tag}.mp3") self._process_pitch_shift(tmp_wav) ffmpeg = "/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg" if os.path.exists("/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg") else "ffmpeg" import subprocess subprocess.run([ffmpeg, "-y", "-i", tmp_wav, "-b:a", "320k", out_path], capture_output=True) try: os.remove(tmp_wav) except: pass else: out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{base}_{tag}.wav") self._process_pitch_shift(out_path) self.ps_status.config(text=f"✅ Saved: {out_path}") except Exception as e: self.ps_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") # ── TRACK DOCTOR — one-click diagnostic report ────────── def _show_track_doctor(self, preset_file=None): """Runs peak, loudness, mono-compatibility, frequency balance and clipping checks in one go and gives a clear report card.""" win = tk.Toplevel(self) clipping ── peak = float(np.max(np.abs(y))) peak_db = 20*np.log10(peak) if peak > 0 else -99 clipped_samples = int(np.sum(np.abs(y) >= 0.999)) total_samples = y.size clip_pct = clipped_samples / np.std(left) > 0 and np.std(right) > 0: correlation = float(np.corrcoef(left, right)[0,1]) else: correlation = 1.0 # ── Frequency balance ── mono_sig = (left + right) / 2 S = np.abs(librosa.stft(mono_sig, n_fft=4096)) freqs = librosa.fft_frequencies(sr=sr, n_fft=4096) total_energy = np.sum(S) + 1e-9 def band_pct(lo, hi): mask = (freqs >= lo) & (freqs < hi) return MONO COMPATIBILITY ─────────────────────────────") lines.append(f" L/R correlation: {correlation:.2f} (1.0 = perfectly mono-compatible)") if correlation > 0.92: lines.append(" ⚠️ VERY NARROW — near-mono, little stereo width") lines.append(" → Fix: Stereo Widener tool, move the slider RIGHT (positive %)") lines.append(" to add some width, if that suits the track.") elif correlation > 0.5: lines.append(" ✅ GOOD — translates well to mono systems (phones, some club systems)") elif correlation > 0.0: lines.append(" ⚠️ WIDE — some elements may thin out or partially cancel in mono") lines.append(" → Fix: Stereo Widener tool, move the slider LEFT (negative %)") lines.append(" to pull it back toward the safe zone.") else: lines.append(" ❌ RISKY — significant phase cancellation in mono, check wide stereo elements") lines.append(" → Fix: Stereo Widener tool, move the slider LEFT (negative %,") lines.append(" try -30 to -50%) to narrow it back to a safer width.") lines.append("") lines.append("── 5. if that's not") lines.append(" your genre, may sound muddy on smaller speakers") balance_flagged = True elif high_pct > 35: lines.append(" ⚠️ BRIGHT — may sound harsh on bright playback systems") balance_flagged = True elif mid_pct < 30: lines.append(" ⚠️ SCOOPED MIDS — vocals/leads may lack presence") balance_flagged = True else: lines.append(" ✅ GOOD — reasonably balanced across the spectrum") balance_flagged = False lines.append("") # ── Overall score ── checks = [peak_ok, clip_pct < 0.01, -20 <= rms_db <= -8, correlation > 0.0, not balance_flagged] score = sum(checks) lines.append("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════") lines.append(f" OVERALL: {score}/5 checks passed") if score == 5: lines.append(" 🎉 Excellent — this track is in great shape") elif score >= 3: lines.append(" 👍 Solid — a few things worth double-checking above") else: lines.append(" 🔧 Needs attention — review the ❌/⚠️ items above before releasing") lines.append("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════") self._write(self.td_txt, "\n".join(lines)) except Exception as e: self._write(self.td_txt, f"❌ Error running diagnosis: {e}") # ── SAMPLE RANDOMIZER — layer your own sounds, generate huge variety ── SR_LAYER_NAMES = ["Kick", "Snare / Clap", "Hi-Hat / Perc", "Bass / Sub", "Texture / Pad", "FX / Riser"] def _show_sample_randomizer(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("🎲 Sample Randomizer — MCS") win.geometry("820x760") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); _sr_generate_combo(self): import sys, subprocess, tempfile, random, os as _os try: import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf except ImportError: try: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "numpy", "librosa", "soundfile", "--quiet"]) import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf except Exception as e: self.sr_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") return active = [(name, l) for name, l in self.sr_layers.items() if l["enabled_var"].get() and l["files"]] if not active: self.sr_status.config(text="⚠️ Load at least one sample in an enabled layer first.") return self.sr_status.config(text="⏳ Generating..."); self.update() sr_target = 44100 max_len = int(sr_target * 4.0) # Try a few times to avoid landing on a combo you've already exported MAX_TRIES = 15 picks = None for attempt in range(MAX_TRIES): candidate = [] for name, layer in active: path = random.choice(layer["files"]) pitch_range = layer["pitch_var"].get() semitones = round(random.uniform(-pitch_range, pitch_range), 1) if pitch_range > 0 else 0.0 vol_range = layer["vol_var"].get() gain_db = round(random.uniform(-vol_range, 0), 1) if vol_range > 0 else 0.0 pan = round(random.uniform(-1, 1), 2) candidate.append((name, path, semitones, gain_db, pan)) signature = tuple(candidate) if signature not in self.sr_exported_signatures: picks = candidate break if picks is None: # Every attempt matched something already exported — proceed anyway, # this only happens once you've exported nearly every combo available picks = candidate self.sr_status.config(text="⚠️ Ran out of fresh combos to try — this one may repeat an export.") mix = np.zeros((2, max_len)) used = [] try: for name, path, semitones, gain_db, pan in picks: y, _sr = librosa.load(path, sr=sr_target, mono=True) if abs(semitones) > 0.05: y = librosa.effects.pitch_shift(y, sr=sr_target, n_steps=semitones) y = y * (10 ** (gain_db / 20)) angle = (pan + 1) * (np.pi / 4) left_gain, right_gain = np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle) n = min(len(y), max_len) mix[0, :n] += y[:n] * left_gain mix[1, :n] += y[:n] * right_gain used.append(f"{name}: {_os.path.basename(path)} ({gain_db:.1f}dB, pan {pan:+.2f})") peak = np.max(np.abs(mix)) if peak > 0.99: mix = mix * (0.95 / peak) out_path = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False).name sf.write(out_path, mix.T, sr_target) self.sr_last_output = out_path self.sr_last_signature = tuple(picks) subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) subprocess.Popen(["afplay", out_path], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL) already = tuple(picks) in self.sr_exported_signatures tag = " (⚠️ already exported before)" if already else "" self.sr_status.config(text="🎲 " + " · ".join(used) + tag) except Exception as e: self.sr_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:100]}") def _sr_play_last(self): import subprocess if not self.sr_last_output: self.sr_status.config(text="⚠️ Generate a combo first.") return subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) subprocess.Popen(["afplay", self.sr_last_output], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL) def _sr_stop(self): import subprocess subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) self.sr_status.config(text="⏹ Stopped") def _sr_export_last(self): import os as _os, datetime as _dt if not self.sr_last_output: self.sr_status.config(text="⚠️ Generate a combo first.") return default_name = f"MCS_combo_{len(self.sr_export_log)+1:03d}.wav" dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav")], initialfile=default_name) if not dest: return import shutil shutil.copy(self.sr_last_output, dest) if self.sr_last_signature is not None: self.sr_exported_signatures.add(self.sr_last_signature) stamp = _dt.datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S") entry = f"[{stamp}] {_os.path.basename(dest)}" self.sr_export_log.append(entry) self.sr_log_list.insert("end", entry) self.sr_log_list.see("end") self.sr_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved to {dest}") # ── SPECIAL EQ — analyzes a track's frequency balance and suggests a # starting EQ curve: broad band imbalances plus narrow resonant peaks # worth cutting. A starting point for your own ears, not a final answer. HT_EQ_BANDS = [ (20, 80, "Sub"), (80, 250, "Low"), (250, 500, "Low-Mid"), (500, 1000, "Mid"), (1000, 2500, "Upper-Mid"), (2500, 5000, "Presence"), (5000, 10000, "Brilliance"), (10000, 20000, "Air"), ] # ── MCS PULSE — groove intelligence. Analyzes the beat grid and # lets you shift the micro-timing of off-beat elements (hats, # percussion) while the kick/downbeat stays perfectly tight — not # simple swing, a controllable "pull or push" on just the off-grid # elements. Especially strong for house/afro-style grooves. ── # ── MCS SHADOW — derives a subtle "ghost layer" from the original # sound itself: a delayed, filtered, softened echo mixed in at low # level. You don't consciously hear a second layer — but turn it off # and something feels missing. Works on drums, vocals, synths. ── # ── MCS SPACE — not just reverb. Pick a spatial POSITION (Front, # Behind, Wide, Distant, Huge) and the plugin translates that into # concrete pre-delay, early reflections, filtering, stereo width, # and transient reduction — placing a sound somewhere, rather than # dialing in a raw reverb percentage. ── SPACE_POSITIONS = { "Front": {"pre_delay_ms": 5, "decay_s": 0.8, "mix": 0.15, "lowpass_hz": 12000, "width": 0.4, "transient_reduction": 0.0}, "Behind": {"pre_delay_ms": 25, "decay_s": 1.8, "mix": 0.35, "lowpass_hz": 5000, "width": 0.6, "transient_reduction": 0.25}, "Wide": {"pre_delay_ms": 15, "decay_s": 1.5, "mix": 0.30, "lowpass_hz": 8000, "width": 0.9, "transient_reduction": 0.10}, "Distant": {"pre_delay_ms": 45, "decay_s": 3.0, "mix": 0.55, "lowpass_hz": 3000, "width": 0.7, "transient_reduction": 0.45}, "Huge": {"pre_delay_ms": 35, "decay_s": 4.5, "mix": 0.45, "lowpass_hz": 6000, "width": 0.95, "transient_reduction": 0.15}, } # ── MCS DROP — pure drop-impact plugin. Automatically combines # pre-drop frequency thinning, micro-silence, stereo contraction → # expansion, and psychoacoustic (peak-safe) loudness — makes a drop # feel bigger without simply making it louder. ── def _show_mcs_drop(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("💥 MCS Drop — Impact Without Just Louder") win.geometry("620x560") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); pick_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(6,0)) self.drop_file_lbl = tk.Label(pick_row, text="No track selected", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG2) self.drop_file_lbl.pack(side="left") self._btn(pick_row, "📂 Choose Track", BG4, BTN_FG, self._drop_pick_file).pack(side="right") self.drop_file = None settings_f = tk.Frame(body, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=12); settings_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) row1 = tk.Frame(settings_f, bg=BG2); row1.pack(fill="x") tk.Label(row1, text="DROP TIME (seconds):", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8)) self.drop_time = tk.StringVar(value="30.0") tk.Entry(row1, textvariable=self.drop_time, width=8, font=("Courier New",10,"bold"), bg=BG3, fg="#e85050", justify="center").pack(side="left", padx=(0,16)) tk.Label(row1, text="PRE-DROP WINDOW:", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8)) self.drop_window = tk.StringVar(value="2.0") tk.Entry(row1, textvariable=self.drop_window, width=6, font=("Courier New",10,"bold"), bg=BG3, fg="#e85050", justify="center").pack(side="left") tk.Label(row1, text="sec", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(side="left", padx=(4,0)) tk.Label(settings_f, text="DROP TIME = the exact moment the drop hits · PRE-DROP WINDOW =\n" "how many seconds before that get thinned/narrowed/silenced", font=("Courier New",8), fg=FG3, bg=BG2, justify="left").pack(anchor="w", pady=(8,0)) intensity_f = tk.Frame(body, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=14);
