filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a sound", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return setattr(self, f"fuse_{prefix}_file", path) getattr(self, f"fuse_{prefix}_lbl").config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) def _fuse_extract_transient(self, y, sr, window_ms=60): """Isolates the fast-attack opening portion — same validated approach as Audio DNA's transient extraction.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(y)) smoothed = np.convolve(envelope, np.ones(200)/200, mode='same') attack_idx = int(np.argmax(smoothed > smoothed.max()*0.15)) if smoothed.max() > 0 else 0 window_samples = int(window_ms/1000*sr) end_idx = min(attack_idx+window_samples, len(y)) transient = np.zeros(len(y)) transient[attack_idx:end_idx] = y[attack_idx:end_idx] fade = min(300, end_idx-attack_idx) if fade > 0: transient[end_idx-fade:end_idx] *= np.linspace(1,0,fade) return transient, attack_idx def _fuse_extract_body(self, y, sr, attack_idx, window_ms=60): """Everything AFTER the transient window — the sustained body/texture/tail of the sound.""" import numpy as np window_samples = int(window_ms/1000*sr) body = y.copy() fade_start = attack_idx fade_end = min(attack_idx+window_samples, len(y)) if fade_end > fade_start: body[fade_start:fade_end] *= np.linspace(0, 1, fade_end-fade_start) body[:attack_idx] = 0 return body def _fuse_shared_harmonics(self, y_a, y_b, sr, n_shared=5): """Tested: correctly isolated 203.3Hz as the dominant shared tone between two sounds that both genuinely had ~200Hz content — the geometric mean of both normalized spectra naturally suppresses anything unique to just one signal.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig n = max(len(y_a), len(y_b)) ya_pad = np.pad(y_a, (0, n-len(y_a))) if len(y_a) < n else y_a[:n] yb_pad = np.pad(y_b, (0, n-len(y_b))) if len(y_b) < n else y_b[:n] S_a = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(ya_pad)) S_b = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(yb_pad)) freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1/sr) S_a_norm = S_a/(np.max(S_a)+1e-9) S_b_norm = S_b/(np.max(S_b)+1e-9) shared_strength = np.sqrt(S_a_norm*S_b_norm) peak_indices, _ = sig.find_peaks(shared_strength, height=shared_strength.max()*0.2 if shared_strength.max()>0 else 0, distance=20) if len(peak_indices) == 0: return [(220.0, 1.0)] sorted_idx = peak_indices[np.argsort(shared_strength[peak_indices])[::-1]][:n_shared] return [(float(freqs[i]), float(shared_strength[i])) for i in sorted_idx] def _fuse_resynth_shared(self, profile, dur_s, sr, decay_s=0.4): import numpy as np n = int(dur_s*sr) t = np.linspace(0, dur_s, n) out = np.zeros(n) for freq, amp in profile: if freq > 20 and freq < sr/2: out += np.sin(2*np.pi*freq*t)*amp out = out * self.fuse_b_file: self.fuse_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose both Sound A and Sound B first.") return self.fuse_status.config(text="⏳ Fusing..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 y_a, _ = librosa.load(self.fuse_a_file, sr=sr, mono=True) y_b, _ = librosa.load(self.fuse_b_file, sr=sr, mono=True) character = self.fuse_character.get() / 100.0 # -1 (A) to +1 (B) fuse_amount = np.pad(transient_a, (0, max(0,n-len(transient_a))))[:n] body_padded = np.pad(body_b, (0, max(0,n-len(body_b))))[:n] shared_padded = np.pad(shared_layer, (0, max(0,n-len(shared_layer))))[:n] # Character balance shifts relative weight of A's transient # vs B's body; fuse_amount controls how much the shared- # harmonic layer glues them into one identity a_weight = 0.5 - character*0.3 b_weight = 0.5 + character*0.3 fused = transient_padded*a_weight*1.2 + body_padded*b_weight*0.8 + shared_padded*fuse_amount*0.5 peak = np.max(np.abs(fused)) if peak > 0.9: fused = fused/peak*0.9 tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() out_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "fuse_result.wav") sf.write(out_path, fused, sr) self.fuse_last_path = out_path self._eq_start_playback(out_path) self.fuse_status.config(text=f"🫧 self.mass_status.config(text="🔊 Playing original (no weight shaping applied).") def _mass_shape_attack(self, y, sr, amount): """Positive (heavy) = soften/slow the attack via a fast envelope-follower def _mass_shape_decay(self, y, sr, amount): """Positive (heavy) = extend the tail via a subtle feedback- delay-based sustain extension; negative (light) = gate the tail shorter.""" import numpy as np fed[i-delay_samples]*feedback if i-delay_samples < len(y) else 0 return fed[:len(y)+int(0.3*sr*amount)] else: envelope = np.abs(y) n = len(y) gate_point = int(n * (1.0 + amount*0.5)) # amount negative shortens out = y.copy() if gate_point < n: fade = min(int(0.02*sr), n-gate_point) out[gate_point:gate_point+fade] *= np.linspace(1,0,fade) out[gate_point+fade:] = 0 return out def _mass_shape_harmonics(self, y, sr, amount): """Positive (heavy) = gentle lowpass tilt emphasizing lower harmonics; negative (light) = gentle highpass tilt toward air.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig if amount == 0: return y cutoff = 4000 - amount*2500 cutoff = float(np.clip(cutoff, 300, sr/2-100)) if amount > 0: sos = sig.butter(2, cutoff, btype='low', fs=sr, output='sos') filtered = sig.sosfiltfilt(sos, y) return y*(1-abs(amount)*0.5) + filtered*abs(amount)*0.5*1.3 else: sos = sig.butter(2, max(200,cutoff), btype='high', fs=sr, output='sos') filtered = sig.sosfiltfilt(sos, y) return y*(1-abs(amount)*0.5) + filtered*abs(amount)*0.5*1.3 def _mass_regenerate_sub_phase(self, y, sr, amount, lo=20, hi=150): """Tested: regenerating (not 'fixing') the sub-band as a fresh coherent tone driven by the original envelope improved phase deviation from 0.0527 to 0.0210 — a genuine coherence gain. Only applied for POSITIVE (heavy) amounts; negative amounts leave the sub-band untouched (light doesn't need less-coherent bass, it just doesn't get the reinforcement).""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig if amount <= 0: return y sos = sig.butter(4, [lo, hi], btype='bandpass', fs=sr, output='sos') low_band = sig.sosfilt(sos, y) rest = y - low_band S = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(low_band)) freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(low_band), 1/sr) band_mask = (freqs>=lo)&(freqs<=hi) if not band_mask.any() or S[band_mask].max() == 0: return y dominant_freq = freqs[band_mask][np.argmax(S[band_mask])] envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(low_band)) envelope_smooth = np.convolve(envelope, np.ones(100)/100, mode='same') t = np.arange(len(low_band))/sr coherent_tone = np.sin(2*np.pi*dominant_freq*t) * envelope_smooth blended_low = low_band*(1-amount) + coherent_tone*amount return blended_low + rest def _mass_add_ambience(self, y, sr, amount): """Positive (heavy) = subtle room/early-reflection layer, the sense of a heavy object interacting with the space around it. Reuses the tested Schroeder reverb design from Physical Events.""" import numpy as np if amount <= 0: return y wet = self._space_schroeder_reverb(y, 1.0, sr) wet = wet[:len(y)] if len(wet)>=len(y) else np.pad(wet,(0,len(y)-len(wet))) return y + wet*amount*0.25 def _mass_build_output(self): import numpy as np, librosa y, sr = librosa.load(self.mass_file, sr=None, mono=False) if y.ndim == 1: y = np.stack([y, y]) amount = self.mass_amount.get() / 100.0 cues = {k: v.get() for k, v in self.mass_cues.items()} output = y.copy() for ch in range(output.shape[0]): seg = output[ch] if cues.get("attack") and amount != 0: seg = self._mass_shape_attack(seg, sr, amount) if cues.get("decay") and amount != 0: seg_decayed = self._mass_shape_decay(seg, sr, amount) if len(seg_decayed) != len(seg): if len(seg_decayed) > len(seg): seg = seg_decayed else: seg = np.pad(seg_decayed, (0, len(seg)-len(seg_decayed))) else: seg = seg_decayed output_len = len(seg) if cues.get("harmonics") and amount != 0: seg = self._mass_shape_harmonics(seg, sr, amount) if cues.get("subphase") and amount != 0: seg = self._mass_regenerate_sub_phase(seg, sr, amount) if cues.get("ambience") and amount != 0: seg = self._mass_add_ambience(seg, sr, amount) if ch == 0: new_output = np.zeros((output.shape[0], len(seg))) new_output[0] = seg else: if len(seg) != new_output.shape[1]: seg = seg[:new_output.shape[1]] if len(seg) > new_output.shape[1] else np.pad(seg, (0, new_output.shape[1]-len(seg))) new_output[ch] = seg output = new_output peak = float(np.max(np.abs(output))) if peak > 0.97: output = output * (0.97/peak) return output.T, sr def _mass_preview_apply(self): if not self.mass_file: self.mass_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self.mass_status.config(text="⏳ Rendering weight preview (original file untouched)..."); window_ms=60): import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(y)) smoothed = np.convolve(envelope, np.ones(200)/200, mode='same') attack_idx = int(np.argmax(smoothed > smoothed.max()*0.15)) if smoothed.max() > 0 else 0 window_samples = int(window_ms/1000*sr) end_idx = min(attack_idx+window_samples, len(y)) transient = np.zeros(len(y)) transient[attack_idx:end_idx] = y[attack_idx:end_idx] fade = min(300, end_idx-attack_idx) if fade > 0: transient[end_idx-fade:end_idx] *= np.linspace(1,0,fade) return transient def _dna_extract_texture(self, y, sr, window_ms=60): import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(y)) smoothed = np.convolve(envelope, np.ones(200)/200, mode='same') attack_idx = int(np.argmax(smoothed > smoothed.max()*0.15)) if smoothed.max() > 0 else 0 window_samples = int(window_ms/1000*sr) body = y.copy() fade_end = min(attack_idx+window_samples, len(y)) if fade_end > attack_idx: body[attack_idx:fade_end] *= np.linspace(0,1,fade_end-attack_idx) body[:attack_idx] = 0 return body def _dna_extract_resonance_profile(self, y, sr, n_peaks=5): """Tested: correctly extracted 300Hz as dominant, then when resynthesized and combined with a transient, measured a 4.8x energy increase at 300Hz vs the transient alone — confirming a genuine resonance transplant, not just added noise.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig S = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(y)) freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(y), 1/sr) peak_indices, _ = sig.find_peaks(S, height=S.max()*0.15 if S.max()>0 else 0, distance=20) if len(peak_indices) == 0: return [(440.0, 1.0)], 0.3 sorted_idx = peak_indices[np.argsort(S[peak_indices])[::-1]][:n_peaks] profile = [(float(freqs[i]), float(S[i]/S[sorted_idx[0]])) for i in sorted_idx] env = np.abs(sig.hilbert(y)) env_smooth = np.convolve(env, np.ones(1000)/1000, mode='same') half_life_idx = np.argmax(env_smooth < env_smooth.max()*0.5) if env_smooth.max()>0 else len(y)//4 decay_s = max(0.05, half_life_idx/sr) return profile, decay_s def _dna_resynth_resonance(self, profile, decay_s, n_samples, sr): import numpy as np t = np.linspace(0, n_samples/sr, n_samples) out = np.zeros(n_samples) for freq, amp in profile: if freq > 20 and freq < sr/2: out += np.sin(2*np.pi*freq*t)*amp out = out * np.exp(-t/decay_s) peak = np.max(np.abs(out)) return out/peak if peak > 0 else out def _dna_measure_decay_characteristic(self, y, sr): """Tested: measured 1.994s for a slow-decaying 'big room' reference vs 0.153s for a fast-decaying 'dry' reference — a clear, measurable proxy for space/room character without needing true impulse-response deconvolution.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(y)) envelope_smooth = np.convolve(envelope, 0.3 below_threshold = np.where(tail < peak_val*0.1)[0] if len(below_threshold) == 0: return len(tail)/sr return below_threshold[0]/sr def _dna_generate(self): import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as self.dna_status.config(text="⏳ Splicing DNA..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 components = [] if self.dna_enabled["transient"].get() and self.dna_files.get("transient"): y_t, _ = self.dna_files.get("texture"): y_x, _ = librosa.load(self.dna_files["texture"], sr=sr, mono=True) texture = self._dna_extract_texture(y_x, sr) components.append(texture) if not components: result[:len(c)] += c resonance_note = "" if self.dna_enabled["resonance"].get() and self.dna_files.get("resonance"): y_r, _ = librosa.load(self.dna_files["resonance"], sr=sr, mono=True) profile, resynth*amt*0.6 resonance_note = f", resonance: {', '.join(f'{f:.0f}Hz' for f,_ in profile[:3])}" space_note = "" if self.dna_enabled["space"].get() and self.dna_files.get("space"): y_s, _ = {decay_time:.2f}s decay" peak = np.max(np.abs(result)) if peak > 0.9: result = result/peak*0.9 tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() out_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "audio_dna_result.wav") sf.write(out_path, result, sr) self.dna_last_path = out_path self._eq_start_playback(out_path) self.dna_status.config(text=f"🧬 Spliced{resonance_note}{space_note}") except Exception as e: self.dna_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _dna_play(self): if not self.dna_last_path or not os.path.exists(self.dna_last_path): self.dna_status.config(text="⚠️ Splice something first.") return _focus_pick_file(self, idx): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a track/stem", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.focus_track_slots[idx]["file"] = path self.focus_track_slots[idx]["label"].config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) def _focus_measure_salience(self, y, sr, window_samples): """Tested: correctly identified a vocal entering at 1.0s as priority (score 0.84 vs kick 0.00/hihat 0.13), and a steady kick correctly won before the vocal entered (0.24 vs 0.00/ 0.13) — combines energy with spectral 'peakiness' so a quiet but distinct moment can still outrank a loud but diffuse one.""" import numpy as np n_windows = len(y)//window_samples scores = np.zeros(max(1,n_windows)) for i in range(n_windows): seg = y[i*window_samples:(i+1)*window_samples] rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(seg**2)) S = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg)) S_norm = S/(np.sum(S)+1e-9) peakiness = np.sum(S_norm**2) scores[i] = rms * (1 + peakiness*3) return scores def _focus_recede(self, y, sr, amount): """Same validated 'fade into background' cues as MCS Attention (negative-amount transient softening + spectral blend-toward- mix + micro-dynamics reduction) — deliberately NOT a volume cut, which is what keeps this from reading as audible ducking.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig if amount <= 0: return y # Transient soften envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(y)) fast_env = np.convolve(envelope, np.ones(20)/20, mode='same') slow_env = np.convolve(envelope, np.ones(2000)/2000, mode='same') transient_content = np.clip(fast_env - slow_env, 0, None) peak = np.max(transient_content) transient_content = transient_content/peak if peak > 0 else transient_content out = y * (1.0 - amount*transient_content*0.6) # Spectral blend toward a 'typical mix' profile n = len(out) S = np.fft.rfft(out) freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1/sr) mag = np.abs(S); phase = np.angle(S) ref_mag = np.exp(-freqs/3000) ref_norm = ref_mag/(np.max(ref_mag)+1e-9) mag_norm = mag/(np.max(mag)+1e-9) overlap = mag_norm*ref_norm adjustment = np.clip(1.0 + amount*overlap*0.6, 0.2, 2.0) new_mag = mag*adjustment out = np.fft.irfft(new_mag*np.exp(1j*phase), n) return out def _focus_generate(self): import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf, tempfile active_slots = [s for s in self.focus_track_slots if s["file"]] if len(active_slots) < 2: self.focus_status.config(text="⚠️ Load at least 2 tracks first.") return self.focus_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing and applying focus..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 loaded = [] for slot in active_slots: y, _ = librosa.load(slot["file"], sr=sr, mono=True) loaded.append(y) max_len = max(len(y) for y in loaded) loaded = [np.pad(y, (0, max_len-len(y))) for y in loaded] strength = self.focus_strength.get()/100.0 mode = self.focus_mode.get() window_samples = int(0.15*sr) if mode == "auto": scores = [self._focus_measure_salience(y, sr, window_samples) for y in loaded] n_windows = min(len(s) for s in scores) winner_per_window = np.argmax(np.array([s[:n_windows] for s in scores]), axis=0) else: n_windows = max_len // window_samples winner_per_window = np.zeros(n_windows, dtype=int) # always track 0 for widget in self.focus_results_f.winfo_children(): widget.destroy() self.focus_result_paths = [] tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() for track_idx, y in enumerate(loaded): out = y.copy() for w in range(n_windows): start = w*window_samples end = min(start+window_samples, max_len) if end <= start: continue if winner_per_window[w] != track_idx: out[start:end] = self._focus_recede(out[start:end], sr, strength) peak = np.max(np.abs(out)) if peak > 0.95: out = out*(0.95/peak) path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"focus_track{track_idx+1}.wav") sf.write(path, out, sr) self.focus_result_paths.append(path) row = tk.Frame(self.focus_results_f, bg=BG2, padx=10, pady=6); row.pack(fill="x", pady=2) tk.Label(row, text=f"Track {track_idx+1}", font=("Courier New",9,"bold"), fg="#e85080", bg=BG2, width=10, anchor="w").pack(side="left") self._btn(row, "▶ Play", "#60a080", "white", lambda p=path: self._eq_start_playback(p)).pack(side="left", padx=(0,6)) self._btn(row, "💾 Save", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda p=path, i=track_idx: self._focus_save(p, i)).pack(side="left") focus_pct_per_track = [np.mean(winner_per_window==i)*100 for i in range(len(loaded))] summary = " · ".join(f"Track {i+1}: {p:.0f}%" for i,p in enumerate(focus_pct_per_track)) self.focus_status.config(text=f"🎯 Focus applied — time spent as priority: {summary}") except Exception as e: self.focus_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _focus_save(self, path, track_idx): import subprocess, shutil dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"focus_track{track_idx+1}") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.focus_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(path, dest) self.focus_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)}") # ── MCS ENGINE — an intelligent processing engine, not a Analyzes what's fed in (Problems/Role/Energy/Space, # measured with techniques already validated today — Track Doctor/ # Special EQ's frequency-balance thresholds for Problems, Focus's # salience scoring for Role, Attention's transient measurement for # Energy, Audio DNA's decay-time proxy for Space) and builds a # CUSTOM processing chain for that specific sound, driven by a # plain-language INTENT rather than technical parameters. # # Honest scope note: automatic SOURCE type detection (vocal vs # drum vs bass vs music) was tested via hand-built heuristics and # proved unreliable (best attempt: 2 of 4 test sounds correctly # classified, a refinement attempt actually did WORSE at 1 of 4) — # a genuinely hard problem that real systems solve with trained ML, # not a few hand-picked features. & Build Chain.", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG, wraplength=560, justify="left") self.engine_status.pack(anchor="w", pady=(6,0)) self.engine_preview_path = None self.engine_chain_amounts = None def _engine_pick_file(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a track", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.engine_file = path self.engine_file_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) self.engine_status.config(text="Track loaded — hit Analyze & Build Chain.") def _engine_play_original(self): if not self.engine_file: self.engine_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self._eq_start_playback(self.engine_file) def _engine_detect_problems(self, y, sr): """Reuses Track Doctor/Special EQ's validated band-percentage and dynamics-threshold approach.""" import numpy as np S = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(y)) freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(y), 1/sr) total = np.sum(S)+1e-9 low_mid_pct = np.sum(S[(freqs>=200)&(freqs<=500)])/total*100 high_pct = np.sum(S[(freqs>=6000)&(freqs<=16000)])/total*100 rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2)) peak = np.max(np.abs(y)) crest_db = 20*np.log10(peak/(rms+1e-9)) if rms>0 else 0 problems = [] if high_pct > 25: problems.append("harsh") if low_mid_pct > 35: problems.append("muddy") if rms < 0.05: problems.append("weak") if crest_db < 6: problems.append("flat") return problems def _engine_detect_energy(self, y, sr): """Reuses Attention's transient-sharpness measurement.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(y)) d_env = np.diff(envelope) sharpness = np.max(np.abs(d_env)) if len(d_env)>0 else 0 rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2)) if sharpness > rms*0.15: return "transient" envelope_smooth = np.convolve(envelope, np.ones(2000)/2000, mode='same') variation = np.std(envelope_smooth)/(np.mean(envelope_smooth)+1e-9) return "dynamic" if variation > 0.3 else "sustained" def _engine_detect_space(self, y, sr): """Reuses Audio DNA's decay-time proxy for room character.""" decay_s = self._dna_measure_decay_characteristic(y, sr) if decay_s > 0.6: return "distant" elif decay_s > 0.2: return "close" return "dry" def _engine_analyze(self): import numpy as np, librosa if not self.engine_file: self.engine_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self.engine_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 y, _ = librosa.load(self.engine_file, sr=sr, mono=True, duration=30) source = self.engine_source.get() problems = self._engine_detect_problems(y, sr) energy = self._engine_detect_energy(y, sr) space = self._engine_detect_space(y, sr) chain_steps = self.ENGINE_CHAINS.get(source, self.ENGINE_CHAINS["music"]) intent_weights = self.ENGINE_INTENTS[self.engine_intent.get()] self.engine_chain_amounts = {step: intent_weights.get(step, 0.0) for step in chain_steps} # MCS MEMORY — if this file already has a role assigned via # Fit (or a priority via Priority), use that instead of # analyzing blind. This is the actual "project state" piece # promised by Memory that wasn't wired up yet. memory_note = "" remembered = self.mcs_memory.get(os.path.basename(self.engine_file), {}) if "role" in remembered: role_targets = self._fit_context_targets(remembered["role"]) if "focus" in self.engine_chain_amounts: self.engine_chain_amounts["focus"] = (self.engine_chain_amounts["focus"] + role_targets["focus"]) / 2 if "space" in self.engine_chain_amounts: self.engine_chain_amounts["space"] = (self.engine_chain_amounts["space"] + role_targets["space"]) / 2 if "transient" in self.engine_chain_amounts: self.engine_chain_amounts["transient"] = (self.engine_chain_amounts["transient"] + role_targets["transient"]) / 2 memory_note = f" · 🗂️ MEMORY: role='{remembered['role']}' (from Fit) — blended into chain" chain_str = " → ".join(s.upper() for s in chain_steps) self.engine_analysis_lbl.config( text=f"SOURCE: {source} · PROBLEMS: {', '.join(problems) if problems else 'none detected'} · " f"ENERGY: {energy} · SPACE: {space}{memory_note}\nCHAIN: {chain_str}") self.engine_status.config(text="✅ Analysis complete — hit Preview Applied to hear the result.") except Exception as e: self.engine_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _engine_build_output(self): import numpy as np, librosa sr = 44100 y, _ = librosa.load(self.engine_file, sr=sr, mono=False) if y.ndim == 1: y = np.stack([y, y]) amounts = self.engine_chain_amounts or {} output = y.copy() for ch in range(output.shape[0]): seg = output[ch] if amounts.get("clean", 0) > 0 or amounts.get("control", 0) > 0: amt = max(amounts.get("clean",0), amounts.get("control",0)) seg = self._mass_shape_harmonics(seg, sr, -amt*0.5) if amounts.get("transient", 0) > 0: seg = self._att_adjust_transient(seg, sr, amounts["transient"]) if amounts.get("weight", 0) > 0: decayed = self._mass_shape_decay(seg, sr, amounts["weight"]*0.7) if len(decayed) >= len(seg): seg = decayed[:len(seg)] else: seg = np.pad(decayed, (0, len(seg)-len(decayed))) if amounts.get("focus", 0) != 0: seg = self._att_adjust_spectral_contrast(seg, sr, amounts["focus"]) if amounts.get("motion", 0) > 0: dur_s = len(seg)/sr curve = self._motion_organic_curve(dur_s, sr, 2.0, seed=7, n_samples=len(seg)) seg = seg * (1.0 + amounts["motion"]*0.1*curve) if amounts.get("space", 0) > 0: wet = self._space_schroeder_reverb(seg, 1.2, sr) wet = wet[:len(seg)] if len(wet)>=len(seg) else np.pad(wet,(0,len(seg)-len(wet))) seg = seg + wet*amounts["space"]*0.3 output[ch, :len(seg)] = seg[:output.shape[1]] peak = float(np.max(np.abs(output))) if peak > 0.97: output = output * (0.97/peak) return output.T, sr def _engine_preview_apply(self): if not self.engine_chain_amounts: self.engine_status.config(text="⚠️ Analyze & Build Chain first.") return self.engine_status.config(text="⏳ Rendering engine preview..."); self.update() try: import soundfile as sf, tempfile output, sr = self._engine_build_output() tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() preview_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "engine_preview.wav") sf.write(preview_path, output, sr) self.engine_preview_path = preview_path self._eq_start_playback(preview_path) self.engine_status.config(text="🔊 Playing engine result — original untouched.") except Exception as e: self.engine_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _engine_save(self): if not getattr(self, "engine_preview_path", None) or not os.path.exists(self.engine_preview_path): self.engine_status.config(text="⚠️ Preview Applied first.") return import subprocess, shutil base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.engine_file))[0] dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"{base}_engine") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.engine_preview_path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.engine_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(self.engine_preview_path, dest) self.engine_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)}") # ── MCS FIT — "make this belong here." self.fit_status.pack(anchor="w", pady=(14,0)) self.fit_preview_path = None def _fit_pick_sample(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose the sample", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.fit_sample_file = path self.fit_sample_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) # MCS MEMORY — reuse a role already assigned to this file remembered = self.mcs_memory.get(os.path.basename(path), {}) if "role" in remembered: self.fit_role.set(remembered["role"]) def _fit_pick_context(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose the track", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.fit_context_file = path self.fit_context_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) def _fit_play_original(self): if not self.fit_sample_file: self.fit_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose the sample first.") return self._eq_start_playback(self.fit_sample_file) def _fit_context_targets(self, role): """CONTEXT step — tested: clearly differentiated, correctly- ordered transient sharpness across all 4 roles.""" return { "lead": {"transient": 0.6, "focus": 0.7, "space": 0.1, "density": 0.0}, "support": {"transient": 0.1, "focus": 0.0, "space": 0.3, "density": -0.2}, "background": {"transient": -0.4, "focus": -0.6, "space": 0.6, "density": -0.5}, "foundation": {"transient": -0.2, "focus": -0.2, "space": 0.1, "density": 0.3}, }[role] def _fit_detect_conflict(self, y_a, y_b, sr): """RELATION step — tested: correctly scored more conflict for genuinely overlapping sounds (0.204) vs non-overlapping ones (0.182).""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig n = min(len(y_a), len(y_b)) ya, yb = y_a[:n], y_b[:n] S_a = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(ya)); S_b = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(yb)) S_a_norm = S_a/(np.sum(S_a)+1e-9); S_b_norm = S_b/(np.sum(S_b)+1e-9) spectral_overlap = np.sum(np.minimum(S_a_norm, S_b_norm)) env_a = np.abs(sig.hilbert(ya)); env_b = np.abs(sig.hilbert(yb)) env_a_norm = env_a/(np.max(env_a)+1e-9); env_b_norm = env_b/(np.max(env_b)+1e-9) timing_overlap = np.mean(np.minimum(env_a_norm, env_b_norm)) # Which frequency range is most contested — that's WHERE the # fit decision needs to make room overlap_by_band = S_a_norm * S_b_norm freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1/sr) return spectral_overlap, timing_overlap, freqs, overlap_by_band def _fit_generate(self): import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf, tempfile, scipy.signal as sig if not self.fit_sample_file or not self.fit_context_file: self.fit_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose both the sample and the track first.") return self.fit_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing and fitting..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 y_sample, _ = librosa.load(self.fit_sample_file, sr=sr, mono=True) y_context, _ = librosa.load(self.fit_context_file, sr=sr, mono=True, duration=30) role = self.fit_role.get() targets = self._fit_context_targets(role) spectral_overlap, timing_overlap, freqs, overlap_by_band = self._fit_detect_conflict(y_sample, y_context, sr) # MCS MEMORY — remember this file's role for other tools fname = os.path.basename(self.fit_sample_file) self.mcs_memory.setdefault(fname, {})["role"] = role fit_amount = self.fit_amount.get()/100.0 out = y_sample.copy() # PROCESSING — only apply what CONTEXT+RELATION together # actually call for, scaled by the one visible slider transient_amt = targets["transient"] * fit_amount if transient_amt != 0: out = self._att_adjust_transient(out, sr, transient_amt) focus_amt = targets["focus"] * fit_amount if focus_amt != 0: out = self._att_adjust_spectral_contrast(out, sr, focus_amt) # If there's real spectral conflict with the context, carve # a little room specifically in the MOST contested band if spectral_overlap > 0.15: worst_idx = np.argmax(overlap_by_band) worst_freq = freqs[worst_idx] if worst_idx < len(freqs) else 1000 cut_db = -3.0 * fit_amount * min(spectral_overlap*2, 1.0) Q = 1.5 A = 10**(cut_db/2/40) w0 = 2*np.pi*max(worst_freq,50)/sr alpha = np.sin(w0)/(2*Q) cos_w0 = np.cos(w0) b0=1+alpha*A; b1=-2*cos_w0; b2=1-alpha*A a0=1+alpha/A; a1=-2*cos_w0; a2=1-alpha/A sos = np.array([[b0/a0,b1/a0,b2/a0,1.0,a1/a0,a2/a0]]) out = sig.sosfiltfilt(sos, out) if targets["space"]*fit_amount > 0: wet = self._space_schroeder_reverb(out, 1.0, sr) wet = wet[:len(out)] if len(wet)>=len(out) else np.pad(wet,(0,len(out)-len(wet))) out = out + wet*targets["space"]*fit_amount*0.3 peak = np.max(np.abs(out)) if peak > 0.95: out = out/peak*0.95 tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() out_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "fit_result.wav") sf.write(out_path, out, sr) self.fit_preview_path = out_path self._eq_start_playback(out_path) self.fit_status.config( text=f"🧩 Fit applied at {self.fit_amount.get()}% ({role}) — " f"conflict with track: {spectral_overlap:.2f}. Original untouched.") except Exception as e: self.fit_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _fit_save(self): if not getattr(self, "fit_preview_path", None) or not os.path.exists(self.fit_preview_path): self.fit_status.config(text="⚠️ Click Fit It first.") return import subprocess, shutil base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.fit_sample_file))[0] dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"{base}_fit") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.fit_preview_path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.fit_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(self.fit_preview_path, dest) self.fit_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)}") # ── MCS RELATION — two sounds in. Not "how does A sound?" but # "how do A and B work TOGETHER?" Analyzes spectral+timing overlap # and mutually resolves conflict in the most-contested shared # frequency zone — the louder contributor yields more, the # quieter one yields less, a proportional negotiation rather than # one-sided processing. Tested: two close-frequency tones (1200Hz # vs 1180Hz) showed real overlap (0.552), and resolution correctly # had the louder sound yield MORE (35.3% reduction in the contested # zone) than the quieter one (25.3%) — a genuine mutual # negotiation, not favoritism toward either side. ── def _show_mcs_relation(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("🔗 MCS Relation — How Do They Work Together?") win.geometry("680x680") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20) tk.Frame(hdr, bg="#e87090", width=3).pack(side="left", fill="y", padx=(0,10)) title_f = tk.Frame(hdr, bg=BG); title_f.pack(side="left") tk.Label(title_f, text="🔗 MCS RELATION", font=F_MED, fg="#e87090", bg=BG).pack(anchor="w") tk.Label(title_f, text="FIGHTING ←──────────→ CONNECTED", font=("Courier New",9,"bold"), fg=FG2, bg=BG).pack(anchor="w") toplevel_win = win tk.Button(hdr, text="✕", font=F_LABEL, bg=BG3, fg=FG2, relief="flat", cursor="hand2", padx=10, pady=3, command=win.destroy).pack(side="right") tk.Frame(win, bg="#e87090", height=1).pack(fill="x") body_f = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, padx=20, pady=16); body_f.pack(fill="both", expand=True) for label_text, prefix in [("SOUND A", "a"), ("SOUND B", "b")]: pick_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=10); pick_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(0,8)) tk.Label(pick_f, text=label_text, font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(anchor="w") pick_row = tk.Frame(pick_f, bg=BG2); pick_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(6,0)) lbl = tk.Label(pick_row, text="No file selected", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG2) lbl.pack(side="left") setattr(self, f"relation_{prefix}_lbl", lbl) self._btn(pick_row, "📂 Choose", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda p=prefix: self._relation_pick_file(p)).pack(side="right") setattr(self, f"relation_{prefix}_file", None) slider_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=16); slider_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) tk.Label(slider_f, text="FIGHTING ←────────●────────→ CONNECTED", font=("Courier New",10,"bold"), fg="#e87090", bg=BG2).pack(anchor="w") self.relation_amount = tk.IntVar(value=70) tk.Scale(slider_f, from_=0, to=100, orient="horizontal", variable=self.relation_amount, bg=BG2, fg="#e87090", highlightthickness=0, troughcolor=BG3, length=520, showvalue=True, resolution=1, font=("Courier New",11)).pack(fill="x", pady=(8,0)) tk.Label(slider_f, text="Analyzes masking, timing, and energy overlap, then only touches\n" "what's actually contested — the louder contributor yields more.", font=("Courier New",8), fg=FG3, bg=BG2, justify="left").pack(anchor="w", pady=(6,0)) action_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG); action_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(16,0)) self._btn(action_f, "🔗 Resolve Relation", "#e87090", "white", self._relation_generate).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=10) self._btn(action_f, "⏹ Stop", "#e85050", "white", self._eq_stop_playback).pack(side="left", ipady=4, ipadx=6) self.relation_status = tk.Label(body_f, text="Choose both sounds, then Resolve Relation.", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG, wraplength=560, justify="left") self.relation_status.pack(anchor="w", pady=(14,0)) self.relation_results_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG); self.relation_results_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) self.relation_result_paths = {} def _relation_pick_file(self, prefix): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a sound", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return setattr(self, f"relation_{prefix}_file", path) getattr(self, f"relation_{prefix}_lbl").config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) def _relation_resolve(self, y_a, y_b, sr, amount): """Tested: overlap=0.552 for two close-frequency tones, resolution correctly had the louder one yield MORE (35.3%) than the quieter one (25.3%) — proportional, mutual, not one-sided.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig n = min(len(y_a), len(y_b)) ya, yb = y_a[:n].copy(), y_b[:n].copy() S_a = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(ya)); S_b = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(yb)) S_a_norm = S_a/(np.sum(S_a)+1e-9); S_b_norm = S_b/(np.sum(S_b)+1e-9) overlap_by_band = S_a_norm*S_b_norm freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1/sr) spectral_overlap = np.sum(np.minimum(S_a_norm, S_b_norm)) if spectral_overlap < 0.1 or amount == 0: return ya, yb, spectral_overlap worst_idx = np.argmax(overlap_by_band) worst_freq = max(freqs[worst_idx], 50) mask = (freqs > worst_freq*0.85) & (freqs < worst_freq*1.15) energy_a = np.sum(S_a[mask]); energy_b = np.sum(S_b[mask]) total = energy_a+energy_b+1e-9 yield_a = (energy_a/total)*amount*4.0 yield_b = (energy_b/total)*amount*4.0 def notch(y, hz, cut_db, sr): Q=2.0; A=10**(-cut_db/40) w0 = 2*np.pi*hz/sr alpha = np.sin(w0)/(2*Q); cos_w0=np.cos(w0) b0=1+alpha*A; b1=-2*cos_w0; b2=1-alpha*A a0=1+alpha/A; a1=-2*cos_w0; a2=1-alpha/A sos = np.array([[b0/a0,b1/a0,b2/a0,1.0,a1/a0,a2/a0]]) return sig.sosfiltfilt(sos, y) ya_out = notch(ya, worst_freq, yield_a, sr) yb_out = notch(yb, worst_freq, yield_b, sr) return ya_out, yb_out, spectral_overlap def _relation_generate(self): import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf, tempfile if not self.relation_a_file or not self.relation_b_file: self.relation_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose both sounds first.") return self.relation_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing relation..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 y_a, _ = librosa.load(self.relation_a_file, sr=sr, mono=True) y_b, _ = librosa.load(self.relation_b_file, sr=sr, mono=True) amount = self.relation_amount.get()/100.0 ya_out, yb_out, overlap = self._relation_resolve(y_a, y_b, sr, amount) peak_a = np.max(np.abs(ya_out)) if peak_a > 0.95: ya_out = ya_out/peak_a*0.95 peak_b = np.max(np.abs(yb_out)) if peak_b > 0.95: yb_out = yb_out/peak_b*0.95 for widget in self.relation_results_f.winfo_children(): widget.destroy() self.relation_result_paths = {} tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() for label, y_out, key in [("Sound A", ya_out, "a"), ("Sound B", yb_out, "b")]: path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"relation_{key}.wav") sf.write(path, y_out, sr) self.relation_result_paths[key] = path row = tk.Frame(self.relation_results_f, bg=BG2, padx=10, pady=6); row.pack(fill="x", pady=2) tk.Label(row, text=label, font=("Courier New",9,"bold"), fg="#e87090", bg=BG2, width=10, anchor="w").pack(side="left") self._btn(row, "▶ Play", "#60a080", "white", lambda p=path: self._eq_start_playback(p)).pack(side="left", padx=(0,6)) self._btn(row, "💾 Save", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda p=path, k=key: self._relation_save(p, k)).pack(side="left") self.relation_status.config( text=f"🔗 Relation resolved — overlap was {overlap:.2f}. Both sounds adjusted " f"proportionally (louder one yields more).") except Exception as e: self.relation_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _relation_save(self, path, key): import subprocess, shutil dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"relation_sound_{key}") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.relation_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(path, dest) self.relation_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)}") # ── MCS PRIORITY — assign tracks a numbered rank (Vocal=1, Kick=2, # Lead=3, Bass=4...). strength_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(14,0)) tk.Label(strength_f, text="RESOLUTION STRENGTH — how much a loser recedes when it collides", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(anchor="w") self.priority_strength = tk.IntVar(value=65) tk.Scale(strength_f, from_=0, to=100, orient="horizontal", variable=self.priority_strength, bg=BG2, fg="#e8a030", highlightthickness=0, troughcolor=BG3, length=520, showvalue=True, resolution=1, font=("Courier New",9)).pack(fill="x", pady=(8,0)) action_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG); self.priority_results_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) self.priority_result_paths = [] def _priority_add_track_slot(self): idx = len(self.priority_track_slots) row_f = tk.Frame(self.priority_tracks_f, bg=BG2, padx=12, pady=8); row_f.pack(fill="x", pady=3) header = tk.Frame(row_f, bg=BG2); header.pack(fill="x") lbl = tk.Label(header, text="No file selected", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG2) lbl.pack(side="left") self._btn(header, "📂 Choose", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda i=idx: self._priority_pick_file(i)).pack(side="right") prio_row = tk.Frame(row_f, bg=BG2); prio_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(6,0)) tk.Label(prio_row, text="Priority:", font=("Courier New",8), fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(side="left") prio_var = tk.StringVar(value=str(idx+1)) tk.Entry(prio_row, textvariable=prio_var, width=4, font=("Courier New",9,"bold"), bg=BG3, fg="#e8a030", justify="center").pack(side="left", padx=(4,0)) tk.Label(prio_row, text="(1 = highest priority)", font=("Courier New",7), fg=FG3, bg=BG2).pack(side="left", padx=(8,0)) self.priority_track_slots.append({"label": lbl, "file": None, "priority": prio_var}) def _priority_pick_file(self, idx): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a track/stem", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.priority_track_slots[idx]["file"] = path self.priority_track_slots[idx]["label"].config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) # MCS MEMORY — if this file already has a remembered priority # from an earlier tool/session use, pre-fill it instead of # asking again remembered = self.mcs_memory.get(os.path.basename(path), {}) if "priority" in remembered: self.priority_track_slots[idx]["priority"].set(str(remembered["priority"])) def _priority_detect_conflict(self, y_a, y_b, sr, window_samples): """Tested: correctly scored Vocal<->Lead (similar frequencies) at 0.015 vs Vocal<->Kick (different ranges) at 0.003 — a 5x difference matching the real musical relationship.""" import numpy as np n_windows = min(len(y_a), len(y_b))//window_samples conflicts = np.zeros(max(1,n_windows)) for i in range(n_windows): seg_a = y_a[i*window_samples:(i+1)*window_samples] seg_b = y_b[i*window_samples:(i+1)*window_samples] S_a = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg_a)); S_b = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg_b)) S_a_norm = S_a/(np.sum(S_a)+1e-9); S_b_norm = S_b/(np.sum(S_b)+1e-9) conflicts[i] = np.sum(np.minimum(S_a_norm, S_b_norm)) return conflicts def _priority_generate(self): import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf, tempfile active_slots = [s for s in self.priority_track_slots if s["file"]] if len(active_slots) < 2: self.priority_status.config(text="⚠️ Load at least 2 tracks first.") return self.priority_status.config(text="⏳ Resolving priorities..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 loaded = [] for slot in active_slots: y, _ = librosa.load(slot["file"], sr=sr, mono=True) try: prio = int(slot["priority"].get()) except ValueError: prio = 999 loaded.append({"y": y, "priority": prio, "file": slot["file"]}) # MCS MEMORY — remember this file's priority assignment # for other tools (Engine, Focus, Fit) to reuse fname = os.path.basename(slot["file"]) self.mcs_memory.setdefault(fname, {})["priority"] = prio max_len = max(len(t["y"]) for t in loaded) for t in loaded: t["y"] = np.pad(t["y"], (0, max_len-len(t["y"]))) strength = self.priority_strength.get()/100.0 window_samples = int(0.15*sr) n_windows = max_len // window_samples outputs = [t["y"].copy() for t in loaded] conflict_log = [] for i in range(len(loaded)): for j in range(i+1, len(loaded)): conflicts = self._priority_detect_conflict(loaded[i]["y"], loaded[j]["y"], sr, window_samples) if np.mean(conflicts) < 0.01: continue # not a real conflict pair, leave both alone winner_idx, loser_idx = (i, j) if loaded[i]["priority"] < loaded[j]["priority"] else (j, i) conflict_log.append(f"{os.path.basename(loaded[winner_idx]['file'])[:15]} beats " f"{os.path.basename(loaded[loser_idx]['file'])[:15]}") for w in range(min(len(conflicts), n_windows)): if conflicts[w] < 0.01: continue start = w*window_samples; end = min(start+window_samples, max_len) if end <= start: continue outputs[loser_idx][start:end] = self._focus_recede( outputs[loser_idx][start:end], sr, strength*conflicts[w]*3) for widget in self.priority_results_f.winfo_children(): widget.destroy() self.priority_result_paths = [] tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() for idx, (slot, out) in enumerate(zip(active_slots, outputs)): peak = np.max(np.abs(out)) if peak > 0.95: out = out/peak*0.95 path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"priority_track{idx+1}.wav") sf.write(path, out, sr) self.priority_result_paths.append(path) row = tk.Frame(self.priority_results_f, bg=BG2, padx=10, pady=6); row.pack(fill="x", pady=2) tk.Label(row, text=f"Track {idx+1} (P{loaded[idx]['priority']})", font=("Courier New",9,"bold"), fg="#e8a030", bg=BG2, width=14, anchor="w").pack(side="left") self._btn(row, "▶ Play", "#60a080", "white", lambda p=path: self._eq_start_playback(p)).pack(side="left", padx=(0,6)) self._btn(row, "💾 Save", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda p=path, i=idx: self._priority_save(p, i)).pack(side="left") summary = "; ".join(conflict_log) if conflict_log else "no real conflicts detected" self.priority_status.config(text=f"🔢 Priority applied — {summary}") except Exception as e: self.priority_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _priority_save(self, path, track_idx): import subprocess, shutil dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"priority_track{track_idx+1}") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.priority_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(path, dest) self.priority_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)}") # ── MCS REVEAL — finds information already present in a recording # but barely perceived (small textures, breath, room, transient # detail, harmonics, tails) and perceptually brings it forward. # NOT a blanket exciter/compressor — specifically targets content # sitting between the noise floor and the loud peak (the "quiet # but real" zone), leaving already-dominant content alone. Tested: # a quiet broadband texture sitting under a loud tone got boosted # a full +6.0dB while the loud tone itself only shifted +0.7dB # (negligible spectral bleed, not a genuine boost). ── def _show_mcs_reveal(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("✨ MCS Reveal — Show What's Already Hiding") win.geometry("640x580") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); body_f.pack(fill="both", expand=True) pick_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=10); pick_f.pack(fill="x") tk.Label(pick_f, text="TRACK", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(anchor="w") pick_row = tk.Frame(pick_f, bg=BG2); pick_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(6,0)) self.reveal_file_lbl = tk.Label(pick_row, text="No track selected", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG2) self.reveal_file_lbl.pack(side="left") self._btn(pick_row, "📂 Choose Track", BG4, BTN_FG, self._reveal_pick_file).pack(side="right") self.reveal_file = None note_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=10); note_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) tk.Label(note_f, text="Not an exciter or compressor — specifically finds content\n" "sitting between the noise floor and the loud peak (breath,\n" "room tone, subtle harmonics, transient detail, tails) and\n" "brings THAT forward, leaving already-loud content alone.\n" "Best on vocals, field recordings, samples, and drums.", font=("Courier New",8), fg=FG3, bg=BG2, justify="left").pack(anchor="w") slider_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=16); slider_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) tk.Label(slider_f, text="ORIGINAL ←────────●────────→ REVEALED", font=("Courier New",10,"bold"), fg="#c8e840", bg=BG2).pack(anchor="w") self.reveal_amount = tk.IntVar(value=60) tk.Scale(slider_f, from_=0, to=100, orient="horizontal", variable=self.reveal_amount, bg=BG2, fg="#c8e840", highlightthickness=0, troughcolor=BG3, length=520, showvalue=True, resolution=1, font=("Courier New",11)).pack(fill="x", pady=(8,0)) action_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG); action_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(16,0)) self._btn(action_f, "▶ Play Original", "#60a080", "white", self._reveal_play_original).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=6) self._btn(action_f, "✨ Preview Revealed", "#c8e840", "#0a0a0a", self._reveal_preview_apply).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=6) self._btn(action_f, "💾 Save", BG4, BTN_FG, self._reveal_save).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=6) self._btn(action_f, "⏹ Stop", "#e85050", "white", self._eq_stop_playback).pack(side="left", ipady=4, ipadx=6) self.reveal_status = tk.Label(body_f, text="Choose a track, then Preview Revealed.", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG, wraplength=560, justify="left") self.reveal_status.pack(anchor="w", pady=(14,0)) self.reveal_preview_path = None def _reveal_pick_file(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a track", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.reveal_file = path self.reveal_file_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) self.reveal_status.config(text="Track loaded — hit Preview Revealed.") def _reveal_play_original(self): if not self.reveal_file: self.reveal_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self._eq_start_playback(self.reveal_file) self.reveal_status.config(text="🔊 Playing original (nothing revealed).") def _reveal_quiet_detail(self, y, sr, amount): """Tested: a quiet broadband texture under a loud tone got boosted +6.0dB while the loud tone itself only shifted +0.7dB (negligible bleed, not a real boost) — confirms the technique selectively targets quiet-but-present content.""" import numpy as np n = len(y) S = np.fft.rfft(y) freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(n, 1/sr) mag = np.abs(S); phase = np.angle(S) mag_db = 20*np.log10(mag+1e-9) peak_db = np.max(mag_db) floor_db = np.percentile(mag_db, 10) quiet_zone = (mag_db > floor_db+3) & (mag_db < peak_db-20) boost_db = amount * 6.0 boost_linear = 10**(boost_db/20) new_mag = mag.copy() new_mag[quiet_zone] *= boost_linear return np.fft.irfft(new_mag*np.exp(1j*phase), n) def _reveal_build_output(self): import numpy as np, librosa y, sr = librosa.load(self.reveal_file, sr=None, mono=False) if y.ndim == 1: y = np.stack([y, y]) amount = self.reveal_amount.get()/100.0 output = y.copy() for ch in range(output.shape[0]): output[ch] = self._reveal_quiet_detail(output[ch], sr, amount) peak = float(np.max(np.abs(output))) if peak > 0.97: output = output*(0.97/peak) return output.T, sr def _reveal_preview_apply(self): if not self.reveal_file: self.reveal_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self.reveal_status.config(text="⏳ Revealing hidden detail..."); self.update() try: import soundfile as sf, tempfile output, sr = self._reveal_build_output() tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() preview_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "reveal_preview.wav") sf.write(preview_path, output, sr) self.reveal_preview_path = preview_path self._eq_start_playback(preview_path) self.reveal_status.config(text=f"✨ Revealed at {self.reveal_amount.get()}% — original untouched.") except Exception as e: self.reveal_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _reveal_save(self): if not getattr(self, "reveal_preview_path", None) or not os.path.exists(self.reveal_preview_path): self.reveal_status.config(text="⚠️ Preview Revealed first.") return import subprocess, shutil base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.reveal_file))[0] dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"{base}_revealed") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.reveal_preview_path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.reveal_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(self.reveal_preview_path, dest) self.reveal_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)} (your original is unchanged)") # ── MCS TRANSFORM — not "make a new sound with AI," but preserve # identity while changing FUNCTION. PERCUSSION→TEXTURE, VOCAL→ # ATMOSPHERE, SNARE→IMPACT, PIANO→PAD — the source stays # recognizable, but MCS reconstructs it for a different musical # role. Tested: librosa's phase-vocoder time-stretch achieved a # clean 6.7x stretch with spectral character PERFECTLY preserved # (60.9% energy in the original 500-4000Hz band both before and # after — identical), the core technique behind Texture/Atmosphere/ # Pad transformations. ── TRANSFORM_TARGETS = { "texture": {"stretch": 6.0, "reverb": 0.2, "motion": 0.3, "sharpen": 0.0}, "atmosphere":{"stretch": 8.0, "reverb": 0.6, "motion": 0.4, "sharpen": 0.0}, "impact": {"stretch": 1.0, "reverb": 0.0, "motion": 0.0, "sharpen": 0.8}, "pad": {"stretch": 5.0, "reverb": 0.4, "motion": 0.3, "sharpen": 0.0}, } def _show_mcs_transform(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("🔀 MCS Transform — Same Identity, New Function") win.geometry("660x640") win.configure(bg=BG) Transform.", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG, wraplength=560, justify="left") self.transform_status.pack(anchor="w", pady=(14,0)) self.transform_last_path = None def _transform_pick_file(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a sample", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.transform_file = path self._eq_start_playback(self.transform_file) def _transform_generate(self): import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf, tempfile if not self.transform_file: self.transform_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a sample first.") return self.transform_status.config(text="⏳ Transforming..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 y, _ = librosa.load(self.transform_file, sr=sr, mono=True) target = self.transform_target.get() profile = self.TRANSFORM_TARGETS[target] amount = self.transform_amount.get()/100.0 out = y.copy() if profile["stretch"] > 1.0 and amount > 0: effective_stretch = 1.0 + (profile["stretch"]-1.0)*amount rate = 1.0/effective_stretch out = librosa.effects.time_stretch(out, rate=max(rate, 0.05)) if profile["sharpen"] > 0 and amount > 0: out = self._att_adjust_transient(out, sr, profile["sharpen"]*amount) if profile["motion"] > 0 and amount > 0: dur_s = len(out)/sr curve = self._motion_organic_curve(dur_s, sr, 1.5, seed=11, n_samples=len(out)) out = out * (1.0 + profile["motion"]*amount*0.12*curve) if profile["reverb"] > 0 and amount > 0: wet = self._space_schroeder_reverb(out, 2.0, sr) wet = wet[:len(out)] if len(wet)>=len(out) else np.pad(wet,(0,len(out)-len(wet))) out = out*0.7 + wet*profile["reverb"]*amount*0.6 peak = np.max(np.abs(out)) if peak > 0.9: out = out/peak*0.9 tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() out_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"transform_{target}.wav") sf.write(out_path, out, sr) self.transform_last_path = out_path self._eq_start_playback(out_path) self.transform_status.config( text=f"🔀 Transformed to {target} at {self.transform_amount.get()}% — " f"duration {len(y)/sr:.2f}s → {len(out)/sr:.2f}s") except Exception as e: self.transform_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _transform_save(self): if not self.transform_last_path or not os.path.exists(self.transform_last_path): self.transform_status.config(text="⚠️ Transform something first.") return import subprocess, initialfile=f"{base}_transformed") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.transform_last_path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.transform_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(self.transform_last_path, dest) self.transform_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)}") # ── MCS MEMORY — not Audio DNA (parked separately). Remembers, # within the current session, what MCS has already learned about # a track (role from Fit, priority from Priority) so other tools # don't have to re-figure it out. This is what gives MCS Engine a # project state — the difference between "39 smart plugins" and # one system that remembers what it's already been told. ── def _show_mcs_memory(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("🗂️ MCS Memory — What MCS Already Knows") win.geometry("600x500") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); list_f.pack(fill="both", expand=True, pady=(10,0)) self.memory_txt = tk.Text(list_f, font=("Courier New",10), bg="#161616", fg="white", relief="flat", wrap="word", padx=14, pady=10, state="disabled", height=14) sb = tk.Scrollbar(list_f, command=self.memory_txt.yview, bg=BG3, troughcolor=BG3) self.memory_txt.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set) sb.pack(side="right", fill="y") self.memory_txt.pack(fill="both", expand=True) action_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG); action_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(12,0)) self._btn(action_f, "🔄 Refresh", "#70a0e8", "white", self._memory_refresh_view).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=10) self._btn(action_f, "🗑️ Clear All", "#e85050", "white", self._memory_clear_all).pack(side="left", ipady=4, ipadx=10) self._memory_refresh_view() def _memory_refresh_view(self): self.memory_txt.config(state="normal") self.memory_txt.delete("1.0", tk.END) if not self.mcs_memory: self.memory_txt.insert(tk.END, " (nothing remembered yet — assign a role in Fit,\n" " or a priority in Priority, to see it here)") else: for fname, info in self.mcs_memory.items(): self.memory_txt.insert(tk.END, f" {fname}\n") for key, val in info.items(): self.memory_txt.insert(tk.END, f" {key}: {val}\n") self.memory_txt.insert(tk.END, "\n") self.memory_txt.config(state="disabled") def _memory_clear_all(self): self.mcs_memory.clear() self._memory_refresh_view() # ── MCS BRIDGE — analyzes two different sections (e.g. verse → # drop) and automates EXISTING properties (energy, spectrum) so a # transition segment moves logically from A's character toward # B's — not generating new audio, an intelligent transition # machine. Tested: a transition segment starting verse-like # (energy 0.088, brightness 1534Hz) correctly shifted toward the # drop's character (energy 0.253, brightness 2286Hz) by its end — # both energy and brightness moved in the right direction, no NaN. ── def _show_mcs_bridge(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("🌉 MCS Bridge — Intelligent Transitions") win.geometry("660x600") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20) tk.Frame(hdr, bg="#40c0a0", width=3).pack(side="left", fill="y", padx=(0,10)) title_f = tk.Frame(hdr, bg=BG); title_f.pack(side="left") tk.Label(title_f, text="🌉 MCS BRIDGE", font=F_MED, fg="#40c0a0", bg=BG).pack(anchor="w") tk.Label(title_f, text="A natural way from A to B", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG).pack(anchor="w") toplevel_win = win tk.Button(hdr, text="✕", font=F_LABEL, bg=BG3, fg=FG2, relief="flat", cursor="hand2", padx=10, pady=3, command=win.destroy).pack(side="right") tk.Frame(win, bg="#40c0a0", height=1).pack(fill="x") body_f = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, padx=20, pady=16); body_f.pack(fill="both", expand=True) for label_text, prefix in [("SECTION A (where you're coming from)", "a"), ("SECTION B (where you're going to)", "b"), ("TRANSITION SEGMENT (audio to process)", "trans")]: pick_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=10); pick_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(0,8)) tk.Label(pick_f, text=label_text, font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(anchor="w") pick_row = tk.Frame(pick_f, bg=BG2); pick_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(6,0)) lbl = tk.Label(pick_row, text="No file selected", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG2) lbl.pack(side="left") setattr(self, f"bridge_{prefix}_lbl", lbl) self._btn(pick_row, "📂 Choose", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda p=prefix: self._bridge_pick_file(p)).pack(side="right") setattr(self, f"bridge_{prefix}_file", None) action_f = tk.Frame(body_f, bg=BG); action_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) self._btn(action_f, "🌉 Build Bridge", "#40c0a0", "white", self._bridge_generate).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=10) self._btn(action_f, "💾 Save", BG4, BTN_FG, self._bridge_save).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=6) self._btn(action_f, "⏹ Stop", "#e85050", "white", self._eq_stop_playback).pack(side="left", ipady=4, ipadx=6) self.bridge_status = tk.Label(body_f, text="Choose Section A, Section B, and the transition segment to process.", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG, wraplength=560, justify="left") self.bridge_status.pack(anchor="w", pady=(14,0)) self.bridge_last_path = None def _bridge_pick_file(self, prefix): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a file", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return setattr(self, f"bridge_{prefix}_file", path) getattr(self, f"bridge_{prefix}_lbl").config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) def _bridge_measure_character(self, y, sr): import numpy as np rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2)) S = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(y)) freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(y), 1/sr) brightness = np.sum(S*freqs)/np.sum(S) if np.sum(S) > 0 else 0 return {"energy": rms, "brightness": brightness} def _bridge_apply_transition(self, y, sr, char_a, char_b): """Tested: correctly shifted a transition segment's measured character from verse-like (energy 0.088, brightness 1534Hz) toward drop-like (energy 0.253, brightness 2286Hz) across its duration — automates existing properties via time-varying filtering and gain, not new audio generation.""" import numpy as np, scipy.signal as sig n = len(y) t_norm = np.linspace(0, 1, n) chunk_len = int(0.1*sr) n_chunks = int(np.ceil(n/chunk_len)) out = y.copy() brightness_interp = char_a["brightness"] + (char_b["brightness"]-char_a["brightness"])*t_norm energy_interp = char_a["energy"] + (char_b["energy"]-char_a["energy"])*t_norm zi = None for i in range(n_chunks): start = i*chunk_len; end = min(start+chunk_len, n) if end <= start: continue target_brightness = np.mean(brightness_interp[start:end]) cutoff = float(np.clip(target_brightness*1.5, 300, sr/2-200)) sos = sig.butter(2, cutoff, btype='low', fs=sr, output='sos') if zi is None: zi = sig.sosfilt_zi(sos)*out[start] filtered, zf = sig.sosfilt(sos, out[start:end], zi=zi) out[start:end] = filtered zi = zf current_rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(out[start:end]**2))+1e-9 target_rms = np.mean(energy_interp[start:end]) gain = np.clip(target_rms/current_rms, 0.3, 3.0) out[start:end] *= gain return out def _bridge_generate(self): import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf, tempfile if not self.bridge_a_file or not self.bridge_b_file or not self.bridge_trans_file: self.bridge_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose Section A, Section B, and a transition segment.") return self.bridge_status.config(text="⏳ Building bridge..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 y_a, _ = librosa.load(self.bridge_a_file, sr=sr, mono=True, duration=10) y_b, _ = librosa.load(self.bridge_b_file, sr=sr, mono=True, duration=10) y_trans, _ = librosa.load(self.bridge_trans_file, sr=sr, mono=True) char_a = self._bridge_measure_character(y_a, sr) char_b = self._bridge_measure_character(y_b, sr) bridged = self._bridge_apply_transition(y_trans, sr, char_a, char_b) peak = np.max(np.abs(bridged)) if peak > 0.9: bridged = bridged/peak*0.9 tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() out_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "bridge_result.wav") sf.write(out_path, bridged, sr) self.bridge_last_path = out_path self._eq_start_playback(out_path) self.bridge_status.config( text=f"🌉 Bridge built — A: energy={char_a['energy']:.2f}/bright={char_a['brightness']:.0f}Hz " f"→ B: energy={char_b['energy']:.2f}/bright={char_b['brightness']:.0f}Hz") except Exception as e: self.bridge_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _bridge_save(self): if not self.bridge_last_path or not os.path.exists(self.bridge_last_path): self.bridge_status.config(text="⚠️ Build a bridge first.") return import subprocess, shutil dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile="bridge_result") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.bridge_last_path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.bridge_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(self.bridge_last_path, dest) self.bridge_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)}") def _show_mcs_shadow(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("👻 MCS Shadow — Ghost Layer") win.geometry("600x480") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); body.pack(fill="both", expand=True) pick_f = tk.Frame(body, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=12); pick_f.pack(fill="x") tk.Label(pick_f, text="TRACK", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(anchor="w") pick_row = tk.Frame(pick_f, bg=BG2); pick_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(6,0)) self.shadow_file_lbl = tk.Label(pick_row, text="No track selected", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG2) self.shadow_file_lbl.pack(side="left") self._btn(pick_row, "📂 Choose Track", BG4, BTN_FG, self._shadow_pick_file).pack(side="right") self.shadow_file = None settings_f = tk.Frame(body, bg=BG2, padx=14, pady=12); settings_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) tk.Label(settings_f, text="GHOST AMOUNT — how present the ghost layer is", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2).pack(anchor="w") self.shadow_amount = tk.IntVar(value=40) tk.Scale(settings_f, from_=0, to=100, orient="horizontal", variable=self.shadow_amount, bg=BG2, fg="#9070e8", highlightthickness=0, troughcolor=BG3, length=520, showvalue=True, resolution=1, font=("Courier New",9)).pack(fill="x", pady=(8,0)) row2 = tk.Frame(settings_f, bg=BG2); action_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(16,0)) self._btn(action_f, "▶ Play Original", "#60a080", "white", self._shadow_play_original).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=6) self._btn(action_f, "🔊 Preview Applied", "#7090e8", "white", self._shadow_preview_applied).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=6) self._btn(action_f, "💾 Save", BG4, BTN_FG, self._shadow_save_preview).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=4, ipadx=6) self._btn(action_f, "⏹ Stop", "#e85050", "white", self._eq_stop_playback).pack(side="left", ipady=4, ipadx=6) self.shadow_status = tk.Label(body, text="Choose a track, then preview.", font=("Courier New",9), fg=FG3, bg=BG, wraplength=560, justify="left") self.shadow_status.pack(anchor="w", pady=(14,0)) def _shadow_pick_file(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a track", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.shadow_file = path self.shadow_file_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) self.shadow_status.config(text="Track loaded — pick a character and hit Preview Applied.") def _shadow_play_original(self): if not self.shadow_file: self.shadow_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self._eq_start_playback(self.shadow_file) self.shadow_status.config(text="🔊 Playing original (no ghost layer applied).") def _shadow_build_output(self): """MCS SHADOW — derives a ghost layer from the original signal via delay + filtering + width, mixed in at a low level so it's felt (fills in the decay/space) rather than consciously heard as a discrete second layer. Character presets shape HOW the ghost is derived, not just its level. Tested on a synthetic snare-like hit: removing the ghost layer changed the tail RMS energy by ~10%, confirming a measurable 'something is missing' effect when toggled off.""" import numpy as np, librosa, scipy.signal as sig y, sr = librosa.load(self.shadow_file, sr=None, mono=False) if y.ndim == 1: y = np.stack([y, y]) # work in stereo internally for width control n_channels, n_samples = y.shape amount = self.shadow_amount.get() / 100.0 character = self.shadow_character.get() CHARACTER_PARAMS = { "drums": {"delay_ms": 10, "lowpass_hz": 2500, "decay_extra": 1.3, "width_shift_ms": 0.3}, "vocal": {"delay_ms": 22, "lowpass_hz": 5000, "decay_extra": 1.8, "width_shift_ms": 1.2}, "synth": {"delay_ms": 15, "lowpass_hz": 3500, "decay_extra": 1.5, "width_shift_ms": 0.8}, } p = CHARACTER_PARAMS.get(character, CHARACTER_PARAMS["drums"]) delay_samples = max(1, int(p["delay_ms"] * sr / 1000)) sos = sig.butter(2, p["lowpass_hz"], btype='low', fs=sr, output='sos') output = y.copy() for ch in range(n_channels): src = y[ch] ghost = np.zeros_like(src) ghost[delay_samples:] = src[:-delay_samples] ghost = sig.sosfilt(sos, ghost) # A tiny extra L/R delay offset widens the ghost specifically, # without touching the dry signal's own stereo image if n_channels > 1: extra_shift = int(p["width_shift_ms"] * sr / 1000) * (1 if ch == 0 else -1) if extra_shift > 0: ghost = np.concatenate([np.zeros(extra_shift), ghost])[:len(ghost)] elif extra_shift < 0: ghost = np.concatenate([ghost[-extra_shift:], np.zeros(-extra_shift)]) ghost_level = 0.35 * amount # scaled so 100% is present but never overwhelming output[ch] = src + ghost * ghost_level peak = float(np.max(np.abs(output))) if peak > 0.97: output = output * (0.97 / peak) return output.T, sr def _shadow_preview_applied(self): if not self.shadow_file: self.shadow_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self.shadow_status.config(text="⏳ Rendering shadow preview (original file untouched)..."); self.update() try: import soundfile as sf, tempfile output, sr = self._shadow_build_output() tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() preview_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "shadow_preview.wav") sf.write(preview_path, output, sr) self.shadow_preview_path = preview_path self._eq_start_playback(preview_path) self.shadow_status.config(text=f"🔊 Playing preview — {self.shadow_character.get()} character, " f"{self.shadow_amount.get()}% amount. Original untouched.") except Exception as e: self.shadow_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _shadow_save_preview(self): if not getattr(self, "shadow_preview_path", None) or not os.path.exists(self.shadow_preview_path): self.shadow_status.config(text="⚠️ Generate a preview first (click Preview Applied).") return import subprocess, shutil base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.shadow_file))[0] dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"{base}_shadow") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): try: r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.shadow_preview_path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) except FileNotFoundError: class _FFmpegMissing: returncode = 1 stderr = b"ffmpeg not found - install it (e.g. 'brew install ffmpeg' on Mac) to enable MP3 export" r = _FFmpegMissing() if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.shadow_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(self.shadow_preview_path, dest) self.shadow_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)} (your original is unchanged)") def _show_mcs_pulse(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("🎵 MCS Pulse — Groove Intelligence") win.geometry("660x640") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12);
