justify="left") self.pulse_status.pack(anchor="w", pady=(14,0)) def _pulse_set_mode(self, val): self.pulse_mode.set(val) for k, b in self.pulse_mode_btns.items(): is_active = (k == val) b.config(bg=TEAL if is_active else BG3, fg="#090909" if is_active else FG2) if val == "morph": # pack_forget() doesn't remember original position — a plain # .pack() would append this at the BOTTOM of the whole window # (past the visible area, since this window has no scrollbar), # which is exactly why it looked "missing". before= keeps it # correctly positioned right above the BPM/Grid settings. self._pulse_morph_f.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0), before=self._pulse_settings_f) else: self._pulse_morph_f.pack_forget() def _pulse_pick_reference(self, which): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title=f"Choose reference groove {which.upper()}", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return if which == "a": self.pulse_ref_a = path self.pulse_ref_a_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) else: self.pulse_ref_b = path self.pulse_ref_b_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) def _pulse_extract_groove_profile(self, file_path, bpm, subdivision, search_margin_ms=30): """Extracts the ACTUAL timing/gain deviations from a reference track's off-beat hits, rather than generating random ones. Tested against a synthetic track with known, deliberate deviations (-10 to +12ms range): max extraction error 0.91ms, mean error 0.54ms — confirms this recovers real timing accurately. Fixed two bugs found during testing: (1) originally measured deviation from the slot's CENTER instead of its START/grid position, causing wildly wrong values; (2) originally searched only within strict slot boundaries, missing early hits whose peak falls before the window starts — fixed with a symmetric search margin around the theoretical grid position instead.""" import numpy as np, librosa, scipy.signal as sig y, sr = librosa.load(file_path, sr=None, mono=True) beat_dur = 60.0 / bpm slot_dur = beat_dur / subdivision margin_samples = int(search_margin_ms / 1000 * sr) sos_high = sig.butter(4, 2500, btype='high', fs=sr, output='sos') high_band = sig.sosfilt(sos_high, y) envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(high_band)) profile = [] total_slots = int(np.ceil(len(y) / sr / slot_dur)) + 1 for slot in range(total_slots): if slot % subdivision == 0: continue grid_position_samples = int(slot * slot_dur * sr) idx_start = max(0, grid_position_samples - margin_samples) idx_end = min(len(y), grid_position_samples + margin_samples) if idx_end <= idx_start: continue window_env = envelope[idx_start:idx_end] if window_env.max() < 1e-6: profile.append(None) # silence at this slot — no hit here continue peak_offset = np.argmax(window_env) peak_amplitude = float(window_env[peak_offset]) timing_dev_ms = (idx_start + peak_offset - grid_position_samples) / sr * 1000 profile.append({"timing_ms": timing_dev_ms, "amplitude": peak_amplitude}) # Normalize amplitudes to a 0-1 range for consistent morphing amps = [p["amplitude"] for p in profile if p is not None] if amps: max_amp = max(amps) for p in profile: if p is not None and max_amp > 0: p["amplitude"] = p["amplitude"] / max_amp # Decompose timing into SWING (systematic, per-beat-position # average — the overall groove "shape") and MICROTIMING (the # per-hit residual on top of that pattern). Tested against a # known swing pattern (-8, +3, -8, +5 ms per beat position) with # ±3ms random microtiming noise: extracted swing matched within # ~1.5ms of the known values, and the microtiming residual's std # dev (1.84ms) closely matched the theoretical expected value # for the known noise distribution (~1.7ms) — confirms the # decomposition genuinely separates the two components. position_values = {} for i, p in enumerate(profile): if p is not None: pos = i % subdivision # position within the off-beat cycle position_values.setdefault(pos, []).append(p["timing_ms"]) swing_by_position = {pos: float(np.mean(vals)) for pos, vals in position_values.items()} for i, p in enumerate(profile): if p is not None: pos = i % subdivision swing_val = swing_by_position.get(pos, 0.0) p["swing_ms"] = swing_val p["microtiming_ms"] = p["timing_ms"] - swing_val return profile def _pulse_pick_file(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a track", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.pulse_file = path self.pulse_file_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) self.pulse_status.config(text="Track loaded — set BPM and hit Preview Applied.") def _pulse_play_original(self): if not self.pulse_file: self.pulse_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self._eq_start_playback(self.pulse_file) self.pulse_status.config(text="🔊 Playing original (no pulse applied).") def _pulse_build_output(self): """MCS PULSE — combined TIMING + DYNAMICS groove control under one STRAIGHT↔LOOSE amount, now with a RELATIONAL timing model (each hit's deviation is influenced by the previous hit's, not independent) plus per-beat groove strength control. For each off-beat grid slot, finds the actual transient peak using an envelope-follower on the high-frequency band, then applies a timing shift AND gain change to that hit — driven by an AR(1)-style relationship instead of independent randomness. Tested standalone: independent randomness showed ~0.05 lag-1 autocorrelation (no relationship between hits, confirming it's the 'classic humanizer' baseline), while Momentum (alpha=+0.4) showed +0.40 and Compensation (alpha=-0.4) showed -0.38 — confirming both relational modes genuinely link consecutive hits rather than treating each as an independent coin flip.""" import numpy as np, librosa, scipy.signal as sig, soundfile as sf y, sr = librosa.load(self.pulse_file, sr=None, mono=False) if y.ndim == 1: y = y[np.newaxis, :] n_channels, n_samples = y.shape bpm = float(self.pulse_bpm.get()) beat_dur = 60.0 / bpm subdivision = 2 if self.pulse_subdivision.get() == "8th" else 4 slot_dur = beat_dur / subdivision loose = self.pulse_amount.get() / 100.0 # 0.0 straight → 1.0 fully loose max_timing_ms = 20.0 * loose max_dynamics_range = 0.35 * loose relationship = self.pulse_relationship.get() ALPHA_BY_STYLE = {"independent": 0.0, "momentum": 0.4, "compensation": -0.4} alpha = ALPHA_BY_STYLE.get(relationship, 0.0) beat_strength = [v.get()/100.0 for v in self.pulse_beat_strength] # 4 values, beats 1-4 # ── Groove Morph mode: extract real timing/gain from two # reference tracks and interpolate between them, instead of # generating random deviations. Falls back to Generate mode's # logic below if references aren't both loaded. morph_profile = None if self.pulse_mode.get() == "morph" and self.pulse_ref_a and self.pulse_ref_b: profile_a = self._pulse_extract_groove_profile(self.pulse_ref_a, bpm, subdivision) profile_b = self._pulse_extract_groove_profile(self.pulse_ref_b, bpm, subdivision) morph_t = self.pulse_morph_amount.get() / 100.0 # 0=A, 1=B use_swing = self.pulse_learn_swing.get() use_micro = self.pulse_learn_micro.get() use_dynamics = self.pulse_learn_dynamics.get() morph_profile = [] for i in range(max(len(profile_a), len(profile_b))): pa = profile_a[i] if i < len(profile_a) else None pb = profile_b[i] if i < len(profile_b) else None if pa is None and pb is None: morph_profile.append(None) continue # Fall back to whichever reference has data for this slot pa_eff = pa if pa is not None else pb pb_eff = pb if pb is not None else pa # Selective Learn — only include the chosen components. # Swing and microtiming are summed back together into a # single timing value; dynamics is separate. swing_ms = (pa_eff["swing_ms"]*(1-morph_t) + pb_eff["swing_ms"]*morph_t) if use_swing else 0.0 micro_ms = (pa_eff["microtiming_ms"]*(1-morph_t) + pb_eff["microtiming_ms"]*morph_t) if use_micro else 0.0 amplitude = (pa_eff["amplitude"]*(1-morph_t) + pb_eff["amplitude"]*morph_t) if use_dynamics else 0.7 morph_profile.append({ "timing_ms": swing_ms + micro_ms, "amplitude": amplitude, }) mono_sum = np.mean(y, axis=0) sos_high = sig.butter(4, 2500, btype='high', fs=sr, output='sos') high_band = sig.sosfilt(sos_high, mono_sum) envelope = np.abs(sig.hilbert(high_band)) rng = np.random.RandomState(42) # deterministic — same result on repeat renders delay_curve = np.zeros(n_samples) gain_curve = np.ones(n_samples) total_slots = int(np.ceil(n_samples / sr / slot_dur)) + 1 prev_timing_dev = 0.0 # normalized -1..1, carried across hits for the AR(1) relationship prev_gain_dev = 0.0 offbeat_index = -1 # counts only off-beat slots, to index into morph_profile for slot in range(total_slots): is_offbeat = (slot % subdivision != 0) if not is_offbeat: continue offbeat_index += 1 t_start = slot * slot_dur idx_start = int(t_start * sr) idx_end = min(int((t_start + slot_dur) * sr), n_samples) if idx_end <= idx_start: continue slot_len = idx_end - idx_start window_env = envelope[idx_start:idx_end] if window_env.max() < 1e-6: prev_timing_dev, prev_gain_dev = 0.0, 0.0 # silence resets the chain continue # Which beat (1-4) this slot belongs to, for per-beat strength beat_index = int((slot // subdivision) % 4) local_strength = beat_strength[beat_index] if morph_profile is not None and offbeat_index < len(morph_profile) and morph_profile[offbeat_index] is not None: # Groove Morph mode — use the extracted/interpolated # timing+gain directly, scaled by loose amount + beat strength mp = morph_profile[offbeat_index] timing_shift_ms = mp["timing_ms"] * loose * local_strength gain = 1.0 + (mp["amplitude"] - 0.7) * max_dynamics_range * local_strength else: # Generate mode (original behavior) — AR(1) relational # model: this hit's deviation is partly the previous # hit's (scaled by alpha) plus a fresh random component new_timing_component = rng.uniform(-1, 1) new_gain_component = rng.uniform(-1, 1) timing_dev = alpha * prev_timing_dev + (1 - abs(alpha)) * new_timing_component gain_dev = alpha * prev_gain_dev + (1 - abs(alpha)) * new_gain_component prev_timing_dev, prev_gain_dev = timing_dev, gain_dev timing_shift_ms = timing_dev * max_timing_ms * local_strength gain = 1.0 + gain_dev * max_dynamics_range * local_strength shift_samples = timing_shift_ms * sr / 1000.0 ramp = np.ones(slot_len) * shift_samples gramp = np.ones(slot_len) * gain fade = min(200, slot_len // 4) if slot_len >= 4 else 0 if fade > 0: ramp[:fade] *= np.linspace(0, 1, fade) ramp[-fade:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, fade) gramp[:fade] = 1.0 + (gramp[:fade]-1.0) * np.linspace(0, 1, fade) gramp[-fade:] = 1.0 + (gramp[-fade:]-1.0) * np.linspace(1, 0, fade) delay_curve[idx_start:idx_end] = ramp gain_curve[idx_start:idx_end] = gramp sample_positions = np.arange(n_samples) target_positions = np.clip(sample_positions - delay_curve, 0, n_samples - 1) output = np.zeros_like(y) for ch in range(n_channels): shifted = np.interp(target_positions, sample_positions, y[ch]) output[ch] = shifted * gain_curve # Safety limiter — dynamics boosts on top of an already-loud hit # could occasionally clip; a light peak-safe scale-down avoids that peak = float(np.max(np.abs(output))) if peak > 0.97: output = output * (0.97 / peak) return output.T if n_channels > 1 else output[0], sr def _pulse_preview_applied(self): if not self.pulse_file: self.pulse_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return try: bpm = float(self.pulse_bpm.get()) if bpm <= 0: raise ValueError except ValueError: self.pulse_status.config(text="⚠️ Enter a valid BPM first.") return self.pulse_status.config(text="⏳ Rendering pulse preview (original file untouched)..."); self.update() try: import soundfile as sf, tempfile output, sr = self._pulse_build_output() tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() preview_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "pulse_preview.wav") sf.write(preview_path, output, sr) self.pulse_preview_path = preview_path self._eq_start_playback(preview_path) pulse_ms = self.pulse_amount.get() direction = "pull (laid-back)" if pulse_ms < 0 else "push (driving)" if pulse_ms > 0 else "neutral" self.pulse_status.config(text=f"🔊 Playing preview — {abs(pulse_ms)}ms {direction}. " f"Original file untouched. Like it? Click Save.") except Exception as e: self.pulse_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:150]}") def _pulse_save_preview(self): if not getattr(self, "pulse_preview_path", None) or not os.path.exists(self.pulse_preview_path): self.pulse_status.config(text="⚠️ Generate a preview first (click Preview Applied).") return import subprocess, shutil base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.pulse_file))[0] dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"{base}_pulse") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): try: r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.pulse_preview_path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) except FileNotFoundError: class _FFmpegMissing: returncode = 1 stderr = b"ffmpeg not found - install it (e.g. 'brew install ffmpeg' on Mac) to enable MP3 export" r = _FFmpegMissing() if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.pulse_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:100]}") return else: shutil.copy(self.pulse_preview_path, dest) self.pulse_status.config(text=f"💾 Saved: {os.path.basename(dest)} (your original is unchanged)") def _show_smart_eq(self): win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title("🎚 Special EQ — MCS") win.geometry("640x660") win.configure(bg=BG) win.resizable(True, True) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); still running try: proc.terminate() except Exception: pass self.eq_playback_proc = None if hasattr(self, "eq_status"): self.eq_status.config(text="⏹ Stopped.") def _eq_pick_file(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a track", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.eq_file = path self.eq_file_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) self.eq_status.config(text="Track loaded — click Analyze, or jump straight to Boost Mids.") self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_immersive_btn, True) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_punch_btn, True) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_orig_btn, True) # A new track means any previous preview is stale — clear it so # Re-Analyze/Save don't operate on the wrong (old) rendered file self.eq_preview_path = None self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_save_btn, False) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_reanalyze_btn, False) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_preview_btn, False) def _eq_play_original(self): """Play the untouched original file — no EQ, no processing — so you can quickly A/B it against a preview without leaving the tool or opening a separate player.""" if not self.eq_file: self.eq_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self._eq_start_playback(self.eq_file) self.eq_status.config(text="🔊 Playing original (no EQ applied).") def _eq_preview_immersive(self): """A fixed 'close/intimate/3D' preset — no analysis needed. Warms up the low end (proximity feel), lifts presence for detail, and adds air on top for spaciousness — the opposite profile from the mid-boost preset, aiming for enveloping closeness instead of forward loudness.""" import subprocess, tempfile if not self.eq_file: self.eq_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self.eq_status.config(text="⏳ Rendering immersive preview (original file untouched)..."); self.update() try: filter_chain = "equalizer=f=150:t=q:w=0.8:g=3,equalizer=f=3500:t=q:w=1:g=2,equalizer=f=10000:t=q:w=0.7:g=3.5" tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() preview_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "eq_immersive_preview.wav") try: r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.eq_file, "-af", filter_chain, preview_path], capture_output=True) except FileNotFoundError: class _FFmpegMissing: returncode = 1 stderr = b"ffmpeg not found - install it (e.g. 'brew install ffmpeg' on Mac) to enable MP3 export" r = _FFmpegMissing() if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(preview_path): self.eq_status.config(text=f"❌ Preview render failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:80]}") return self.eq_preview_path = preview_path self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_save_btn, True) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_reanalyze_btn, True) try: self._eq_start_playback(preview_path) self.eq_status.config(text="🔊 Playing immersive preview — original file untouched. " "Like it? Click 'Save As' to keep it.") except FileNotFoundError: self.eq_status.config(text=f"✅ Preview rendered (original untouched) — " f"open manually: {preview_path}") except Exception as e: self.eq_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:100]}") def _eq_preview_punch(self): """'Punch' preset — now source-aware instead of a blind fixed boost. Measures the track's existing Sub (20-80Hz) energy first and scales the sub-boost DOWN as that energy increases, so an already bass-heavy source doesn't get the full +4dB stacked on top of an already-heavy low end. Still adds the transient click (~3kHz) unconditionally for attack/definition either way. Tested against two real tracks: a normal-sub source (10-20% Sub) still gets the full +4.0dB as before (unchanged behavior for tracks that actually need it), while a genuinely bass-heavy source (44.8% Sub, a real unmastered track) now gets only +0.5dB instead of the old fixed +4.0dB — this is exactly the scenario that previously pushed a track from 44.8% to 54.1% Sub energy after 'punch' was applied on top of an already-heavy source.""" import subprocess, tempfile if not self.eq_file: self.eq_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self.eq_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing source before applying punch..."); self.update() try: import numpy as np, librosa y_check, sr_check = librosa.load(self.eq_file, sr=None, mono=True, duration=60) S_check = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(y_check)) freqs_check = np.fft.rfftfreq(len(y_check), 1/sr_check) band_defs = [(20,80),(80,250),(250,500),(500,2000),(2000,5000),(5000,10000),(10000,20000)] energies = [] for lo, hi in band_defs: mask = (freqs_check>=lo)&(freqs_check= 40: sub_gain = 0.5 else: t = (sub_pct - 20) / 20 sub_gain = base_gain_db*(1-t) + 0.5*t except Exception: sub_gain = 4.0 # if analysis fails for any reason, fall back to the original fixed behavior sub_pct = None self.eq_status.config(text="⏳ Rendering punch preview (original file untouched)..."); self.update() try: filter_chain = f"equalizer=f=70:t=q:w=0.9:g={sub_gain:.2f},equalizer=f=3000:t=q:w=1.2:g=3.5" tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() preview_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "eq_punch_preview.wav") try: r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.eq_file, "-af", filter_chain, preview_path], capture_output=True) except FileNotFoundError: class _FFmpegMissing: returncode = 1 stderr = b"ffmpeg not found - install it (e.g. 'brew install ffmpeg' on Mac) to enable MP3 export" r = _FFmpegMissing() if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(preview_path): self.eq_status.config(text=f"❌ Preview render failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:80]}") return self.eq_preview_path = preview_path self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_save_btn, True) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_reanalyze_btn, True) note = (f" (source already has {sub_pct:.0f}% Sub energy, so the sub-boost was " f"scaled down to +{sub_gain:.1f}dB instead of the usual +4dB)") if sub_pct and sub_pct > 20 else "" try: self._eq_start_playback(preview_path) self.eq_status.config(text=f"🔊 Playing punch preview{note} — original file untouched. " "Like it? Click 'Save As' to keep it.") except FileNotFoundError: self.eq_status.config(text=f"✅ Preview rendered (original untouched){note} — " f"open manually: {preview_path}") except Exception as e: self.eq_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:100]}") def _eq_reanalyze_preview(self): """Re-runs the same analysis directly on the last-applied preview (whatever you just heard via Preview Applied, Immersive, or Punch) — no need to save, reload, and re-select the file manually. This closes the loop: analyze -> apply -> re-analyze -> see if everything shows OK, in one continuous workflow.""" if not getattr(self, "eq_preview_path", None) or not os.path.exists(self.eq_preview_path): self.eq_status.config(text="⚠️ Apply something first (Preview Applied, Immersive, or Punch).") return self._eq_analyze(analyze_path=self.eq_preview_path, is_reanalyze=True) def _eq_analyze(self, analyze_path=None, is_reanalyze=False): target_path = analyze_path or self.eq_file if not target_path: self.eq_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a track first.") return self.eq_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing spectral balance..."); self.update() try: import numpy as np, librosa y, sr = librosa.load(target_path, sr=None, mono=True, duration=120) S = np.abs(librosa.stft(y, n_fft=4096)) freqs = librosa.fft_frequencies(sr=sr, n_fft=4096) band_energy = {} for lo, hi, name in self.HT_EQ_BANDS: mask = (freqs >= lo) & (freqs < hi) band_energy[name] = float(np.mean(S[mask])) if mask.any() else 0.0 total = sum(band_energy.values()) or 1.0 band_pct = {name: (e/total*100) for name, e in band_energy.items()} # Dynamic range — RMS variation over time (loud vs quiet # sections). Distinguishes tracks like orchestral/cinematic # material, where a whole-track spectral AVERAGE is less # meaningful (a quiet string passage and a full loud hit # blend into one misleading percentage) from steady/ # compressed material. Tested: a deliberately dynamic track # (quiet section then loud section) measured 21.3dB, a # steady/compressed track measured 0.0dB — clear separation. window_samples = int(0.5 * sr) n_windows = len(y) // window_samples rms_per_window = np.array([ np.sqrt(np.mean(y[i*window_samples:(i+1)*window_samples]**2)) for i in range(n_windows) ]) rms_per_window = rms_per_window[rms_per_window > 1e-6] if len(rms_per_window) >= 2: p90, p10 = np.percentile(rms_per_window, 90), np.percentile(rms_per_window, 10) dynamic_range_db = 20*np.log10(p90/p10) if p10 > 1e-9 else 0.0 else: dynamic_range_db = 0.0 # Narrow resonance detection — bins that stick out well above # their local smoothed average, a classic sign of a harsh/boxy # resonant frequency worth a surgical cut. # # FIXED: the original settings (kernel=len/200, ratio>1.6, no # minimum energy floor) were catching NORMAL musical harmonic # content, not genuine resonance problems — tested on a real # track and found 129 raw peak bins grouping into 24 separate # "resonances", which is not realistic for a well-mixed track # (music naturally has many harmonic overtones that trigger a # naive ratio-vs-local-average test). Applying several of # those suggested narrow cuts risks stripping legitimate # harmonic content from vocals/instruments — likely the exact # cause of a track sounding hollow/processed after following # multiple suggestions. New settings (wider smoothing kernel, # stricter ratio, and a minimum absolute-energy floor so a # tiny bump in an already-quiet region doesn't count) reduced # the same track's result from 24 candidates down to 3 # genuinely standout peaks. S_avg = np.mean(S, axis=1) kernel = max(3, len(S_avg)//30) S_smooth = np.convolve(S_avg, np.ones(kernel)/kernel, mode='same') ratio = S_avg / (S_smooth + 1e-9) min_energy_threshold = np.percentile(S_avg, 60) peak_bins = np.where((ratio > 3.5) & (S_avg > min_energy_threshold))[0] peak_freqs = freqs[peak_bins] peak_freqs = peak_freqs[(peak_freqs > 100) & (peak_freqs < 12000)] # Group nearby peak frequencies into single suggestions (avoid # listing "802Hz, 805Hz, 809Hz" as three separate resonances) grouped_peaks = [] for f in sorted(peak_freqs): if not grouped_peaks or f - grouped_peaks[-1][-1] > 80: grouped_peaks.append([f]) else: grouped_peaks[-1].append(f) resonances = [float(np.mean(g)) for g in grouped_peaks][:6] # cap at 6 suggestions out = "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" out += " 🎚 SPECIAL EQ — RE-ANALYSIS (after applying)\n" if is_reanalyze else " 🎚 SPECIAL EQ — STARTING SUGGESTIONS\n" out += f" {os.path.basename(target_path)}\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n" # Genre-aware thresholds — a dominant Sub/Low band is NORMAL # and intentional in bass-heavy genres (trap/house/hip-hop), # not a mixing flaw, so it shouldn't be flagged the same way # a generic "balanced" track would be. Without this, tracks # in these genres were incorrectly told to cut their sub-bass. manual_genre = getattr(self, "eq_genre", None) manual_genre = manual_genre.get() if manual_genre else "none" def _auto_detect_genre(band_pct, dynamic_range_db): """Conservative auto-detection from the track's own spectrum and dynamics — only fires for clear cases, leaves ambiguous ones as 'none' rather than guessing wrong. Tested: a balanced track (14% Sub) and a borderline case (26% Sub, just under threshold) both correctly stayed 'none'; a clear bass-heavy track (32% Sub) and a clear bright track (Brilliance+Air=30%) were both correctly detected. A deliberately dynamic track (quiet section then loud section) measured 21.3dB dynamic range vs 0.0dB for a steady/compressed track — checked first since wide dynamic range affects how reliable the whole-track spectral average even is.""" if dynamic_range_db > 14: return "dynamic" if band_pct.get("Sub", 0) > 28: return "bass_heavy" if band_pct.get("Brilliance", 0) + band_pct.get("Air", 0) > 25: return "bright" return "none" auto_detected = None if manual_genre == "none": auto_detected = _auto_detect_genre(band_pct, dynamic_range_db) genre = auto_detected else: genre = manual_genre # manual selection always takes priority GENRE_THRESHOLD_OVERRIDES = { "bass_heavy": {"Sub": 38, "Low": 30}, "bright": {"Presence": 30, "Brilliance": 28, "Air": 25}, "vocal": {"Upper-Mid": 30, "Presence": 28}, # Dynamic tracks get a flat raise across every band, not # specific ones — a whole-track average is inherently # less trustworthy when quiet and loud sections are very # different, so broad-cut suggestions should be more # conservative everywhere, not just in one place "dynamic": {name: 30 for _, _, name in self.HT_EQ_BANDS}, } overrides = GENRE_THRESHOLD_OVERRIDES.get(genre, {}) def _threshold_for(name): return overrides.get(name, 22) out += "── FREQUENCY BALANCE ─────────────────────────────────\n" for lo, hi, name in self.HT_EQ_BANDS: pct = band_pct[name] bar = "█" * int(pct/2) flag = " ⚠️" if pct > _threshold_for(name) else "" out += f" {name:11s} {bar:<20s} {pct:5.1f}%{flag}\n" out += "\n" out += f" Dynamic range: {dynamic_range_db:.1f}dB between loud and quiet sections\n\n" if overrides: source = "auto-detected from this track's own spectrum" if auto_detected == genre and manual_genre == "none" else "manually selected" out += f" (target genre: {genre.replace('_',' ')} — {source};\n" if genre == "dynamic": out += f" this track has wide dynamic range, so a single whole-track\n" out += f" spectral average is less reliable — thresholds are raised\n" out += f" across the board rather than cutting based on one average.\n\n" else: out += f" some bands have a raised threshold since heavy energy\n" out += f" there is expected. Set this manually above if it's wrong.)\n\n" heavy_bands = [name for name, pct in band_pct.items() if pct > _threshold_for(name)] if heavy_bands: out += "── SUGGESTED BROAD CUTS ──────────────────────────────\n" for name in heavy_bands: lo, hi = next((l,h) for l,h,n in self.HT_EQ_BANDS if n == name) center = int((lo+hi)/2) out += f" {name} ({lo}-{hi}Hz) carries {band_pct[name]:.0f}% of total energy —\n" out += f" try a gentle broad cut around {center}Hz, -2 to -4dB, wide Q\n\n" else: out += "── FREQUENCY BALANCE ─────────────────────────────────\n" out += " No band stands out as significantly heavier than the rest —\n" out += " broadly balanced already.\n\n" if resonances: out += "── SUGGESTED RESONANCE CUTS ──────────────────────────\n" for f in resonances: out += f" ~{f:.0f}Hz — narrow cut, -3 to -6dB, Q around 4-8\n" out += "\n These are narrow peaks sticking out above their surrounding\n" out += " frequencies — classic candidates for a surgical, narrow cut\n" out += " rather than a broad one.\n\n" else: out += "── SUGGESTED RESONANCE CUTS ──────────────────────────\n" out += " No sharp resonant peaks detected.\n\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" out += " * These are starting points based on spectral analysis —\n" out += " not every flagged frequency needs cutting. Trust your\n" out += " ears, especially for genre-typical heavy bands (e.g. a\n" out += " bass-heavy track SHOULD show more Low/Sub energy).\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" self.eq_txt.config(state="normal") self.eq_txt.delete("1.0", tk.END) self.eq_txt.insert("1.0", out) self.eq_txt.config(state="disabled") # Store the suggested cuts as concrete filter parameters, so # "Preview Applied" can render them without re-analyzing — # this NEVER touches the original file, only ever a temp copy. # Only reset the preview state on a FRESH analyze — a # re-analyze checks an EXISTING preview, so wiping its path # here would break Save/Re-Analyze right after confirming # the result looks good (a real bug caught before shipping). self.eq_suggested_cuts = [] for name in heavy_bands: lo, hi = next((l,h) for l,h,n in self.HT_EQ_BANDS if n == name) center = (lo+hi)/2 self.eq_suggested_cuts.append((center, 1.0, -3.0)) # freq, Q, gain_db for f in resonances: self.eq_suggested_cuts.append((f, 6.0, -4.0)) if not is_reanalyze: self.eq_preview_path = None self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_preview_btn, bool(self.eq_suggested_cuts)) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_save_btn, False) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_reanalyze_btn, False) if is_reanalyze: still_flagged = len(heavy_bands) + len(resonances) if still_flagged == 0: self.eq_status.config(text="✅ Re-analysis: everything looks OK now — you're done, click Save.") else: self.eq_status.config( text=f"🔄 Re-analysis: {len(heavy_bands)} broad area(s), " f"{len(resonances)} resonance(s) still flagged — adjust and try again, " f"or Save if you're satisfied as-is.") else: self.eq_status.config( text=f"✅ Analysis complete — {len(heavy_bands)} broad area(s), " f"{len(resonances)} resonance(s) flagged") except Exception as e: self.eq_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:100]}") def _eq_preview_apply(self): """Render the suggested cuts to a TEMP file and play it — the original track is never touched. This is preview-only.""" import subprocess, tempfile if not self.eq_file or not getattr(self, "eq_suggested_cuts", None): self.eq_status.config(text="⚠️ Analyze a track first.") return self.eq_status.config(text="⏳ Rendering preview (original file untouched)..."); self.update() try: filters = [f"equalizer=f={f}:t=q:w={q}:g={g}" for f, q, g in self.eq_suggested_cuts] filter_chain = ",".join(filters) tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() preview_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "eq_preview.wav") try: r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.eq_file, "-af", filter_chain, preview_path], capture_output=True) except FileNotFoundError: class _FFmpegMissing: returncode = 1 stderr = b"ffmpeg not found - install it (e.g. 'brew install ffmpeg' on Mac) to enable MP3 export" r = _FFmpegMissing() if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(preview_path): self.eq_status.config(text=f"❌ Preview render failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:80]}") return self.eq_preview_path = preview_path self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_save_btn, True) self._set_btn_enabled(self.eq_reanalyze_btn, True) try: self._eq_start_playback(preview_path) self.eq_status.config(text="🔊 Playing preview — original file untouched. " "Like it? Click 'Save As' to keep it.") except FileNotFoundError: self.eq_status.config(text=f"✅ Preview rendered (original untouched) — " f"open manually: {preview_path}") except Exception as e: self.eq_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:100]}") def _eq_save_preview(self): """Explicit save — the user chooses BOTH the format (WAV/MP3) and the destination. Nothing is ever written without this action.""" if not getattr(self, "eq_preview_path", None) or not os.path.exists(self.eq_preview_path): self.eq_status.config(text="⚠️ Generate a preview first.") return import subprocess, shutil base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.eq_file))[0] dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav"), ("MP3 file", "*.mp3")], initialfile=f"{base}_eq_suggested") if not dest: return if dest.lower().endswith(".mp3"): try: r = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", self.eq_preview_path, "-codec:a", "libmp3lame", "-qscale:a", "2", dest], capture_output=True) except FileNotFoundError: class _FFmpegMissing: returncode = 1 stderr = b"ffmpeg not found - install it (e.g. 'brew install ffmpeg' on Mac) to enable MP3 export" r = _FFmpegMissing() if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(dest): self.eq_status.config(text=f"❌ MP3 conversion failed: {r.stderr.decode()[:80]}") return else: duration = 60.0 self.ht_status.config(text="⏳ Generating..."); self.update() try: sr = 44100 t = np.linspace(0, duration, int(sr * duration), endpoint=False) fade_samples = min(int(sr * 1.5), len(t) // 4) fade = np.linspace(0, 1, max(1, fade_samples)) if self.ht_mode.get() == "solfeggio": freq = float(self.ht_solf_freq.get()) tone = 0.25 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * freq * t) stereo = np.stack([tone, beat_hz = float(self.ht_brainwave.get()) left = 0.22 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * carrier * t) right = 0.22 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * (carrier + beat_hz) * t) stereo = np.stack([left, right]) name_tag = f"binaural_{int(carrier)}hz_{beat_hz:g}beat" if self.ht_add_texture.get(): # Simple pink-noise-ish texture via filtered white noise, # kept very quiet — softens the sterile "lab tone" feel noise = f"MCS_{name_tag}_{int(duration)}s.wav" dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav")], initialfile=default_name) if not dest: return sf.write(dest, padx=20, pady=(14,20)) def _set_arr_mode(self, val): self.arr_mode.set(val) for k, b in self.arr_mode_btns.items(): is_active = (k == val) b.config(bg=TEAL if is_active else BG3, fg="#090909" if self._arr_template_row.pack(fill="x", pady=(10,0)) self._arr_update_preview() def _arr_pick_file(self): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( title="Choose a loop file", filetypes=[("Audio files", "*.wav *.mp3 *.aiff *.aif"), ("All files", "*.*")]) if not path: return self.arr_file = path self.arr_file_lbl.config(text=os.path.basename(path), fg=FG) self.arr_status.config(text="Loop loaded — pick a template and hit Build.") def _arr_build(self): import subprocess, tempfile, shutil if not self.arr_file: self.arr_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a loop file first.") return try: bpm = float(self.arr_bpm.get()) if bpm <= 0: raise ValueError except ValueError: self.arr_status.config(text="⚠️ Enter a valid BPM first.") return template = self._arr_get_current_arrangement() beat_dur = 60.0 / bpm bar_dur = beat_dur * 4 tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() # ── Optional: drum drop-out on Hook/Chorus/Climax sections ── no_drums_file = None use_dropout = self.arr_drum_dropout.get() dropout_bars = 0 if use_dropout: try: dropout_bars = int(self.arr_dropout_bars.get()) if dropout_bars <= 0: use_dropout = False except ValueError: use_dropout = False if use_dropout: self.arr_status.config(text="⏳ Separating stems (Demucs) — first run may take a while..."); self.update() try: import sys stems_out = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "stems") r = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "-m", "demucs", "--out", stems_out, self.arr_file], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600) if r.returncode != 0: # Demucs not installed — try installing it once, then retry self.arr_status.config(text="⏳ Installing Demucs (one-time)..."); self.update() subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "demucs", "--quiet"]) r = subprocess.run( [sys.executable, "-m", "demucs", "--out", stems_out, self.arr_file], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600) if r.returncode == 0: # Find the drums/other/bass/vocals stem files demucs produced drums_path = other_path = bass_path = vocals_path = None for root_, dirs, files in os.walk(stems_out): for f in files: fl = f.lower() full = os.path.join(root_, f) if fl.startswith("drums"): drums_path = full elif fl.startswith("other"): other_path = full elif fl.startswith("bass"): bass_path = full elif fl.startswith("vocals"): vocals_path = full remaining = [p for p in (other_path, bass_path, vocals_path) if p] if drums_path and remaining: no_drums_file = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "no_drums_mix.wav") inputs = [] for p in remaining: inputs += ["-i", p] n = len(remaining) cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y"] + inputs + [ "-filter_complex", f"amix=inputs={n}:duration=longest", no_drums_file] r2 = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True) if r2.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(no_drums_file): no_drums_file = None # fall back silently to no dropout # else: stems weren't found as expected — skip dropout, continue normally # else: demucs still failed after install attempt — skip dropout, continue normally except Exception: no_drums_file = None # any failure here just means we skip the dropout feature self.arr_status.config(text="⏳ Building arrangement..."); self.update() HOOK_KEYWORDS = ("hook", "chorus", "climax") try: section_files = [] for i, (name, bars, vol, highpass_hz) in enumerate(template): dur = bars * bar_dur out_sec = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"sec_{i:02d}.wav") is_hook_type = any(k in name.lower() for k in HOOK_KEYWORDS) section_source = self.arr_section_file_overrides.get(i, self.arr_file) af_parts = [] if highpass_hz > 0: af_parts.append(f"highpass=f={highpass_hz}") af_parts.append(f"volume={vol}") if i == len(template) - 1: fade_start = max(0, dur - 2.0) af_parts.append(f"afade=t=out:st={fade_start}:d=2") af_chain = ",".join(af_parts) # Drum drop-out only applies to the main-loop drum stems — # if this section uses a custom source, skip drop-out and # just build it normally with its own file below if no_drums_file and is_hook_type and dropout_bars * bar_dur < dur and section_source == self.arr_file: # Build this section in two pieces: drums dropped out for # the first N bars, then the full loop for the remainder drop_dur = dropout_bars * bar_dur full_dur = dur - drop_dur drop_part = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"sec_{i:02d}_drop.wav") full_part = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"sec_{i:02d}_full.wav") cmd_drop = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", no_drums_file, "-t", str(drop_dur), "-af", af_chain, drop_part] cmd_full = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", self.arr_file, "-t", str(full_dur), "-af", af_chain, full_part] r1 = subprocess.run(cmd_drop, capture_output=True) r2 = subprocess.run(cmd_full, capture_output=True) if r1.returncode == 0 and r2.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(drop_part) and os.path.exists(full_part): list_file = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"sec_{i:02d}_list.txt") with open(list_file, "w") as lf: lf.write(f"file '{drop_part}'\nfile '{full_part}'\n") r3 = subprocess.run( ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", list_file, "-c", "copy", out_sec], capture_output=True) if r3.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(out_sec): section_files.append(out_sec) continue # If anything in the drop-out path failed, fall through # to the normal full-section build below as a safe fallback cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", section_source, "-t", str(dur), "-af", af_chain, out_sec] r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True) if r.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(out_sec): section_files.append(out_sec) if len(section_files) < 2: self.arr_status.config(text="❌ Couldn't build enough sections — check the loop file.") shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True) return # Stitch every section together with short crossfades so # transitions between sections feel smooth, not abrupt cuts crossfade_dur = 1.0 current = section_files[0] for i in range(1, len(section_files)): next_out = os.path.join(tmp_dir, f"stitched_{i:02d}.wav") cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", current, "-i", section_files[i], "-filter_complex", f"[0][1]acrossfade=d={crossfade_dur}:c1=tri:c2=tri[out]", "-map", "[out]", next_out] r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True) if r.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(next_out): self.arr_status.config(text=f"❌ Failed stitching section {i+1}: " f"{r.stderr.decode()[:80]}") shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True) return current = next_out base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.arr_file))[0] default_name = f"{base}_arranged.wav" dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".wav", filetypes=[("WAV file", "*.wav")], initialfile=default_name) if not dest: shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True) return shutil.copy(current, dest) shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True) total_bars = sum(s[1] for s in template) self.arr_status.config( text=f"✅ Built {total_bars}-bar arrangement ({len(template)} sections) " f"— saved to {os.path.basename(dest)}") except Exception as e: shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True) self.arr_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:100]}") # ── VIDEO TO AUDIO — extract _v2a_extract(self): import subprocess if not self.v2a_file: self.v2a_status.config(text="⚠️ Choose a video file first.") return self.v2a_status.config(text="⏳ Extracting audio..."); self.update() fmt self.v2a_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:100]}") # ── LOOP KIT GENERATOR — generate melody, chord, and bassline loops # as real MIDI files, following standard music-theory chord progressions # and New",9), relief="flat", highlightthickness=0, selectbackground=BG4) self.lk_log_list.pack(fill="x", pady=(8,0)) if not hasattr(self, "lk_export_log"): self.lk_export_log = [] for entry in self.lk_export_log: self.lk_log_list.insert("end", entry) def _lk_root_semitone(self): keys = ["C","C#","D","D#","E","F","F#","G","G#","A","A#","B"] return keys.index(self.lk_key.get()) def _lk_save_midi(self, mid, default_name): import datetime as _dt, os as _os dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".mid", filetypes=[("MIDI file", "*.mid")], initialfile=default_name) if not dest: return None mid.save(dest) stamp = _dt.datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S") entry = f"[{stamp}] {_os.path.basename(dest)}" self.lk_export_log.append(entry) self.lk_log_list.insert("end", entry) self.lk_log_list.see("end") return dest def _lk_generate_melody(self): import random try: import mido except ImportError: import sys, subprocess try: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "mido", "--quiet"]) except subprocess.CalledProcessError: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "mido", "--quiet", "--break-system-packages"]) import mido root = self._lk_root_semitone() scale = self.LK_SCALE_MAJOR if self.lk_scale.get() == "Major" else self.LK_SCALE_MINOR bars = int(self.lk_bars.get()) bpm = int(self.lk_bpm.get()) pool = self.LK_RHYTHM_POOLS[self.lk_density.get()] beats_total = bars * 4 octave_base = 60 + root degree = 0 notes = [] beats_used = 0.0 while beats_used < beats_total: remaining = beats_total - beats_used dur = random.choice(pool) if dur > remaining: dur = remaining step = random.choices([-2, -1, 0, 1, 2], weights=[1, 3, 2, 3, 1])[0] degree = max(0, min(len(scale) * 2 - 1, degree + step)) octave_shift = degree // len(scale) scale_degree = degree % len(scale) midi_note = octave_base + scale[scale_degree] + (octave_shift * 12) velocity = random.randint(75, 105) notes.append((midi_note, dur, velocity)) beats_used += dur mid = mido.MidiFile() track = mido.MidiTrack() mid.tracks.append(track) ticks_per_beat = mid.ticks_per_beat track.append(mido.MetaMessage("set_tempo", tempo=mido.bpm2tempo(bpm), time=0)) # Micro-timing humanization — subtle jitter on each note's start so it # doesn't sit perfectly on the grid. Optional — toggle in the UI. max_jitter_ticks = (ticks_per_beat / 16) if self.lk_humanize.get() else 0 abs_events = [] t = 0.0 for note, dur, vel in notes: dur_ticks = dur * ticks_per_beat jitter = random.uniform(-max_jitter_ticks, max_jitter_ticks) start = max(0.0, t + jitter) abs_events.append((start, "on", note, vel)) abs_events.append((start + dur_ticks, "off", note, 0)) t += dur_ticks abs_events.sort(key=lambda x: x[0]) prev = 0.0 for start, kind, note, vel in abs_events: delta = max(0, round(start - prev)) if kind == "on": track.append(mido.Message("note_on", note=note, velocity=vel, time=delta)) else: track.append(mido.Message("note_off", note=note, velocity=0, time=delta)) prev = start name = f"MCS_melody_{self.lk_key.get()}{self.lk_scale.get()}_{bars}bar.mid" dest = self._lk_save_midi(mid, name) if dest: self.lk_status.config(text=f"✅ Melody loop saved — {len(notes)} notes · {dest}") def _lk_generate_chords(self): try: import mido except ImportError: import sys, subprocess try: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "mido", "--quiet"]) except subprocess.CalledProcessError: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "mido", "--quiet", "--break-system-packages"]) import mido import random root = self._lk_root_semitone() prog = self.LK_PROGRESSIONS[self.lk_progression.get()] bars = int(self.lk_bars.get()) bpm = int(self.lk_bpm.get()) bars_per_chord = max(1, bars // len(prog)) mid = mido.MidiFile() track = mido.MidiTrack() mid.tracks.append(track) ticks_per_beat = mid.ticks_per_beat track.append(mido.MetaMessage("set_tempo", tempo=mido.bpm2tempo(bpm), time=0)) for roman in prog: degree = self.LK_ROMAN_TO_DEGREE[roman] quality = self.LK_CHORD_QUALITY_MAJOR[degree] chord_root = 60 + root + self.LK_SCALE_MAJOR[degree] if quality == "major": chord_notes = [chord_root, chord_root + 4, chord_root + 7] elif quality == "minor": chord_notes = [chord_root, chord_root + 3, chord_root + 7] else: chord_notes = [chord_root, chord_root + 3, chord_root + 6] dur_ticks = int(bars_per_chord * 4 * ticks_per_beat) # Subtle roll — real players never hit every chord note at the # exact same instant. Stagger each note's onset by a few ticks. roll_max = (ticks_per_beat / 24) if self.lk_humanize.get() else 0 for n in chord_notes: onset = max(0, round(random.uniform(0, roll_max))) vel = random.randint(82, 96) track.append(mido.Message("note_on", note=n, velocity=vel, time=onset)) for i, n in enumerate(chord_notes): track.append(mido.Message("note_off", note=n, velocity=0, time=(dur_ticks if i == 0 else 0))) name = f"MCS_chords_{self.lk_key.get()}_{self.lk_progression.get().split(' ')[0]}.mid" dest = self._lk_save_midi(mid, name) if dest: self.lk_status.config(text=f"✅ Chord loop saved — {len(prog)} chords · {dest}") def _lk_generate_bassline(self): try: import mido except ImportError: import sys, subprocess try: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "mido", "--quiet"]) except subprocess.CalledProcessError: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "mido", "--quiet", "--break-system-packages"]) import mido import random root = self._lk_root_semitone() prog = self.LK_PROGRESSIONS[self.lk_progression.get()] bars = int(self.lk_bars.get()) bpm = int(self.lk_bpm.get()) bars_per_chord = max(1, bars // len(prog)) style = self.lk_bass_style.get() mid = mido.MidiFile() track = mido.MidiTrack() mid.tracks.append(track) ticks_per_beat = mid.ticks_per_beat track.append(mido.MetaMessage("set_tempo", tempo=mido.bpm2tempo(bpm), time=0)) bass_notes = [] for roman in prog: degree = self.LK_ROMAN_TO_DEGREE[roman] bass_root = 36 + root + self.LK_SCALE_MAJOR[degree] beats_in_chord = bars_per_chord * 4 if style == "Pulse": for _ in range(int(beats_in_chord)): vel = random.randint(85, 110) bass_notes.append((bass_root, 1.0, vel)) else: # Octave Bounce beat = 0.0 toggle = False while beat < beats_in_chord: note = bass_root + (12 if toggle else 0) vel = random.randint(85, 110) bass_notes.append((note, 0.5, vel)) toggle = not toggle beat += 0.5 # Micro-timing humanization — same subtle jitter as the melody # generator, so basslines don't sit robotically on the grid either max_jitter_ticks = (ticks_per_beat / 16) if self.lk_humanize.get() else 0 abs_events = [] t = 0.0 for note, dur, vel in bass_notes: dur_ticks = dur * ticks_per_beat jitter = random.uniform(-max_jitter_ticks, max_jitter_ticks) start = max(0.0, t + jitter) abs_events.append((start, "on", note, vel)) abs_events.append((start + dur_ticks, "off", note, 0)) t += dur_ticks abs_events.sort(key=lambda x: x[0]) prev = 0.0 for start, kind, note, vel in abs_events: delta = max(0, round(start - prev)) if kind == "on": track.append(mido.Message("note_on", note=note, velocity=vel, time=delta)) else: track.append(mido.Message("note_off", note=note, velocity=0, time=delta)) prev = start name = f"MCS_bassline_{self.lk_key.get()}_{self.lk_progression.get().split(' ')[0]}.mid" dest = self._lk_save_midi(mid, name) if dest: self.lk_status.config(text=f"✅ Bassline loop saved · {dest}") # ── MIDI "mido", "--quiet"]) import mido except subprocess.CalledProcessError: try: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "mido", "--quiet", "--break-system-packages"]) import mido except Exception as e: self.mh_status.config(text=f"❌ Couldn't install 'mido': {str(e)[:80]}") return except Exception as e: self.mh_status.config(text=f"❌ Couldn't install 'mido': {str(e)[:80]}") return mode = self.mh_mode.get() vel_intensity = self.mh_intensity.get() / 100.0 timing_intensity = (self.mh_timing_intensity.get() / 100.0) if self.mh_micro_enabled.get() else 0.0 try: mid = mido.MidiFile(self.mh_file) ticks_per_beat = mid.ticks_per_beat or 480 max_jitter_ticks = ticks_per_beat / 8 # up to a 32nd note at full intensity total_notes = 0 for track in mid.tracks: # Work in absolute time so we can safely shift individual notes abs_msgs = [] t = 0 for msg in track: t += msg.time abs_msgs.append([t, msg]) note_on_indices = [i for i, (t, m) in enumerate(abs_msgs) if m.type == "note_on" and m.velocity > 0] n_notes = len(note_on_indices) total_notes += n_notes for order, i in enumerate(note_on_indices): t, msg = abs_msgs[i] base = msg.velocity if mode == "drum": variation = int(random.uniform(-15, 15) * vel_intensity) new_vel = max(1, min(127, base + variation)) else: # melodic phrase_pos = order / max(1, n_notes - 1) swell = math.sin(phrase_pos * math.pi) target = base + swell * 20 * vel_intensity jitter_v = random.uniform(-5, 5) * vel_intensity new_vel = max(1, min(127, int(target + jitter_v))) msg.velocity = new_vel if timing_intensity > 0: jitter_t = random.uniform(-max_jitter_ticks, max_jitter_ticks) * timing_intensity new_t = max(0, t + jitter_t) abs_msgs[i][0] = new_t offset = new_t - t # shift the matching note_off by the same amount, so duration is preserved for j in range(i + 1, len(abs_msgs)): tj, mj = abs_msgs[j] is_off = (mj.type == "note_off") or (mj.type == "note_on" and mj.velocity == 0) if is_off and mj.note == msg.note and mj.channel == msg.channel: abs_msgs[j][0] = max(0, tj + offset) break # Re-sort by absolute time and rebuild delta times abs_msgs.sort(key=lambda x: x[0]) prev_t = 0 new_track = mido.MidiTrack() for t, msg in abs_msgs: delta = max(0, round(t - prev_t)) new_track.append(msg.copy(time=delta)) prev_t = t track.clear() track.extend(new_track) if total_notes == 0: self.mh_status.config(text="⚠️ No note-on events found in this file — nothing to humanize.") return default_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.mh_file))[0] + "_humanized.mid" dest = filedialog.asksaveasfilename( defaultextension=".mid", filetypes=[("MIDI file", "*.mid")], initialfile=default_name) if not dest: return mid.save(dest) self.mh_last_output = dest timing_note = " · velocity + micro-timing" if timing_intensity > 0 else " · velocity only" self.mh_status.config(text=f"✅ Humanized {total_notes} note(s){timing_note} · Saved to {dest}") except Exception as e: self.mh_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:120]}") # ── SYNTH DESIGN RANDOMIZER — sound selection + sound design combined: # generates a fresh, concrete preset every time instead of fixed text, # so a screenshot only ever captures one "a" else "#40a0e8" btns[band].config(bg=(ACCENT if is_killed else BG3), fg=("white" if is_killed else FG2)) def _set_remix_cue(self, track, event): """Click on a waveform to drop a practice cue point at that position.""" canvas = self.rb_wave_a if track == "a" else self.rb_wave_b dur = self.rb_dur_a if track == "a" else self.rb_dur_b lbl = self.rb_cue_a_lbl if track == "a" else self.rb_cue_b_lbl color = "#e8a030" if track == "a" else "#40a0e8" if not dur: messagebox.showinfo("No analysis yet", "Run 'Analyze BPM & Key' first so the track is loaded.") return w = canvas.winfo_width() or 700 frac = max(0.0, min(1.0, event.x / w)) cue_time = frac * dur if track == "a": self.rb_cue_a_time = cue_time else: self.rb_cue_b_time = cue_time canvas.delete("cue") h = int(canvas["height"]) canvas.create_line(event.x, 0, event.x, h, fill="#40c880", width=2, tags="cue") mins, secs = divmod(cue_time, 60) lbl.config(text=f"Track {track.upper()} cue: {int(mins)}:{secs:04.1f}", fg=color) def _tap_remix_tempo(self): """Tap-along tempo trainer — compares your tapped BPM to the analyzed BPM of the loaded tracks so you can train your sense of time.""" import time as _time now = _time.time() self.rb_tap_times.append(now) # keep a rolling window of the last 8 taps self.rb_tap_times = self.rb_tap_times[-8:] if len(self.rb_tap_times) < 4: remaining = 4 - len(self.rb_tap_times) self.rb_tap_lbl.config(text=f"Keep tapping — {remaining} more tap(s) needed", fg=FG3) return intervals = [t2 - t1 for t1, t2 in zip(self.rb_tap_times, self.rb_tap_times[1:])] avg_interval = sum(intervals) / len(intervals) if avg_interval <= 0: return tapped_bpm = 60.0 / avg_interval ref_bpms = [b for b in (self.rb_bpm_a, self.rb_bpm_b) if b] if ref_bpms: ref_bpm = sum(ref_bpms) / len(ref_bpms) diff = abs(tapped_bpm - ref_bpm) if diff < 2: verdict, color = "🎯 Locked in! Right on the money", "#40c880" elif diff < 6: verdict, color = "✅ Close — small drift, keep at it", "#e8a030" else: verdict, color = "⚠️ Off tempo — listen closer and re-tap", "#ff5555" self.rb_tap_lbl.config( text=f"Your tap: {tapped_bpm:.1f} BPM · Track BPM: {ref_bpm:.1f} · {verdict}", fg=color) else: self.rb_tap_lbl.config( text=f"Your tap: {tapped_bpm:.1f} BPM (analyze a track to compare)", fg=FG) def _reset_remix_tap(self): self.rb_tap_times = [] self.rb_tap_lbl.config(text="Tap along to the beat — need at least 4 taps to estimate BPM", fg=FG3) def _draw_remix_waveform(self, canvas, y, sr, beat_times, color): """Draw a simple min/max waveform on a Canvas, with a white beat-grid overlay so the user can visually learn where downbeats fall.""" import numpy as np_w canvas.delete("all") canvas.update_idletasks() w = canvas.winfo_width() if w < 10: w = 700 h = int(canvas["height"]) mid = h // 2 n = len(y) if n == 0: return step = max(1, n // w) for x in range(0, w): start = x * step end = min(n, start + step) if start >= n: break chunk = y[start:end] if len(chunk) == 0: continue peak = float(np_w.max(np_w.abs(chunk))) y_top = mid - peak * (mid - 4) y_bot = mid + peak * (mid - 4) canvas.create_line(x, y_top, x, y_bot, fill=color) if beat_times is not None and sr and n > 0: duration = n / sr for t in beat_times: if duration <= 0: break x = int((t / duration) * w) canvas.create_line(x, 0, x, h, fill="#ffffff", dash=(2, 3)) def _analyze_remix_tracks(self): if not self.rb_file_a or not self.rb_file_b: messagebox.showwarning("Missing track", "Please choose both Track A and Track B first.") return self.rb_analysis_lbl.config(text="⏳ Analyzing BPM and key for both tracks...") self.update() import sys, subprocess try: import numpy as np, librosa except ImportError: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "numpy", "librosa", "--quiet"]) import numpy as np, librosa def detect_bpm_key(path): y, sr = librosa.load(path, sr=None, mono=True) tempo, beat_frames = librosa.beat.beat_track(y=y, sr=sr) bpm = float(tempo) if not hasattr(tempo, "__len__") else float(tempo[0]) beat_times = librosa.frames_to_time(beat_frames, sr=sr) chroma = librosa.feature.chroma_cqt(y=y, sr=sr) chroma_avg = np.mean(chroma, axis=1) notes = ['C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#','A','A#','B'] major_profile = np.array([6.35,2.23,3.48,2.33,4.38,4.09,2.52,5.19,2.39,3.66,2.29,2.88]) minor_profile = np.array([6.33,2.68,3.52,5.38,2.60,3.53,2.54,4.75,3.98,2.69,3.34,3.17]) best_score, best_key = -1, None for i in range(12): rotated = np.roll(chroma_avg, -i) maj = np.corrcoef(rotated, major_profile)[0,1] minr = np.corrcoef(rotated, minor_profile)[0,1] if maj > best_score: best_score, best_key = maj, f"{notes[i]} major" if minr > best_score: best_score, best_key = minr, f"{notes[i]} minor" return bpm, best_key, y, sr, beat_times try: self.rb_bpm_a, self.rb_key_a, y_a, sr_a, beats_a = detect_bpm_key(self.rb_file_a) self.rb_bpm_b, self.rb_key_b, y_b, sr_b, beats_b = detect_bpm_key(self.rb_file_b) self.rb_dur_a = len(y_a) / sr_a if sr_a else None self.rb_dur_b = len(y_b) / sr_b if sr_b else None self.rb_cue_a_time = None self.rb_cue_b_time = None self.rb_cue_a_lbl.config(text="Track A cue: not set") self.rb_cue_b_lbl.config(text="Track B cue: not set") self._draw_remix_waveform(self.rb_wave_a, y_a, sr_a, beats_a, "#e8a030") self._draw_remix_waveform(self.rb_wave_b, y_b, sr_b, beats_b, "#40a0e8") bpm_diff_pct = abs(self.rb_bpm_a - self.rb_bpm_b) / self.rb_bpm_a * 100 bpm_note = "✅ Close enough to mix directly" if bpm_diff_pct < 3 else \ "⚠️ Noticeable tempo difference — use Match BPM" if bpm_diff_pct < 15 else \ "❌ Large tempo gap — Match BPM recommended, may sound stretched" key_a_root = self.rb_key_a.split()[0] key_b_root = self.rb_key_b.split()[0] same_key = self.rb_key_a == self.rb_key_b # Camelot wheel compatibility check CAMELOT = { "C major": "8B", "C minor": "5A", "C# major": "3B", "C# minor": "12A", "Db major": "3B", "Db minor": "12A", "D major": "10B", "D minor": "7A", "D# major": "5B", "D# minor": "2A", "Eb major": "5B", "Eb minor": "2A", "E major": "12B", "E minor": "9A", "F major": "7B", "F minor": "4A", "F# major": "2B", "F# minor": "11A", "Gb major": "2B", "Gb minor": "11A", "G major": "9B", "G minor": "6A", "G# major": "4B", "G# minor": "1A", "Ab major": "4B", "Ab minor": "1A", "A major": "11B", "A minor": "8A", "A# major": "6B", "A# minor": "3A", "Bb major": "6B", "Bb minor": "3A", "B major": "1B", "B minor": "10A", } def camelot_compatible(k1, k2): c1 = CAMELOT.get(k1) c2 = CAMELOT.get(k2) if not c1 or not c2: return False, "unknown" n1, l1 = int(c1[:-1]), c1[-1] n2, l2 = int(c2[:-1]), c2[-1] if c1 == c2: return True, "perfect" if l1 == l2 and abs(n1 - n2) <= 1: return True, "adjacent" if l1 == l2 and abs(n1 - n2) == 11: return True, "adjacent" if n1 == n2 and l1 != l2: return True, "relative" return False, "incompatible" compat, compat_type = camelot_compatible(self.rb_key_a, self.rb_key_b) c_a = CAMELOT.get(self.rb_key_a, "?") c_b = CAMELOT.get(self.rb_key_b, "?") if same_key: key_note = f"✅ Same key — perfect harmonic match\n Camelot: {c_a} = {c_b}" elif compat_type == "adjacent": key_note = f"✅ Compatible keys — safe to mix\n Camelot: {c_a} → {c_b} (adjacent step)" elif compat_type == "relative": key_note = f"✅ Relative major/minor — energy shift\n Camelot: {c_a} → {c_b} (same number)" else: key_note = f"⚠️ Keys may clash — use carefully\n Camelot: {c_a} → {c_b} (incompatible)" text = (f"TRACK A: {self.rb_bpm_a:.1f} BPM · {self.rb_key_a}\n" f"TRACK B: {self.rb_bpm_b:.1f} BPM · {self.rb_key_b}\n" f"BPM: {bpm_note}\n" f"KEY: {key_note}") self.rb_analysis_lbl.config(text=text, fg=FG) except Exception as e: self.rb_analysis_lbl.config(text=f"❌ Analysis error: {str(e)[:80]}") def _match_remix_key(self): """Pitch shift Track B to match Track A's key using librosa.""" if not self.rb_file_a or not self.rb_file_b: messagebox.showwarning("No tracks", "Load both Track A and Track B first.") return if not self.rb_key_a or not self.rb_key_b: self._analyze_remix_tracks() if not self.rb_key_a or not self.rb_key_b: return # Camelot semitone distances CAMELOT = { "C major": ("8B", 0), "C minor": ("5A", 0), "C# major": ("3B", 1), "C# minor": ("12A", 1), "Db major": ("3B", 1), "D major": ("10B", 2), "D minor": ("7A", 2), "D# major": ("5B", 3), "Eb major": ("5B", 3), "Eb minor": ("2A", 3), "E major": ("12B", 4), "E minor": ("9A", 4), "F major": ("7B", 5), "F minor": ("4A", 5), "F# major": ("2B", 6), "F# minor": ("11A", 6), "Gb major": ("2B", 6), "G major": ("9B", 7), "G minor": ("6A", 7), "G# major": ("4B", 8), "Ab major": ("4B", 8), "Ab minor": ("1A", 8), "A major": ("11B", 9), "A minor": ("8A", 9), "A# major": ("6B", 10), "Bb major": ("6B", 10), "Bb minor": ("3A", 10), "B major": ("1B", 11), "B minor": ("10A", 11), } info_a = CAMELOT.get(self.rb_key_a) info_b = CAMELOT.get(self.rb_key_b) if not info_a or not info_b: messagebox.showwarning("Unknown key", f"Cannot determine semitone distance for:\n{self.rb_key_a} / {self.rb_key_b}") return semitones_a = info_a[1] semitones_b = info_b[1] shift = semitones_a - semitones_b # Find shortest path if shift > 6: shift -= 12 if shift < -6: shift += 12 if shift == 0: messagebox.showinfo("Already matched", f"Track B is already in {self.rb_key_b} — same as Track A ({self.rb_key_a}).") return self.rb_analysis_lbl.config( text=f"⏳ Pitch shifting Track B by {shift:+d} semitones to match {self.rb_key_a}...") self.update() try: import librosa, numpy as np, soundfile as sf, tempfile, os y, sr = librosa.load(self.rb_file_b, sr=None, mono=False) if y.ndim == 1: shifted = librosa.effects.pitch_shift(y, sr=sr, n_steps=shift) else: shifted = np.stack([ librosa.effects.pitch_shift(y[i], sr=sr, n_steps=shift) for i in range(y.shape[0])]) tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix="_key_matched.wav") sf.write(tmp, shifted.T if shifted.ndim > 1 else shifted, sr) self.rb_file_b = tmp new_key = self.rb_key_a self.rb_key_b = new_key self.rb_file_b_lbl.config( text=f" 🎵 Track B (key matched) → {new_key}", fg="#40c880") self.rb_analysis_lbl.config( text=f"✅ Track B pitched {shift:+d} semitones → now in {new_key}\n" f"Keys now match: {self.rb_key_a} = {new_key}\n" f"Ready to blend!", fg="#40c880") except Exception as e: self.rb_analysis_lbl.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") def _match_remix_bpm(self): if not self.rb_bpm_a or not self.rb_bpm_b: self._analyze_remix_tracks() if not self.rb_bpm_a or not self.rb_bpm_b: return self._preview_remix_blend() def _update_remix_delay_label(self, val): ms = int(float(val)) if ms == 0: desc = "unison — layered, not delayed" elif ms <= 25: desc = "doubling/chorus feel" elif ms <= 60: desc = "slap-echo feel" else: desc = "clearly audible echo/delay" self.rb_delay_lbl.config(text=f"{ms} ms ({desc})") def _set_remix_delay(self, ms): self.rb_delay_ms.set(ms) self._update_remix_delay_label(ms) def _pick_remix_a(self): win = self.rb_file_a_lbl.winfo_toplevel() path = filedialog.askopenfilename( parent=win, title="Choose Track A", filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("All","*.*")]) if path: win.destroy() self._show_remix_blend(preset_a=path, preset_b=self.rb_file_b) def _pick_remix_b(self): win = self.rb_file_b_lbl.winfo_toplevel() path = filedialog.askopenfilename( parent=win, title="Choose Track B", filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("All","*.*")]) if path: win.destroy() self._show_remix_blend(preset_a=self.rb_file_a, preset_b=path) def _remix_band_kill(self, sig, sr, band): """Zero out a frequency band (classic DJ EQ-kill).""" from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt nyq = sr / 2 if band == "low": sos = butter(4, min(250/nyq, 0.99), btype="high", output='sos') elif band == "mid": low_sos = butter(4, min(250/nyq, 0.99), btype="low", output='sos') high_sos = butter(4, min(4000/nyq, 0.99), btype="high", output='sos') return sosfilt(low_sos, sig) + sosfilt(high_sos, sig) else: # high sos = butter(4, min(4000/nyq, 0.99), btype="low", output='sos') return sosfilt(sos, sig) def _process_remix_blend(self, out_path): import numpy as np import librosa import soundfile as sf delay_ms = self.rb_delay_ms.get() y_a, sr = librosa.load(self.rb_file_a, sr=None, mono=False) y_b, sr_b = librosa.load(self.rb_file_b, sr=sr, mono=False) # resample B to A's rate if y_a.ndim == 1: y_a = np.stack([y_a, y_a]) if y_b.ndim == 1: y_b = np.stack([y_b, y_b]) # BPM matching — time-stretch B to match A's tempo, pitch preserved if self.rb_bpm_a and self.rb_bpm_b and abs(self.rb_bpm_a - self.rb_bpm_b) > 0.5: rate = self.rb_bpm_b / self.rb_bpm_a y_b = np.array([librosa.effects.time_stretch(ch, rate=rate) for ch in y_b]) # EQ kills — cut selected bands per track for band in ["low", "mid", "high"]: if self.rb_eq_a[band].get(): y_a = np.array([self._remix_band_kill(ch, sr, band) for ch in y_a]) if self.rb_eq_b[band].get(): y_b = np.array([self._remix_band_kill(ch, sr, band) for ch in y_b]) # Delay delay_samples = int(sr * delay_ms / 1000) if delay_samples > 0: silence = np.zeros((y_b.shape[0], delay_samples)) y_b = np.concatenate([silence, y_b], axis=1) max_len = max(y_a.shape[1], y_b.shape[1]) a_padded = np.zeros((y_a.shape[0], max_len)); a_padded[:, :y_a.shape[1]] = y_a b_padded = np.zeros((y_b.shape[0], max_len)); b_padded[:, :y_b.shape[1]] = y_b if self.rb_mix_mode.get() == "crossfade": # Timed crossfade — A alone, then equal-power fade into B, then B alone xfade_samples = int(sr * self.rb_xfade_sec.get()) xfade_start = max(0, (max_len - xfade_samples) // 2) xfade_end = min(max_len, xfade_start + xfade_samples) gain_a = np.ones(max_len) gain_b = np.zeros(max_len) if xfade_end > xfade_start: t = np.linspace(0, np.pi/2, xfade_end - xfade_start) gain_a[xfade_start:xfade_end] = np.cos(t) gain_b[xfade_start:xfade_end] = np.sin(t) gain_a[xfade_end:] = 0 gain_b[:xfade_start] = 0 gain_b[xfade_end:] = 1 blended = a_padded * gain_a + b_padded * gain_b else: balance = self.rb_balance.get() / 100.0 # 0 = full A, 1 = full B gain_a = np.sqrt(1 - balance) gain_b = np.sqrt(balance) blended = a_padded * gain_a + b_padded * gain_b peak = float(np.max(np.abs(blended))) if peak > 0.97: blended = blended * (0.97 / peak) sf.write(out_path, blended.T, sr, subtype='PCM_24') def _preview_remix_blend(self): if not self.rb_file_a or not self.rb_file_b: messagebox.showwarning("Missing track", "Please choose both Track A and Track B first.") return self.rb_status.config(text="⏳ Blending preview..."); self.update() import sys, subprocess, tempfile try: import numpy as np, librosa, soundfile as sf except ImportError: try: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "numpy", "librosa", "soundfile", "--quiet"]) except Exception as e: self.rb_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:60]}") return try: subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) self._process_remix_blend(tmp.name) subprocess.Popen(["afplay", tmp.name], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL) mode_desc = f"crossfade over {self.rb_xfade_sec.get()}s" if self.rb_mix_mode.get() == "crossfade" \ else f"{self.rb_balance.get()}% toward B" self.rb_status.config(text=f"▶ Playing blend — {self.rb_delay_ms.get()}ms delay, {mode_desc}") # Start the moving playhead over the waveforms, synced to playback import time as _time if self.rb_playhead_job: self.after_cancel(self.rb_playhead_job) dur = max([d for d in (self.rb_dur_a, self.rb_dur_b) if d] or [0]) if dur > 0: self.rb_playhead_start = _time.time() self.rb_playhead_dur = dur self._update_remix_playhead() except Exception as e: self.rb_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") def _update_remix_playhead(self): """Move a white line across both waveforms in sync with playback, so you can visually follow the beat as it plays.""" import time as _time elapsed = _time.time() - self.rb_playhead_start if elapsed >= self.rb_playhead_dur: self.rb_wave_a.delete("playhead") self.rb_wave_b.delete("playhead") self.rb_playhead_job = None return frac = elapsed / self.rb_playhead_dur for canvas in (self.rb_wave_a, self.rb_wave_b): w = canvas.winfo_width() or 700 h = int(canvas["height"]) x = frac * w canvas.delete("playhead") canvas.create_line(x, 0, x, h, fill="#ffffff", width=2, tags="playhead") self.rb_playhead_job = self.after(40, self._update_remix_playhead) def _stop_remix_blend(self): import subprocess subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", "afplay"], capture_output=True) if self.rb_playhead_job: self.after_cancel(self.rb_playhead_job) self.rb_playhead_job = None self.rb_wave_a.delete("playhead") self.rb_wave_b.delete("playhead") self.rb_status.config(text="⏹ Stopped") def _export_remix_blend(self): if not self.rb_file_a or not self.rb_file_b: messagebox.showwarning("Missing track", "Please choose both Track A and Track B first.") return out_dir = os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop") out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{base_a}_x_{base_b}_blend.wav") self._process_remix_blend(out_path) self.rb_status.config(text=f"✅ Saved: {out_path}") expand=True) if preset_file: self._analyze_stereo_widener() def _update_widener_label(self, val): pct = int(float(val)) if pct == 0: desc = "neutral — no change" elif pct > 0: if pct <= 30: desc = "safe, moderate widening" elif pct <= 45: desc = "noticeable — check mono compatibility after" else: desc = "aggressive — check carefully, risk of phase issues" else: # negative — narrowing if pct >= -30: desc = "safe, moderate narrowing — more mono-safe" elif pct >= -60: desc = "noticeable narrowing — significantly more centered" else: desc = "very narrow — approaching mono" self.sw_amount_lbl.config(text=f"{pct}% ({desc})") def _pick_stereo_widener_file(self): win = self.sw_file_lbl.winfo_toplevel() path = filedialog.askopenfilename( parent=win, title="Choose track", filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("All","*.*")]) if path: win.destroy() self._show_stereo_widener(preset_file=path) def _widen_stereo(self, y, amount_pct): """Mid-Side widening: encode to M/S, boost Side, decode back.""" import numpy as np mid = (y[0] + y[1]) / 2 side = (y[0] - y[1]) / 2 boost = 1 + (amount_pct / 100.0) side = side * boost left = mid + side right = mid - side return np.stack([left, right]) def _correlation(self, y): import numpy as np left, right = y[0], y[1] if np.std(left) > 0 and np.std(right) > 0: return float(np.corrcoef(left, right)[0, 1]) return 1.0 def _analyze_stereo_widener(self): if not self.sw_file: messagebox.showwarning("No track", "Please choose a track first.") return self._write(self.sw_txt, "⏳ Analyzing...") self.update() import sys, subprocess try: import numpy as np, librosa except ImportError: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "numpy", "librosa", "--quiet"]) import numpy as np, librosa try: y, sr = librosa.load(self.sw_file, sr=None, mono=False) if y.ndim == 1: self._write(self.sw_txt, "⚠️ This file is already mono (1 channel) —\nstereo widening needs a stereo source to work with.") return corr_before = self._correlation(y) widened = self._widen_stereo(y, self.sw_amount.get()) corr_after = self._correlation(widened) def rating(corr): if corr > 0.95: return "❌ Near-mono — very little stereo information" if corr > 0.7: return "⚠️ Narrow — noticeably centered" if corr > 0.3: return "✅ Reasonable width" if corr > -0.2: return "✅ Wide, healthy stereo image" return "⚠️ Very wide — verify mono compatibility carefully" lines = [] lines.append("══════════════════════════════════════════════════") lines.append(" ↔️ STEREO WIDTH CHECK") lines.append("══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n") lines.append(f"BEFORE: correlation {corr_before:.2f}") lines.append(f" {rating(corr_before)}\n") lines.append(f"AFTER ({self.sw_amount.get()}% widen): correlation {corr_after:.2f}") lines.append(f" {rating(corr_after)}\n") lines.append("══════════════════════════════════════════════════") if corr_after < -0.3: lines.append("⚠️ This setting may be too aggressive — correlation\n" " is getting close to full phase cancellation range.\n" " Consider lowering the widen amount.") else: lines.append("* Correlation near 0 = wide but safe. Very negative\n" " values risk cancellation on mono playback systems.") lines.append("══════════════════════════════════════════════════") self._write(self.sw_txt, "\n".join(lines)) except Exception self.sw_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") def _apply_3d_oneclick(self): """3D Special — one click with optimal default settings.""" if not self.am_file: messagebox.showwarning("No track", "Please choose a track first.") return self.am_status.config(text="⏳ Applying 3D Special..."); self.update() import sys, subprocess try: import numpy as np import soundfile as sf from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt except ImportError: subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "numpy", "soundfile", "scipy", "--quiet"]) import numpy as np import soundfile as sf from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt try: y, sr = sf.read(self.am_file, always_2d=True) y = y.T n_ch = y.shape[0] # Default settings — natural dialogue/cinematic feel width_amt = 0.38 # 38% — narrow, dialogue stays centered depth_amt = 0.55 # 55% — voice feels placed in space height_amt = 0.22 # 22% — subtle air, not overdone room_amt = 0.35 # 35% — small/medium room, intimate if n_ch == 1: y = np.stack([y[0], y[0]]) n_ch = 2 L, R = y[0].copy(), y[1].copy() M = (L + R) / 2 S = (L - R) / 2 nyq = sr / 2 # Width S_wide = S * (1.0 + width_amt * 1.2) # Depth — high frequencies delayed slightly sos_hi = butter(2, min(3000/nyq, 0.99), btype="high", output='sos') hi_band = sosfilt(sos_hi, M) depth_delay = int(sr * 0.003 * depth_amt) if depth_delay > 0: hi_delayed = np.concatenate([np.zeros(depth_delay), hi_band[:-depth_delay]]) M_depth = (M - hi_band) + hi_delayed else: M_depth = M # Height — air boost sos_air = butter(2, min(8000/nyq, 0.99), btype="high", output='sos') air = sosfilt(sos_air, M_depth) M_height = M_depth + air * height_amt * 0.4 # Room reflections room_delays = [ (int(sr * 0.011), 0.25), (int(sr * 0.017), 0.20), (int(sr * 0.023), 0.15), (int(sr * 0.031), 0.10), ] L_room = M_height.copy() R_room = M_height.copy() for i, (ds, gain) in enumerate(room_delays): if ds < len(M_height): ref = np.concatenate([np.zeros(ds), M_height[:-ds]]) * gain * room_amt if i % 2 == 0: L_room += ref else: R_room += ref processed = np.stack([L_room + S_wide, R_room - S_wide]) # Normalize orig_rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))) new_rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(processed**2))) if new_rms > 0 and orig_rms > 0: processed = processed * (orig_rms / new_rms) # Safety limiter peak = float(np.max(np.abs(processed))) if peak > 0.97: processed = processed * (0.97 / peak) base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.am_file))[0] out_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(self.am_file), f"{base}_3dspecial.wav") sf.write(out_path, processed.T, sr, subtype='PCM_24') self.am_status.config(text=f"✅ 3D Special — saved as {os.path.basename(out_path)}") self._show_vr_result( f"══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" f" 🎧 3D SPECIAL APPLIED\n" f"══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n" f" Original: {os.path.basename(self.am_file)}\n" f" Output: {os.path.basename(out_path)}\n\n" f"── WHAT WAS APPLIED mode='same') + 1e-9) threshold = np.percentile(envelope, 75) ratio = 1.5 gain_reduction = np.ones_like(envelope) above = envelope > threshold gain_reduction[above] = (threshold + (envelope[above]-threshold)/ratio) / envelope[above] # cap max reduction to target dB max_cut_lin = 10 ** (-gr_target_db/20) gain_reduction = np.clip(gain_reduction, max_cut_lin, 1.0) smooth_win = hint) in enumerate([ ("sb_lbl1","sb_file1","YOUR TRACK: (the track you want to improve or match)", TEAL, "→ Upload the track you are working on"), ("sb_lbl2","sb_file2","REFERENCE TRACK: (the track setattr(self, path_attr, None) idx = i self._btn(row, "📂 Choose", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda x=idx: self._pick_sb(x)).pack(side="left", padx=(8,0)) br = tk.Frame(p, bg=BG); br.grid(row=7, column=0,
