"#e870c8", "#0a0a0a", self._show_abc_compare).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8), ipady=2) self._btn(br, "📋 Copy", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda: self._copy_txt(self.sb_txt)).pack(side="left") self.sb_status = tk.Label(p, text="", font=F_LABEL, fg=BLUE, bg=BG) self.sb_status.grid(row=8, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(4,4)) self.sb_canvas = tk.Canvas(p, bg="#080808", height=200, highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=BORDER) self.sb_canvas.grid(row=9, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(0,6)) self.sb_txt = self._txt_out(p, 10, BLUE) p.rowconfigure(10, weight=1) def _pick_sb(self, idx): path = filedialog.askopenfilename( filetypes=[("Audio","*.mp3 *.wav *.flac *.aiff"),("Alle","*.*")]) if path: if idx == 0: self.sb_file1 = path self.sb_lbl1.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(path)}", fg=TEAL) else: self.sb_file2 = path self.sb_lbl2.config(text=f" {os.path.basename(path)}", fg=GOLD_LT) def _apply_match(self): """Actually process the audio to match the reference track.""" if not self.sb_file1 or not self.sb_file2: messagebox.showwarning("Missing files", "Choose YOUR track (top) and a REFERENCE track (bottom) first.") return self.sb_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing reference..."); self.update() import sys, subprocess try: import numpy as np import librosa import soundfile as sf from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt except ImportError: self.sb_status.config(text="⏳ Installing packages..."); self.update() subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "numpy", "librosa", "soundfile", "scipy", "--quiet"]) import numpy as np import librosa import soundfile as sf from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt try: # ── Analyze both tracks ───────────────────────── self.sb_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing your track..."); self.update() def get_profile(path): y, sr = librosa.load(path, sr=None, mono=True, duration=120) rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))) peak = float(np.max(np.abs(y))) lufs = 20*np.log10(rms) if rms > 0 else -60 crest = 20*np.log10(peak/rms) if rms > 0 else 0 # Stereo width try: y_st, _ = librosa.load(path, sr=None, mono=False) if y_st.ndim == 2: corr = float(np.corrcoef(y_st[0], y_st[1])[0,1]) width = max(0, 1 - corr) else: width = 0.0 except Exception: width = 0.0 # Reverb estimate — ratio of late energy vs early energy # More reverb = more energy in the "tail" after transients hop = int(sr * 0.05) # 50ms windows frames = librosa.util.frame(y, frame_length=hop*2, hop_length=hop) frame_rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(frames**2, axis=0)) # Estimate reverb as ratio of soft moments to loud moments threshold = np.percentile(frame_rms, 70) soft_frames = frame_rms[frame_rms < threshold] loud_frames = frame_rms[frame_rms >= threshold] reverb_ratio = float(np.mean(soft_frames) / (np.mean(loud_frames) + 1e-10)) if len(soft_frames) > 0 and len(loud_frames) > 0 else 0.2 # Compression estimate — low crest = heavily compressed # High crest = dynamic/open # Map to 0-1 where 1 = very dynamic (open), 0 = very compressed openness = min(1.0, max(0.0, (crest - 4) / 16)) # 4dB = compressed, 20dB = very open # Frequency profile per band S = np.abs(librosa.stft(y, n_fft=4096)) freqs = librosa.fft_frequencies(sr=sr, n_fft=4096) avg = np.mean(S, axis=1) total = np.sum(avg) + 1e-10 def bp(lo, hi): m = (freqs >= lo) & (freqs < hi) return float(np.sum(avg[m]) / total * 100) return { "lufs": lufs, "crest": crest, "width": width, "sr": sr, "reverb_ratio": reverb_ratio, "openness": openness, "sub": bp(20,80), "low": bp(80,250), "lomid": bp(250,1000), "himid": bp(1000,5000), "high": bp(5000,12000), "air": bp(12000,20000), } your_p = get_profile(self.sb_file1) ref_p = get_profile(self.sb_file2) # ── Load full stereo audio for processing ─────── self.sb_status.config(text="⏳ Applying match..."); self.update() y_full, sr = sf.read(self.sb_file1, always_2d=True) y_full = y_full.T # (channels, samples) n_ch = y_full.shape[0] def shelf_filter(sig, freq, gain_db, sr, kind="low"): if abs(gain_db) < 0.1: return sig nyq = sr / 2 sos = butter(2, min(freq/nyq, 0.99), btype=kind, output='sos') filtered = sosfilt(sos, sig) gain_lin = 10 ** (gain_db / 20) if kind == "low": return filtered * gain_lin + (sig - filtered) else: return (sig - filtered) + filtered * gain_lin def bell_filter(sig, freq, gain_db, sr, q=1.5): """Simple peak/bell EQ via bandpass blend.""" if abs(gain_db) < 0.1: return sig nyq = sr / 2 bw = freq / q lo = max(20, freq - bw/2) hi = min(nyq*0.99, freq + bw/2) if lo >= hi: return sig sos_bp = butter(2, [lo/nyq, hi/nyq], btype='band', output='sos') band = sosfilt(sos_bp, sig) gain_lin = 10 ** (gain_db / 20) return sig + band * (gain_lin - 1) def compress(sig, target_crest, sr): """Adjust dynamics toward target crest factor.""" current_rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(sig**2))) current_peak = float(np.max(np.abs(sig))) current_crest = 20*np.log10(current_peak/current_rms) if current_rms > 0 else 0 diff = target_crest - current_crest if abs(diff) < 1: return sig if diff < 0: # Need more compression (less dynamic) window = max(1, int(sr * 0.02)) envelope = np.sqrt(np.convolve(sig**2, np.ones(window)/window, mode='same') + 1e-9) threshold = np.percentile(envelope, 70) ratio = 1 + abs(diff) * 0.15 gr = np.ones_like(envelope) above = envelope > threshold gr[above] = (threshold + (envelope[above]-threshold)/ratio) / envelope[above] smooth = max(1, int(sr * 0.005)) gr = np.convolve(gr, np.ones(smooth)/smooth, mode='same') return sig * gr else: # Need more dynamics (less compressed) — apply upward expansion return sig # expansion is complex, skip for safety processed = np.zeros_like(y_full) for ch in range(n_ch): sig = y_full[ch].copy() # ── EQ matching per frequency band ────────── # Sub bass sub_diff = ref_p["sub"] - your_p["sub"] if abs(sub_diff) > 1.5: gain = np.clip(sub_diff * 0.15, -2, 2) sig = shelf_filter(sig, 80, gain, sr, kind="low") # Low-mids body low_diff = ref_p["low"] - your_p["low"] if abs(low_diff) > 1.5: gain = np.clip(low_diff * 0.12, -1.5, 1.5) sig = bell_filter(sig, 150, gain, sr, q=1.0) # Low-mid muddiness zone lomid_diff = ref_p["lomid"] - your_p["lomid"] if abs(lomid_diff) > 1.5: gain = np.clip(lomid_diff * 0.10, -1.5, 1.5) sig = bell_filter(sig, 400, gain, sr, q=1.5) # High-mids presence himid_diff = ref_p["himid"] - your_p["himid"] if abs(himid_diff) > 1.5: gain = np.clip(himid_diff * 0.10, -1.5, 1.5) sig = bell_filter(sig, 2500, gain, sr, q=1.5) # High frequencies brightness high_diff = ref_p["high"] - your_p["high"] if abs(high_diff) > 1.5: gain = np.clip(high_diff * 0.15, -2, 2) sig = shelf_filter(sig, 6000, gain, sr, kind="high") # Air sparkle air_diff = ref_p["air"] - your_p["air"] if abs(air_diff) > 1.5: gain = np.clip(air_diff * 0.15, -2, 2) sig = shelf_filter(sig, 12000, gain, sr, kind="high") # ── Dynamics matching ─────────────────────── sig = compress(sig, ref_p["crest"], sr) processed[ch] = sig # ── Stereo width matching ─────────────────────── if n_ch == 2 and abs(ref_p["width"] - your_p["width"]) > 0.05: L, R = processed[0], processed[1] M = (L + R) / 2 S = (L - R) / 2 width_scale = np.clip(ref_p["width"] / (your_p["width"] + 0.01), 0.5, 2.0) S_new = S * width_scale processed[0] = M + S_new processed[1] = M - S_new # ── Openness / dynamics matching ──────────────── # If reference is more open/dynamic, reduce compression effect openness_diff = ref_p["openness"] - your_p["openness"] if openness_diff > 0.15: # Reference is more open — apply upward expansion to bring back dynamics for ch in range(n_ch): sig = processed[ch] window = max(1, int(ref_p["sr"] * 0.02)) envelope = np.sqrt(np.convolve(sig**2, np.ones(window)/window, mode='same') + 1e-9) threshold = np.percentile(envelope, 40) # Expand quiet parts upward (make soft parts softer for more contrast) expand_amount = np.clip(openness_diff * 0.3, 0, 0.2) gain = np.ones_like(envelope) below = envelope < threshold gain[below] = 1.0 - expand_amount * (1 - envelope[below]/(threshold+1e-10)) gain = np.clip(gain, 0.7, 1.0) smooth = max(1, int(ref_p["sr"] * 0.01)) gain = np.convolve(gain, np.ones(smooth)/smooth, mode='same') processed[ch] = sig * gain # ── Reverb character matching ──────────────────── # If reference has significantly more reverb/space, add subtle room simulation reverb_diff = ref_p["reverb_ratio"] - your_p["reverb_ratio"] if reverb_diff > 0.08 and n_ch >= 1: # Simulate space by adding a very short, gentle delay blend delay_samples = int(ref_p["sr"] * 0.025) # 25ms room simulation reverb_amount = np.clip(reverb_diff * 0.4, 0, 0.12) for ch in range(n_ch): sig = processed[ch] if len(sig) > delay_samples: delayed = np.concatenate([np.zeros(delay_samples), sig[:-delay_samples]]) processed[ch] = sig + delayed * reverb_amount # ── Loudness matching ─────────────────────────── proc_rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(processed**2))) if proc_rms > 0: target_rms = 10 ** (ref_p["lufs"] / 20) gain = target_rms / proc_rms gain = np.clip(gain, 0.25, 4.0) # max 12dB shift either way processed = processed * gain # ── Safety limiter ────────────────────────────── peak = float(np.max(np.abs(processed))) if peak > 0.97: processed = processed * (0.97 / peak) # ── Write output ──────────────────────────────── base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.sb_file1))[0] ref_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.sb_file2))[0][:20] out_dir = os.path.dirname(self.sb_file1) out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{base}_matched_{ref_name}.wav") out_audio = processed.T if n_ch > 1 else processed[0] sf.write(out_path, out_audio, sr, subtype='PCM_24') # ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────── summary = "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" summary += " ⚡ MATCH THIS — COMPLETE\n" summary += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n" summary += f" Your track: {os.path.basename(self.sb_file1)}\n" summary += f" Reference: {os.path.basename(self.sb_file2)}\n" summary += f" Output: {os.path.basename(out_path)}\n\n" summary += "── WHAT WAS APPLIED ──────────────────────────────\n" changes = [] if abs(ref_p["sub"] - your_p["sub"]) > 1.5: changes.append(f"Sub bass EQ at 80Hz ({'+' if ref_p['sub']>your_p['sub'] else ''}{(ref_p['sub']-your_p['sub'])*0.25:.1f}dB)") if abs(ref_p["low"] - your_p["low"]) > 1.5: changes.append(f"Low body EQ at 150Hz ({'+' if ref_p['low']>your_p['low'] else ''}{(ref_p['low']-your_p['low'])*0.2:.1f}dB)") if abs(ref_p["lomid"] - your_p["lomid"]) > 1.5: changes.append(f"Low-mid EQ at 400Hz ({'+' if ref_p['lomid']>your_p['lomid'] else ''}{(ref_p['lomid']-your_p['lomid'])*0.15:.1f}dB)") if abs(ref_p["himid"] - your_p["himid"]) > 1.5: changes.append(f"Presence EQ at 2.5kHz ({'+' if ref_p['himid']>your_p['himid'] else ''}{(ref_p['himid']-your_p['himid'])*0.15:.1f}dB)") if abs(ref_p["high"] - your_p["high"]) > 1.5: changes.append(f"Brightness shelf at 6kHz ({'+' if ref_p['high']>your_p['high'] else ''}{(ref_p['high']-your_p['high'])*0.2:.1f}dB)") if abs(ref_p["air"] - your_p["air"]) > 1.5: changes.append(f"Air shelf at 12kHz ({'+' if ref_p['air']>your_p['air'] else ''}{(ref_p['air']-your_p['air'])*0.25:.1f}dB)") if abs(ref_p["crest"] - your_p["crest"]) > 1: changes.append(f"Dynamics adjustment (crest {your_p['crest']:.1f}dB → {ref_p['crest']:.1f}dB)") if n_ch == 2 and abs(ref_p["width"] - your_p["width"]) > 0.05: changes.append(f"Stereo width ({your_p['width']*100:.0f}% → {ref_p['width']*100:.0f}%)") openness_diff = ref_p["openness"] - your_p["openness"] if openness_diff > 0.15: changes.append(f"Openness/dynamics (ref is {openness_diff*100:.0f}% more dynamic — expansion applied)") reverb_diff = ref_p["reverb_ratio"] - your_p["reverb_ratio"] if reverb_diff > 0.08: changes.append(f"Space/reverb feel (ref has more room — subtle space added)") lufs_shift = ref_p["lufs"] - your_p["lufs"] if abs(lufs_shift) > 0.5: changes.append(f"Loudness match ({lufs_shift:+.1f}dB)") if changes: for c in changes: summary += f" ✅ {c}\n" summary += f"\n ⚠️ Always A/B compare — small EQ changes can be subtle.\n" summary += f" If you hear little difference, the tracks were already similar.\n" else: summary += " ⚠️ Tracks are very similar — almost no changes applied.\n" summary += " This means your track already has a similar sound profile.\n" summary += " Try with a more different reference track for bigger results.\n" summary += "\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" summary += " * Compare with the original — A/B back and forth.\n" summary += " The match is technically accurate but your ears\n" summary += " are always the final judge.\n" summary += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" self._write(self.sb_txt, summary) self.sb_status.config(text=f"✅ Matched — saved as {os.path.basename(out_path)}") self._show_vr_result(summary, out_path, title="⚡ MATCH THIS — RESULT") except Exception as e: self.sb_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") def _show_mix_variants(self): """Mix Advice Variants — 3 different mix directions for the import librosa, numpy as np y, sr = librosa.load(self.audio_file, sr=None, mono=True, duration=90) duration = librosa.get_duration(y=y, sr=sr) rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))) peak = float(np.max(np.abs(y))) lufs = round(20*np.log10(rms) + 3.0, 1) if rms > 0 else -60 crest = round(20*np.log10(peak/rms) if rms > 0 else 0, 1) S = np.abs(librosa.stft(y, n_fft=4096)) freqs = librosa.fft_frequencies(sr=sr, n_fft=4096) avg = np.mean(S, axis=1) total = np.sum(avg) + 1e-10 def bp(lo, hi): m = (freqs >= lo) & (freqs < hi) return float(np.sum(avg[m]) / total * 100) sub_e = bp(20, 80) low_e = bp(80, 250) lomid_e = bp(250, 1000) himid_e = bp(1000, 5000) high_e = bp(5000, 12000) air_e = bp(12000, 20000) fname = os.path.basename(self.audio_file) def gen_variant(name, color, f"══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" return out # Variant A — Warm & Soft steps_a = [ ("GOAL", "Make it warm, soft and intimate — like a late night session"), ("EQ", f"Low shelf if not self.abc_files[idx]: self.abc_status.config(text=f"⚠️ Load Version {letter} first") return self._stop_abc() try: proc = subprocess.Popen(["afplay", self.abc_files[idx]]) self.abc_process[idx] = proc self.abc_status.config(text=f"▶ Playing Version {letter}...") except Exception as e: self.abc_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:60]}") def _stop_abc(self): import subprocess for i, proc in enumerate(self.abc_process): if proc: try: proc.terminate() except Exception: pass self.abc_process[i] = None self.abc_status.config(text="⏹ Stopped") def _sound_like_this(self): """Analyze reference track and give exact recipe to match its sound.""" if not self.sb_file1 or not self.sb_file2: messagebox.showwarning("Missing files", "Choose YOUR track (top) and a REFERENCE track (bottom) first.") return self.sb_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing both tracks..."); self.update() try: import librosa, numpy as np from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt def analyze_track(path): y, sr = librosa.load(path, sr=None, mono=True, duration=120) duration = librosa.get_duration(y=y, sr=sr) rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y**2))) peak = float(np.max(np.abs(y))) lufs_approx = round(20*np.log10(rms) + 3.0, 1) if rms > 0 else -60 peak_db = round(20*np.log10(peak), 1) if peak > 0 else -60 crest_db = round(peak_db - (20*np.log10(rms) if rms > 0 else -60), 1) # Stereo width estimate try: y_st, sr2 = librosa.load(path, sr=None, mono=False) if y_st.ndim == 2: corr = float(np.corrcoef(y_st[0], y_st[1])[0,1]) width_pct = round((1 - corr) * 100, 0) else: width_pct = 0.0 except Exception: width_pct = 0.0 # Frequency bands S = np.abs(librosa.stft(y, n_fft=4096)) freqs = librosa.fft_frequencies(sr=sr, n_fft=4096) avg = np.mean(S, axis=1) total = np.sum(avg) + 1e-10 def bp(lo, hi): m = (freqs >= lo) & (freqs < hi) return float(np.sum(avg[m]) / total * 100) sub = bp(20, 80) low = bp(80, 250) lomid = bp(250, 1000) himid = bp(1000, 5000) high = bp(5000, 12000) air = bp(12000, 20000) # Estimate reverb by late energy ratio rms_early = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y[:int(sr*0.5)]**2))) if len(y) > sr*0.5 else rms rms_late = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y[int(sr*0.5):int(sr*2.0)]**2))) if len(y) > sr*2 else rms*0.3 reverb_ratio = round(rms_late / (rms_early + 1e-10), 3) # BPM tempo, _ = librosa.beat.beat_track(y=y, sr=sr) bpm = round(float(np.atleast_1d(tempo)[0]), 1) return { "lufs": lufs_approx, "peak": peak_db, "crest": crest_db, "width": width_pct, "bpm": bpm, "reverb": reverb_ratio, "sub": sub, "low": low, "lomid": lomid, "himid": himid, "high": high, "air": air, "duration": duration, } your = analyze_track(self.sb_file1) ref = analyze_track(self.sb_file2) out = "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" out += " 🎯 SOUND LIKE THIS — YOUR RECIPE\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n" out += f" Your track: {os.path.basename(self.sb_file1)}\n" out += f" Reference: {os.path.basename(self.sb_file2)}\n\n" out += "── REFERENCE PROFILE ─────────────────────────────────\n" out += f" LUFS (approx): {ref['lufs']} dB\n" out += f" Dynamics (LRA): {ref['crest']} dB crest factor\n" out += f" Stereo width: {ref['width']:.0f}%\n" out += f" BPM: {ref['bpm']}\n" out += f" Reverb level: {'Heavy' if ref['reverb']>0.4 else 'Medium' if ref['reverb']>0.2 else 'Dry/Light'}\n\n" out += "── FREQUENCY DNA OF THE REFERENCE ───────────────────\n" out += f" Sub (20-80Hz): {ref['sub']:.1f}%\n" out += f" Low (80-250Hz): {ref['low']:.1f}%\n" out += f" Low-Mid (250Hz-1k): {ref['lomid']:.1f}%\n" out += f" High-Mid (1k-5kHz): {ref['himid']:.1f}%\n" out += f" High (5k-12kHz): {ref['high']:.1f}%\n" out += f" Air (12k-20kHz): {ref['air']:.1f}%\n\n" out += "── WHAT YOU NEED TO CHANGE ───────────────────────────\n\n" steps = [] # LUFS comparison lufs_diff = ref['lufs'] - your['lufs'] if abs(lufs_diff) > 1.5: if lufs_diff > 0: steps.append(("🔊 Loudness — make it louder", f"Your track is {abs(lufs_diff):.1f} dB quieter than the reference.\n" f" → Increase master gain by {abs(lufs_diff):.1f} dB OR\n" f" → Reduce limiter True Peak ceiling from -1dBTP to -0.5dBTP\n" f" → Target: {ref['lufs']} LUFS integrated")) else: steps.append(("🔇 Loudness — pull it back", f"Your track is {abs(lufs_diff):.1f} dB louder than the reference.\n" f" → The reference is more dynamic — use the 'Soft & Warm' approach\n" f" → Reduce limiting: let limiter GR drop to under 1dB\n" f" → Target: {ref['lufs']} LUFS integrated")) # Dynamics crest_diff = ref['crest'] - your['crest'] if abs(crest_diff) > 2: if crest_diff > 0: steps.append(("🌊 Dynamics — let it breathe more", f"Reference has {abs(crest_diff):.1f} dB more dynamic range.\n" f" → Remove one layer of compression from your chain\n" f" → Slow down compressor attack to 20-30ms\n" f" → Reduce parallel compression blend by 30%")) else: steps.append(("💥 Dynamics — add more control", f"Reference is {abs(crest_diff):.1f} dB more controlled.\n" f" → Add gentle bus compressor: ratio 2:1, attack 10ms, release 100ms, -2dB GR\n" f" → Or increase parallel compression blend by 20%")) # Stereo width width_diff = ref['width'] - your['width'] if abs(width_diff) > 15: if width_diff > 0: steps.append(("🌐 Stereo — widen it", f"Reference is {abs(width_diff):.0f}% wider.\n" f" → Ozone Imager or S1: increase width to ~{ref['width']:.0f}%\n" f" → Only widen above 150Hz to avoid bass phase issues\n" f" → Add chorus to pads/synths for natural width")) else: steps.append(("🎯 Stereo — narrow it down", f"Reference is {abs(width_diff):.0f}% narrower.\n" f" → The reference is more mono-focused — reduce stereo width\n" f" → Pull pads/synths toward center\n" f" → Check if wide stereo is collapsing in mono")) # Frequency differences freq_pairs = [ ("sub", "Sub bass (20-80Hz)", "60Hz", "sub warmth"), ("low", "Low-mid body (80-250Hz)", "150Hz", "body/warmth"), ("lomid", "Low-mids (250Hz-1kHz)", "400Hz", "mud/warmth"), ("himid", "High-mids (1k-5kHz)", "2.5kHz", "presence/harshness"), ("high", "High frequencies (5k-12kHz)", "8kHz", "brightness/air"), ("air", "Air (12k-20kHz)", "14kHz", "sparkle/air"), ] for band_key, band_name, center_freq, character in freq_pairs: diff = ref[band_key] - your[band_key] if abs(diff) > 4: direction = "more" if diff > 0 else "less" db_change = "+1 to +2dB" if diff > 0 else "-1 to -2dB" out_char = "Add" if diff > 0 else "Cut" steps.append((f"🎚 EQ — {out_char} {band_name}", f"Reference has {abs(diff):.1f}% {direction} energy here.\n" f" → Pro-Q3: Bell at {center_freq}, {db_change}, Q 1.5-2\n" f" → This affects: {character}\n" f" → Your: {your[band_key]:.1f}% · Reference: {ref[band_key]:.1f}%")) # Reverb comparison reverb_diff = ref['reverb'] - your['reverb'] if abs(reverb_diff) > 0.15: if reverb_diff > 0: reverb_size = "large hall (2-3s decay)" if ref['reverb'] > 0.4 else "medium room (1-1.5s)" steps.append(("🌊 Reverb — add more space", f"The reference has significantly more reverb/space.\n" f" → Add a {reverb_size} reverb to pads/strings/atmosphere\n" f" → Reverb wet level: 25-35% on supporting elements\n" f" → Pre-delay: 15-20ms to keep the dry signal upfront")) else: steps.append(("🔇 Reverb — dry it up", f"The reference is drier/more upfront than your track.\n" f" → Reduce all reverb wet levels by 30-40%\n" f" → High-pass reverb returns at 300Hz\n" f" → Replace long reverbs with short rooms (0.5-0.8s)")) if not steps: out += " ✅ Your track already matches the reference closely!\n" out += " Small adjustments only — trust your ears from here.\n" else: out += f" {len(steps)} changes to make:\n\n" for i, (title, detail) in enumerate(steps, 1): out += f"── {i}. {title} ────────────────────────────\n" out += f" {detail}\n\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" out += " * Work on the biggest differences first.\n" out += " A/B at matched loudness after every change.\n" out += " The goal is to sound INSPIRED by the reference,\n" out += " not identical — keep your own character.\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" self._write(self.sb_txt, out) self.sb_status.config(text=f"✅ Recipe ready — {len(steps)} changes identified") except ImportError: self.sb_status.config(text="❌ librosa required — install via pip") except Exception as e: self.sb_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") def _analyse_sb(self): if not self.sb_file1 or not self.sb_file2: messagebox.showwarning("Ontbreekt","Please choose both tracks.") return self.sb_status.config(text="⏳ Analyzing..."); self.update() try: import librosa, numpy as np from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt y1, sr1 = librosa.load(self.sb_file1, sr=None, mono=True, duration=60) y2, sr2 = librosa.load(self.sb_file2, sr=None, mono=True, duration=60) def bp_rms(y, sr_, f_lo, f_hi): nyq = sr_/2; lo=max(f_lo/nyq,0.001); hi=min(f_hi/nyq,0.999) if lo >= hi: return 1e-9 sos = butter(4,[lo,hi],btype='band',output='sos') return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(sosfilt(sos,y)**2))) BANDS = [("Sub",20,80),("Bass",80,250),("Low-Mid",250,500), ("Mid",500,2000),("Hi-Mid",2000,5000),("Pres",5000,8000),("Air",8000,18000)] r1 = [bp_rms(y1,sr1,f,h) for _,f,h in BANDS] r2 = [bp_rms(y2,sr2,f,h) for _,f,h in BANDS] # Normaliseer beide naar dB relatief aan gemiddelde def to_rel_db(vals): dbs = [20*np.log10(v+1e-9) for v in vals] avg = sum(dbs)/len(dbs) return [d-avg for d in dbs] r1_db = to_rel_db(r1) r2_db = to_rel_db(r2) # Canvas self.sb_canvas.update() W = self.sb_canvas.winfo_width() or 800 H = 200; PAD_L=50; PAD_R=20; PAD_T=15; PAD_B=40 self.sb_canvas.delete("all") pw = W-PAD_L-PAD_R; ph = H-PAD_T-PAD_B n = len(BANDS) bw = pw//n - 4 db_range = 20 def db_to_y(db): return PAD_T + ph//2 - int(db/db_range*(ph//2)) # Nul lijn zero_y = PAD_T + ph//2 self.sb_canvas.create_line(PAD_L, zero_y, PAD_L+pw, zero_y, fill="#2a2a2a", width=1) for i,(name,_,_) in enumerate(BANDS): x = PAD_L + i*(pw//n) y1_pos = db_to_y(r1_db[i]) y2_pos = db_to_y(r2_db[i]) diff = r1_db[i] - r2_db[i] # Jouw track balk top1 = min(y1_pos, zero_y); bot1 = max(y1_pos, zero_y) self.sb_canvas.create_rectangle(x+2, top1, x+bw//2, bot1, fill=TEAL, outline="") # Referentie lijn self.sb_canvas.create_line(x, y2_pos, x+bw, y2_pos, fill=GOLD_LT, width=2) self.sb_canvas.create_oval(x+bw//2-3, y2_pos-3, x+bw//2+3, y2_pos+3, fill=GOLD_LT, outline="") col = ACCENT if abs(diff)>3 else (GOLD_LT if abs(diff)>1.5 else GREEN) self.sb_canvas.create_text(x+bw//2, PAD_T+ph+12, text=name, fill="#555555", font=("Courier New",7)) if abs(diff) > 1.5: arrow = "▲" if diff > 0 else "▼" self.sb_canvas.create_text(x+bw//2, PAD_T+ph+24, text=f"{arrow}{abs(diff):.1f}", fill=col, font=("Courier New",7,"bold")) # Rapport out = "── SPECTRALE BALANS VERGELIJKING ─────────────────────\n" out += f" Jouw track: {os.path.basename(self.sb_file1)}\n" out += f" Reference: {os.path.basename(self.sb_file2)}\n\n" for i,(name,_,_) in enumerate(BANDS): diff = r1_db[i] - r2_db[i] if abs(diff) > 3: status = f"⚠️ {'Te veel' if diff>0 else 'Te weinig'} ({diff:+.1f} dB)" elif abs(diff) > 1.5: status = f"💡 Slightly {'more' if diff>0 else 'less'} ({diff:+.1f} dB)" else: status = "✅ Comparable" out += f" {name:<10} {status}\n" out += "\n── EQ SUGGESTIES ─────────────────────────────────────\n" for i,(name,_,_) in enumerate(BANDS): diff = r1_db[i] - r2_db[i] if abs(diff) > 2: action = f"{'Snij' if diff>0 else 'Boost'} {abs(diff):.1f} dB" out += f" → {name}: {action}\n" self._write(self.sb_txt, out) self.sb_status.config(text="✅ Comparison done") except Exception as e: max(dbs.values()) + 3 db_range = max_db - min_db for i,(key,db) in enumerate(dbs.items()): x = PAD_L + i*((W-PAD_L-PAD_R)//n) h = max(4, int((db-min_db)/db_range*(H-PAD_T-PAD_B))) col = Analyzing..."); self.update() try: import librosa, numpy as np from scipy.signal import butter, sosfilt y_stereo, sr = librosa.load(self.mc2_file, sr=None, mono=False) if y_stereo.ndim == 1: / 2 S = (L - R) / 2 # RMS vergelijking stereo vs mono rms_stereo = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(((L+R)/2)**2))) rms_L = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(L**2))) rms_R = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(R**2))) rms_mono = check def bp_rms(y, f_lo, f_hi): nyq=sr/2; lo=max(f_lo/nyq,0.001); hi=min(f_hi/nyq,0.999) if lo>=hi: return 1e-9 sos=butter(4,[lo,hi],btype='band',output='sos') return "Flat or small mids boost — neutral position", 3: "Presence boost 3kHz — present and clear", 4: "High-shelf boost 8kHz — bright and present", 5: "High-shelf boost 12kHz — air and shimmer", } HEIGHT_EQ = HEIGHT_EQ_NL out = "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" out += " 🌐 3D MIX POSITIONER ANALYSIS\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n" # Check mono [abs(s["pan"].get()) for s in self.mix3d_sliders.values()] avg_width = sum(pan_vals) / len(pan_vals) out += "── STEREO WIDTH ──────────────────────────────────\n" if avg_width < 15: out += " ⚠️ Mix is width\n" out += "\n── GOOSEBUMPS TIPS ───────────────────────────────\n" out += " → Vocals at 1-3m — intimate and close\n" out += " → Pads/Strings at 20-50m — large and spacious\n" out += " → That left.rowconfigure(1, weight=1); left.columnconfigure(0, weight=1) self.pv2_counter = tk.Label(left, text="Photo 0 / 0", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG2) self.pv2_counter.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", self.pv2_info = tk.Text(right, font=("Courier New",9), bg=BG2, fg=TEAL, relief="flat", padx=12, pady=10, wrap="word", state="disabled") self.pv2_info.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="nsew") # Thumbnail strip tk.Label(p, text="TIMELINE:", font=F_LABEL, fg=FG2, bg=BG).grid( row=3, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(8,2)) self.pv2_strip = tk.Canvas(p, bg=BG3, height=64, highlightthickness=0) strip_sb = self.pv2_strip.grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="ew") # State self.pv2_images = [] self.pv2_current = 0 self.pv2_playing = False self.pv2_job = None self.pv2_tkimgs = [] self._pv2_win = win def _pv_load(self, win): paths = filedialog.askopenfilenames( parent=win, filetypes=[("Images","*.jpg *.jpeg *.png *.bmp *.webp"),("All","*.*")]) if paths: self.pv2_images.extend(list(paths)) self.pv_count_lbl2.config( text=f"🖼️ {len(self.pv2_images)} images", fg=PURPLE) self._pv2_show(0) self._pv2_draw_strip() def _pv2_show(self, idx): if not self.pv2_images: return idx = max(0, min(idx, len(self.pv2_images)-1)) self.pv2_current = idx path = self.pv2_images[idx] try: from PIL import Image, ImageTk self.pv2_canvas.update() cw = max(self.pv2_canvas.winfo_width(), 400) ch = max(self.pv2_canvas.winfo_height(), 280) img = Image.open(path).convert("RGB") img.thumbnail((cw, ch), Image.LANCZOS) tk_img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(img) self.pv2_tkimgs = [tk_img] self.pv2_canvas.delete("all") x = cw//2 - img.width//2 y = ch//2 - img.height//2 self.pv2_canvas.create_image(x, y, anchor="nw", image=tk_img) except Exception as e: self.pv2_canvas.delete("all") self.pv2_canvas.create_text(200, 140, text=f"Could not load\n{str(e)[:30]}", fill=FG2, font=F_LABEL) bpm = int(self.pv2_bpm.get()) if self.pv2_bpm.get().isdigit() else 90 bars = int(self.pv2_bars.get()) sec_s = (60.0/bpm)*4*bars start_s = idx * sec_s end_s = (idx+1) * sec_s s = f"{int(start_s//60)}:{int(start_s%60):02d}" e = f"{int(end_s//60)}:{int(end_s%60):02d}" self.pv2_counter.config( text=f"Photo {idx+1}/{len(self.pv2_images)} — {os.path.basename(path)[:35]}") self.pv2_time.config(text=f"{s} → {e} · {bpm} BPM · {bars} bars · {sec_s:.1f}s") # Analyse info = self._pv2_analyse(path) total_s = len(self.pv2_images) * sec_s txt = (f"── SECTION {idx+1}/{len(self.pv2_images)} ──────────────\n\n" f" Time: {s} → {e}\n" f" Duration: {sec_s:.1f}s\n\n" f"── MUSIC ─────────────────────────────\n\n" f" Mood: {info['mood']}\n" f" Key: {info['key']}\n" f" Chords: {info['chords']}\n" f" Instruments: {info['inst']}\n\n" f"── TOTAL ─────────────────────────────\n\n" f" {len(self.pv2_images)} photos\n" f" Total: {int(total_s//60)}:{int(total_s%60):02d}\n") self.pv2_info.config(state="normal") self.pv2_info.delete("1.0", tk.END) self.pv2_info.insert("1.0", txt) self.pv2_info.config(state="disabled") self._pv2_draw_strip() def _pv2_analyse(self, path): try: from PIL import Image import numpy as np px = np.array(Image.open(path).convert("RGB").resize((50,50))).reshape(-1,3).astype(float) br = float(np.mean(px)); r=float(np.mean(px[:,0])); b=float(np.mean(px[:,2])); sat=float(np.std(px)) if br<60: return dict(mood="Dark", key="D minor", chords="Dm-Bb-Gm-A", inst="Strings+Piano") elif br>180 and sat>40: return dict(mood="Bright", key="C major", chords="C-G-Am-F", inst="Acoustic+Piano") elif br>180: return dict(mood="Minimal", key="C major", chords="Cmaj7-Fmaj7", inst="Piano+Pads") elif r>b+20: return dict(mood="Warm", key="A minor", chords="Am-F-C-G", inst="Piano+Strings") elif b>r+20: return dict(mood="Cinematic",key="E minor", chords="Em-C-G-D", inst="Synth+Orchestra") else: return dict(mood="Balanced", key="A minor", chords="Am-F-C-Em", inst="Piano+Strings") except Exception: return dict(mood="Unknown", key="A minor", chords="Am-F-C-G", inst="Piano") def _pv2_draw_strip(self): self.pv2_strip.delete("all") if not self.pv2_images: return TW, TH, PAD = 72, 50, 4 total_w = len(self.pv2_images)*(TW+PAD)+PAD self.pv2_strip.configure(scrollregion=(0,0,total_w,TH+14)) strip_imgs = {} for i, path in enumerate(self.pv2_images): x = PAD + i*(TW+PAD) col = ACCENT if i==self.pv2_current else BORDER self.pv2_strip.create_rectangle(x-1,2,x+TW+1,TH+4, fill=col, outline="") try: from PIL import Image, ImageTk img = Image.open(path).convert("RGB"); img.thumbnail((TW,TH),Image.LANCZOS) tk_img = ImageTk.PhotoImage(img) strip_imgs[i] = tk_img self.pv2_strip.create_image(x,3,anchor="nw",image=tk_img) except Exception: self.pv2_strip.create_rectangle(x,3,x+TW,TH+3,fill=BG3,outline="") self.pv2_strip.create_text(x+TW//2,TH//2+3,text=str(i+1),fill=FG2,font=("Courier New",8)) self.pv2_strip.create_text(x+TW//2,TH+10, text=str(i+1), fill=ACCENT if i==self.pv2_current else FG2, font=("Courier New",7)) idx=i tag=f"thumb_{i}" rect=self.pv2_strip.create_rectangle(x,3,x+TW,TH+3,fill="",outline="",tags=tag) self.pv2_strip.tag_bind(tag,"",lambda e,n=idx: self._pv2_show(n)) self._pv2_strip_imgs = strip_imgs def _pv2_prev(self): self._pv2_show(self.pv2_current-1) def _pv2_next(self): self._pv2_show(self.pv2_current+1) def _pv2_move_left(self): i = self.pv2_current if i>0 and self.pv2_images: self.pv2_images[i],self.pv2_images[i-1]=self.pv2_images[i-1],self.pv2_images[i] self.pv2_current=i-1; self._pv2_show(self.pv2_current) def _pv2_move_right(self): i = self.pv2_current if i 180 and saturation > 40: mood = "Bright / Vibrant" target_lufs_shift = +0.5 low_shelf_db = -0.3 high_shelf_db = +0.8 # more air/sparkle sat_drive = 0.08 comp_amount = 0.18 elif saturation < 20: mood = "Desaturated / Melancholic" target_lufs_shift = -0.8 low_shelf_db = +0.4 high_shelf_db = -0.4 sat_drive = 0.08 comp_amount = 0.10 elif warmth > 15: mood = "Warm / Golden" target_lufs_shift = -0.5 low_shelf_db = +1.0 high_shelf_db = -0.4 sat_drive = 0.15 comp_amount = 0.15 elif warmth < -15: mood = "Cool / Blue" target_lufs_shift = 0.0 low_shelf_db = -0.6 high_shelf_db = +0.7 sat_drive = 0.06 comp_amount = 0.15 else: mood = "Balanced / Neutral" target_lufs_shift = 0.0 low_shelf_db = 0.0 high_shelf_db = 0.0 sat_drive = 0.08 comp_amount = 0.12 if contrast > 70: comp_amount += 0.10 # high contrast image → more dynamic punch self.vr_status.config(text=f"⏳ Mood detected: {mood} — processing audio..."); self.update() # ── STEP 3: Load audio ────────────────────────── y, sr = librosa.load(self.vr_audio_file, sr=None, mono=False) if y.ndim == 1: y = np.stack([y, y]) # mono → fake stereo for processing n_channels = y.shape[0] def shelf_filter(signal, freq, gain_db, sr, kind="low"): """Simple shelf EQ via butterworth + gain blend.""" if abs(gain_db) < 0.05: return signal nyq = sr / 2 norm_freq = min(freq / nyq, 0.99) sos = butter(2, norm_freq, btype=kind, output='sos') filtered = sosfilt(sos, signal) gain_lin = 10 ** (gain_db / 20) if kind == "low": # boost/cut low band, keep high band as-is high_part = signal - filtered return filtered * gain_lin + high_part else: low_part = signal - filtered return low_part + filtered * gain_lin def soft_saturate(signal, drive): """Gentle tanh-based harmonic saturation.""" if drive <= 0: return signal driven = signal * (1 + drive * 4) return np.tanh(driven) / np.tanh(1 + drive * 4) def gentle_compress(signal, amount, sr): """Simple RMS-based soft-knee compressor.""" if amount <= 0: return signal window = max(1, int(sr * 0.02)) envelope = np.sqrt(np.convolve(signal**2, np.ones(window)/window, mode='same') + 1e-9) threshold = np.percentile(envelope, 70) ratio = 1 + amount * 3 # amount 0-1 → ratio 1:1 to 4:1 gain_reduction = np.ones_like(envelope) above = envelope > threshold gain_reduction[above] = (threshold + (envelope[above]-threshold)/ratio) / envelope[above] # smooth the gain reduction to avoid zipper noise smooth_win = max(1, int(sr * 0.005)) gain_reduction = np.convolve(gain_reduction, np.ones(smooth_win)/smooth_win, mode='same') return signal * gain_reduction processed = np.zeros_like(y) for ch in range(n_channels): sig = y[ch].copy() sig = shelf_filter(sig, 200, low_shelf_db, sr, kind="low") sig = shelf_filter(sig, 8000, high_shelf_db, sr, kind="high") sig = gentle_compress(sig, comp_amount, sr) sig = soft_saturate(sig, sat_drive) processed[ch] = sig # ── STEP 4: Loudness matching ─────────────────── current_rms = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(processed**2))) if current_rms > 0: current_db = 20*np.log10(current_rms) target_db = current_db + target_lufs_shift gain_lin = 10 ** ((target_db - current_db)/20) processed = processed * gain_lin # ── STEP 5: Safety limiter (prevent clipping) ── peak = float(np.max(np.abs(processed))) if peak > 0.98: processed = processed * (0.98 / peak) # ── STEP 6: Write output file ─────────────────── base = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.vr_audio_file))[0] out_dir = os.path.dirname(self.vr_audio_file) out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{base}_remastered_{mood.split(' ')[0].lower()}.wav") out_audio = processed.T if n_channels > 1 else processed[0] sf.write(out_path, out_audio, sr, subtype='PCM_24') # ── Output summary ────────────────────────────── out = "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" out += " 📸🎚 VISUAL REMASTER COMPLETE\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n" out += f" Image: {os.path.basename(self.vr_image_file)}\n" out += f" Track: {os.path.basename(self.vr_audio_file)}\n\n" out += f"── DETECTED MOOD: {mood} ─────────────────────\n" out += f" Brightness: {brightness:.0f}/255\n" out += f" Saturation: {saturation:.0f}%\n" out += f" Warmth: {'warm' if warmth>0 else 'cool'} ({warmth:+.0f})\n" out += f" Contrast: {contrast:.0f}\n\n" out += f"── PROCESSING APPLIED ────────────────────────\n" out += f" Low shelf (200Hz): {low_shelf_db:+.1f} dB\n" out += f" High shelf (8kHz): {high_shelf_db:+.1f} dB\n" out += f" Compression amount: {comp_amount*100:.0f}%\n" out += f" Saturation drive: {sat_drive*100:.0f}%\n" out += f" Loudness shift: {target_lufs_shift:+.1f} dB\n\n" out += f"── OUTPUT FILE ───────────────────────────────\n" out += f" {out_path}\n\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" out += " * This is a real, processed audio file — not\n" out += " just suggestions. Listen and compare with the\n" out += " original. Always trust your ears — you can\n" out += " always re-run with a different image for a\n" out += " different mood.\n" out += "══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n" # Display in a popup since this tab doesn't have a dedicated text output self._show_vr_result(out, out_path, title="📸🎚 VISUAL REMASTER RESULT") self.vr_status.config(text=f"✅ Done — saved as {os.path.basename(out_path)}") except Exception as e: self.vr_status.config(text=f"❌ {str(e)[:80]}") def _show_vr_result(self, text, out_path, title="📸🎚 REMASTER RESULT"): import subprocess win = tk.Toplevel(self) win.title(title) win.geometry("700x600") win.configure(bg=BG) hdr = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=12); hdr.pack(fill="x", padx=20) tk.Label(hdr, text=title, font=F_MED, fg=GOLD_LT, bg=BG).pack(side="left") _MacBtn(hdr, text="✕", font=F_LABEL, bg=BG3, fg=FG2, relief="flat", cursor="hand2", padx=10, pady=3, command=win.destroy).pack(side="right") tk.Frame(win, bg=GOLD_LT, height=1).pack(fill="x") frm = tk.Frame(win, bg=BORDER, padx=1, pady=1) frm.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=16, pady=12) txt = tk.Text(frm, font=("Courier New",10), bg=BG2, fg=GOLD_LT, relief="flat", wrap="word", padx=16, pady=12) sb = tk.Scrollbar(frm, command=txt.yview, bg=BG3, troughcolor=BG3) txt.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set) sb.pack(side="right", fill="y") txt.pack(fill="both", expand=True) txt.insert("1.0", text) txt.config(state="disabled") br = tk.Frame(win, bg=BG, pady=8); br.pack(fill="x", padx=16) self._btn(br, "📁 Show in Finder", BG4, BTN_FG, lambda: subprocess.run(["open","-R",out_path])).pack(side="left", padx=(0,8)) self._btn(br, "▶️ Play", BG4, GOLD_LT, lambda: subprocess.run(["open",out_path])).pack(side="left") # ── FAVORIETEN ──────────────────────────────────────── def _build_favs(self,parent): p=tk.Frame(parent,bg=BG,padx=22); p.pack(fill="both",expand=True,pady=8); p.columnconfigure(0,weight=1) hdr=tk.Frame(p,bg=BG); hdr.grid(row=0,column=0,sticky="ew",pady=(8,8)) tk.Label(hdr,text="⭐ FAVORITES",font=F_MED,fg=GOLD,bg=BG).pack(side="left") self._btn(hdr,"🗑 Delete",BG4,ACCENT,self._del_fav).pack(side="right",padx=(4,0)) self._btn(hdr,"📋 Copy",BG4,FG2,lambda:self._copy_lb(self.fav_lb)).pack(side="right",padx=(4,0)) self._btn(hdr,"📁 Export",BG4,FG2,self._export_favs).pack(side="right",padx=(4,0)) self.fav_lb=self._lb_out(p,1,GOLD) self.fav_count=tk.Label(p,text="",font=F_LABEL,fg=FG2,bg=BG); self.fav_count.grid(row=2,column=0,sticky="w",pady=(4,0)) def _refresh_favs(self): self.fav_lb.delete(0,tk.END) for t in self.favorieten: disp=t[:100].splitlines()[0]+("..." if len(t)>100 else "") self.fav_lb.insert(tk.END,f" ⭐ {disp}") self.fav_count.config(text=f"{len(self.favorieten)} favorites") def _del_fav(self): sel=list(self.fav_lb.curselection())[::-1] if not sel: messagebox.showinfo("Info","Selecteer eerst iets."); return for i in sel: del self.favorieten[i] self._sla_data_op(); self._refresh_favs() def _export_favs(self): if not self.favorieten: messagebox.showwarning("Empty","No favorites."); return self._export("\n\n".join(f"{i+1}. {t}" for i,t in enumerate(self.favorieten)),"favorites.txt") # ── GESCHIEDENIS ────────────────────────────────────── def _build_history(self,parent): p=tk.Frame(parent,bg=BG,padx=22); p.pack(fill="both",expand=True,pady=8) hdr=tk.Frame(p,bg=BG); hdr.pack(fill="x",pady=(8,8)) tk.Label(hdr,text="📜 HISTORY",font=F_MED,fg=FG,bg=BG).pack(side="left") self._btn(hdr,"🗑 Clear all",BG4,ACCENT,self._wis_history).pack(side="right") split=tk.Frame(p,bg=BG); split.pack(fill="both",expand=True) left=tk.Frame(split,bg=BG2,width=230); left.pack(side="left",fill="y",padx=(0,10)); left.pack_propagate(False) tk.Label(left,text="SESSIES",font=F_LABEL,fg=FG2,bg=BG2,pady=6).pack() sb1=tk.Scrollbar(left,bg=BG3,troughcolor=BG2); sb1.config(command=self.hist_lb.yview) self.hist_lb.bind("<>",self._show_hist) right=tk.Frame(split,bg=BG); right.pack(side="left",fill="both",expand=True) self.hist_info=tk.Label(right,text="← Click a session",font=F_LABEL,fg=FG2,bg=BG,pady=6); self.hist_info.pack(anchor="w") btns=tk.Frame(right,bg=BG); btns.pack(fill="x",pady=(0,4)) self._btn(btns,"⭐ → Favorite",BG4,GOLD,self._hist_to_fav).pack(side="left") lb_f=tk.Frame(right,bg=BG3); lb_f.pack(fill="both",expand=True) sb2=tk.Scrollbar(lb_f,bg=BG4,troughcolor=BG3); sb2.pack(side="right",fill="y") self.hist_items=tk.Listbox(lb_f,font=F_LIST,bg=BG3,fg=FG,selectbackground=ACCENT,relief="flat",bd=0,activestyle="none",yscrollcommand=sb2.set,selectmode="extended") self.hist_items.pack(fill="both",expand=True,padx=10,pady=8); sb2.config(command=self.hist_items.yview) def _refresh_history(self): self.hist_lb.delete(0,tk.END) icons={"titles":"🎵","lyrics":"✍️","hook":"🎤","rap":"🔥","rap16":"🔥","punch":"💥","rhymes":"🔤","music":"🎼","structure":"📐"} for s in self.geschiedenis: icon=icons.get(s.get("type","titles"),"🎵") self.hist_lb.insert(tk.END,f" {icon} {s['datum'][:10]} {s['mood'].upper()}") self.hist_items.delete(0,tk.END); self.hist_info.config(text="← Click a session") def _show_hist(self,event): sel=self.hist_lb.curselection() if not sel: return s=self.geschiedenis[sel[0]] self.hist_info.config(text=f"📅 {s['datum']} · {s.get('type','').upper()} · {s['lang'].upper()} · mood: {s['mood'].upper()} · \"{s['invoer']}\"") self.hist_items.delete(0,tk.END) for item in s["items"]: for line in item.splitlines(): self.hist_items.insert(tk.END,f" {line}") def _hist_to_fav(self): sel=self.hist_items.curselection() items=[self.hist_items.get(i).strip() for i in sel] if sel else [self.hist_items.get(i).strip() for i in range(self.hist_items.size())] nieuw=[t for t in items if t and t not in self.favorieten] if not nieuw: messagebox.showinfo("Info","Already in favorites."); return self.favorieten.extend(nieuw); self._sla_data_op(); messagebox.showinfo("⭐",f"{len(nieuw)} item(s) added!") def _wis_history(self): if messagebox.askyesno("Clear","Clear entire history?"): self.geschiedenis=[]; self._sla_data_op(); self._refresh_history() if __name__ == "__main__": app = App() app.mainloop()
